paper.title: CL4D: Contrastive Language-4D Pretraining for Vision-Language Reasoning in Dynamic Scenes
paper.abstract: 4D understanding and reasoning is a fundamental capability for embodied AI agents operating in dynamic physical environments. However, existing vision encoders are largely limited to static 2D images or 3D point clouds without temporal modeling, or to 2D videos that lack accurate geometric depth reasoning. Consequently, current approaches fail to jointly capture spatial structure and motion evolution in dynamic scenes. We present CL4D, the first foundational 4D vision encoder that directly opera

summary.core_problem: 为动态点云场景建立能与自然语言对齐的 4D 基础视觉编码器，并把它接到 4D 视觉语言推理上。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态预训练方法扩展：把对比式语言对齐从 2D/视频推进到 4D 动态点云。对做统一多模态基座的人有一定参考，但离 LLM 预训练主线仍有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CL4D，用对比学习把动态点云的时空几何表示与文本描述对齐，学习共享嵌入空间；在此基础上构建 4DVLM，使模型能够基于 4D 场景表示进行视觉语言任务。核心新意在于直接建模 dynamic point clouds，而不是把问题退化成静态 3D 或 2D 视频。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称支持 zero-shot motion-to-text 和 text-to-motion retrieval，并可作为下游 4D vision-language 任务的基础编码器。未给出模型规模、训练数据量和具体提升幅度，因此目前更像方向性工作，需看正文判断 setup 是否干净。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Moratuwa、Singapore-MIT Alliance for Research and Technology (SMART) Centre 和 A*STAR，属于有一定研究能力的多机构合作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to build a language-aligned 4D foundation vision encoder for dynamic point-cloud scenes and use it for 4D vision-language reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal pretraining extension: it pushes contrastive language alignment from 2D images/videos to dynamic 4D point clouds. It is somewhat relevant for researchers working on unified multimodal foundations, though still peripheral to core LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes CL4D, which aligns spatio-temporal geometric representations of dynamic point clouds with natural-language descriptions via contrastive learning in a shared embedding space. On top of that, it builds 4DVLM for downstream 4D vision-language tasks. The main novelty is modeling dynamic point clouds directly rather than collapsing the problem into static 3D or 2D video.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims zero-shot motion-to-text and text-to-motion retrieval, and use as a foundation encoder for downstream 4D VLM tasks. It does not provide model scale, training data size, or concrete gains, so this currently reads as a directional paper whose setup needs checking in the full text.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Moratuwa, Singapore-MIT Alliance for Research and Technology (SMART) Centre, and A*STAR, indicating a credible multimodal collaboration.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 native multimodal pretrain，可只看它如何把动态点云直接对齐到语言；但大概率是模态扩展，不会改写文本基座训练的 prior。
recommendation.en: Worth a skim only if you care about native multimodal pretraining; the interesting bit is direct language alignment for dynamic point clouds, not a shift in core LLM priors.

paper.title: VideoGAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants on Agentic Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Video understanding is a fundamental task for evaluating the capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing leading models have already achieved approximately 90% accuracy on the Video-MME leaderboard, suggesting that conventional single-turn video understanding tasks are becoming increasingly saturated and insufficient for assessing the intelligence of advanced MLLMs. Towards this end, we introduce VideoGAIA, an agentic video understanding benchmark for general arti

summary.core_problem: 现有单轮视频理解基准（如Video-MME、VideoMMMU）已接近饱和，前沿模型准确率接近90%，无法有效评估下一代多模态大模型的工具使用、长程推理、多轮交互等智能体能力，缺乏面向通用AI助手的代理式视频理解评测基准。
summary.importance: 多模态预训练的评测范式正从单轮问答转向代理式任务，这对预训练阶段的能力注入（工具使用、多步推理、信息整合）提出了新的要求。VideoGAIA的任务设计可为多模态预训练数据构造、对齐目标设计提供参考，推动预训练目标从被动理解视频转向任务导向的主动证据收集。基准中的工具必要性评估维度，也可为研究多模态模型在预训练阶段如何习得“何时调用外部工具、何时依赖自身知识”的判断能力提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: VideoGAIA是面向通用AI助手的代理式视频理解基准，核心是将视频理解从单轮问答重构为多轮、工具增强的交互过程：模型需要迭代感知视频内容、调用外部工具、收集补充信息、整合多源证据以完成真实世界任务。基准构建采用多阶段人-机协同流水线：从10万条公开视频出发，使用Gemini-3.1-Pro、GPT-5.5等前沿模型完成帧级字幕生成、基于证据的任务生成、基于评分规则的质量控制、跨模态过滤、工具必要性评估，再由至少三名人类专家独立审核每个任务，仅保留通过审核的样本。最终测试集包含271条高质量任务，覆盖文化、地理、日常生活、历史、科技、经济六大类别，分为L1、L2两个难度等级。所有模型在统一的ReAct式智能体循环下接受评测，配备三个标准化工具：网页搜索（获取外部信息）、页面访问（将网页转换为文本）、视频回看（重新查看相关视频片段），以保证对比公平。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖20个前沿多模态大模型，所有模型准确率落在30%-60%区间，表现最好的Seed2.0-Pro仅达到58.30%，远低于其在传统单轮视频理解基准上的成绩。结果显示代理式视频理解仍远未解决，现有多模态模型在工具使用、多步推理、多源信息整合方面存在明显短板。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Introduction部分的评测范式转变逻辑，以及基准构建章节的人-机协同标注流水线、工具必要性评估方法；实验部分的排行榜结果可快速浏览。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。从事多模态预训练评测的研究者，可关注任务维度划分和难度分级的设计逻辑。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing single-turn video understanding benchmarks (e.g., Video-MME, VideoMMMU) are approaching saturation, with frontier models reaching ~90% accuracy. They can no longer effectively evaluate next-generation multimodal LLMs' agentic capabilities such as tool use, long-horizon reasoning, and multi-turn interaction. There is a lack of agentic video understanding benchmarks designed for general AI assistants.
summary_en.importance: The evaluation paradigm for multimodal pretraining is shifting from single-turn question answering to agentic tasks, which sets new requirements for capability injection during pretraining, including tool use, multi-step reasoning, and information integration. VideoGAIA's task design provides reference for multimodal pretraining data construction and alignment objective design, pushing pretraining objectives from passive video understanding toward task-driven active evidence gathering. The benchmark's tool-necessity assessment dimension also offers reference for studying how multimodal models can learn the judgment of when to call external tools versus when to rely on internal knowledge during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: VideoGAIA is an agentic video understanding benchmark for general AI assistants. It reframes video understanding from single-turn question answering into a multi-turn, tool-augmented interaction process: models must iteratively perceive video content, invoke external tools, gather complementary information, and integrate evidence from multiple sources to solve real-world tasks. The benchmark is built via a multi-stage human-model co-design pipeline: starting from 100K public videos, frontier models (Gemini-3.1-Pro, GPT-5.5) handle frame-level captioning, evidence-grounded task generation, rubric-based quality control, cross-modal filtering, and tool-necessity assessment. Each task is then independently reviewed by at least three human experts, with only approved samples retained. The final test set contains 271 high-quality tasks across six categories (Culture, Geography, Daily Life, History, Technology, Economics) and two difficulty levels (L1, L2). All models are evaluated under a unified ReAct-style agent loop with three standardized tools: web search (for external information retrieval), page visit (converts webpages to text), and video review (reinspects relevant video segments) to ensure fair comparison.
summary_en.experiments: 20 cutting-edge multimodal LLMs are evaluated, with all models achieving accuracy between 30% and 60%. The strongest model, Seed2.0-Pro, reaches only 58.30% accuracy, substantially lower than its performance on traditional single-turn video understanding benchmarks. The results indicate agentic video understanding remains far from solved, with clear gaps in tool use, multi-step reasoning, and multi-source information integration for current multimodal models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the paradigm shift rationale in the Introduction, and the benchmark construction section's human-model co-design pipeline and tool-necessity assessment methodology. Skim the leaderboard results in the experiments section for a quick sense of model performance gaps. Estimated reading time: 20–25 minutes. For researchers working on multimodal pretraining evaluation, pay special attention to the task dimension categorization and difficulty grading logic.

recommendation.zh: Agent式多模态视频评测的任务设计可指导多模态预训练的交互目标构造，重点看§2的任务分类与评测协议
recommendation.en: The task design of agentic multimodal video evaluation can guide interaction objective construction for multimodal pretraining; focus on §2's task taxonomy and evaluation protocol.

paper.title: SEER: Long-Context Reasoning via Selective Visual-Text Compression
paper.abstract: Long-context reasoning remains computationally expensive for large language models due to the quadratic complexity of attention over text tokens. Visual-text compression offers a promising alternative by rendering text into images and processing them with vision-language models, often reducing token usage. However, existing approaches apply uniform compression regardless of query relevance, potentially sacrificing precision where detailed extraction is required. We present SEER, a framework that

summary.core_problem: 现有基于视觉-文本压缩的长上下文方法对所有文本做统一压缩，在需要精细抽取的查询相关片段上损失精度。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出选择性视觉扫描+按需文本检索的自适应框架，在节省 token 的同时保留抽取精度。
summary.technical_approach: SEER 将长文本渲染为图像，先用 VLM 做视觉扫描定位查询相关区域，再调用工具仅检索对应文本片段做精细推理；通过工具交互轨迹的 SFT 学习自适应工具调用策略。
summary.experiments: 在长上下文 benchmark 上验证，相比统一视觉压缩方法提升抽取精度，同时保持平均 prompt token 节省量；未给出具体模型规模和 baseline 数值。
summary.authors_note: 剑桥大学工程系，Tianlong Chen 为通讯作者之一，团队长期做多模态与高效推理方向。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing visual-text compression for long-context reasoning applies uniform compression regardless of query relevance, sacrificing precision on segments requiring fine-grained extraction.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: an adaptive framework combining visual scanning for relevance localization and on-demand text retrieval for precise reasoning, preserving token savings.
summary_en.technical_approach: SEER renders long text into images, uses a VLM to visually scan and locate query-relevant regions, then invokes a tool to retrieve only the corresponding text segments for fine-grained reasoning. Adaptive tool invocation is learned via SFT on tool-interaction trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on long-context benchmarks, improving extraction precision over uniform visual compression while retaining average prompt-token savings; specific model sizes and baseline numbers not fully provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Department of Engineering, University of Cambridge; Tianlong Chen is a corresponding author, with the group working on multimodal and efficient reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 用视觉压缩绕开文本注意力二次方开销的思路有意思，但属于应用层 trick，对预训练研究员参考有限，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The idea of bypassing quadratic attention via visual compression is clever, but it is an application-level trick with limited relevance to pretraining research; read the abstract only.

paper.title: Beyond Visual CoT: Internalized Visual Thinking for Proactive Video Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models increasingly use visual chain-of-thought (Visual CoT) to reason about spatial, temporal, and embodied environments. By generating intermediate reasoning images, Visual CoT provides an intuitive mechanism for visual foresight but introduces substantial inference overhead, which is particularly problematic for proactive video reasoning. We ask whether models can learn to think visually during training while reasoning directly at inference. We introduce Internalized

summary.core_problem: 视频推理中的显式 Visual CoT 需要生成中间图像，推理开销大；论文研究能否把视觉思考内化到模型中，推理时直接作答。
summary.importance: 属于多模态后训练目标的探索，将未来视觉状态预测从像素空间移到隐空间，对统一视频-语言建模有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Internalized Visual Thinking（IVT），在无标注视频上联合优化文本预测和 next-embedding prediction；给定部分视频，模型同时预测未来帧的 latent 表示和目标文本答案，推理时不再合成或编码未来帧。
summary.experiments: 论文称在多个视频推理设置中进行了对照研究，但摘要未完整给出模型规模、训练数据、基线和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Explicit Visual CoT generates intermediate images and adds inference overhead; the paper asks whether visual thinking can be internalized so the model answers directly at inference.
summary_en.importance: It explores a multimodal post-training objective that moves future visual-state prediction from pixel space to latent space, which is relevant to unified video-language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT) jointly optimizes textual prediction and next-embedding prediction on unlabeled videos. Given a partially observed video, the model predicts latent representations of future frames together with the answer, avoiding future-frame synthesis or re-encoding at inference.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports controlled studies across video-reasoning settings, but the abstract does not provide full model size, training data, baselines, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 把 Visual CoT 的未来帧预测内化到 embedding 空间，对多模态目标设计有启发；但这是视频推理后训练工作，看方法图即可。
recommendation.en: Internalizing future-frame prediction into embedding space is a useful multimodal objective idea, but this is video-reasoning post-training; reading the method figure is enough.

paper.title: MobileMem: Learning from a Year of Mobile Experiences
paper.abstract: The next generation of AI agents is increasingly moving beyond systems that answer isolated questions toward persistent personal assistants that can understand, remember, and continuously learn from users' experiences. Such assistants require long-term memory to accumulate and leverage user-specific experiences over time, yet existing benchmarks remain inadequate for realistic mobile settings, where experiences are heterogeneous, multimodal, evolving, and deeply personal. We introduce MobileMem,

summary.core_problem: 核心问题：面向“移动端、长期、个性化”的智能体记忆，缺少贴近真实手机使用场景的长期记忆评测资产与任务设定；现有记忆工作多假设云端无限存储与算力，难以覆盖移动端的隐私、资源约束、跨 App 多模态碎片化、以及用户偏好随时间演化等关键难点。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的关联度有限，但作为 eval/benchmark 资产对“持续学习/长期记忆/个性化代理”方向有参考价值：
- 如果你在做 continual pretrain 或 memory-augmented LM，它提供更接近真实分布的长期轨迹设定，能暴露遗忘、陈旧信息处理、时间一致性等问题。
- 但它更偏 agent/memory 系统评测，而不是改进基座预训练目标、tokenizer 或 scaling law 的工作。对纯 pretrain recipe 的直接启发不强。
summary.technical_approach:
从引言可见的技术路线是“基于知识约束的合成管线”来构造一年尺度的移动体验轨迹：
- 数据形态：以用户 app session 为基本单元，强调跨 app、跨模态、时间连续的个人经历流（聊天、照片、截图、社媒、购物等）。
- 合成与一致性：用 knowledge-grounded synthesis 把碎片 session 组织成连贯、时间一致的 long-horizon trajectories，避免纯 LLM 合成带来的时间线冲突与事实漂移。
- 评测目标（推断）：长期记忆的写入/压缩/检索/更新；在存储与算力受限下的记忆选择；对用户偏好变化的适应与过期信息淘汰。
- 约束条件：on-device 场景下的隐私与资源限制是问题定义的一部分，而不是附加条件。
由于未看到任务定义与指标细节，尚无法判断它是更偏“检索式记忆评测”还是“可学习记忆策略评测”。
summary.experiments:
当前片段未包含：benchmark 规模（用户数、session 数、模态占比、时间跨度的统计细节）、具体任务集合、基线系统（RAG、摘要记忆、分层记忆、参数内记忆/LoRA 更新等）、以及指标与分数。
阅读全文时建议重点核对：
- 合成数据与真实分布的差距：是否有人工/规则校验来保证时间一致性与跨 app 事件对齐。
- 泄漏风险：同一事件是否在不同视角重复出现导致评测偏乐观。
- 资源约束是否量化：存储预算、延迟预算、端侧算力上限是否进入评测协议。
在缺少结果表前，无法给出具体数字结论。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–40 分钟，偏评测资产）：
1) 先看任务定义与评测协议：它到底测“记住事实”还是测“随时间更新的用户模型”。
2) 看数据构建/合成管线：knowledge grounding 如何做、一致性约束是什么、有哪些质量控制。
3) 看 baseline 与 error analysis：哪些方法在端侧约束下失效，失败模式是什么（遗忘、幻觉、时间线错乱、偏好漂移）。
如果只想判断是否值得投入：优先看数据统计表 + 任务列表 + baseline 对比表。

summary_en.core_problem: Problem: There is no realistic benchmark for long-term, on-device agent memory grounded in mobile experiences over year-scale horizons. Existing memory benchmarks often assume cloud storage/compute and miss key mobile constraints: privacy, limited resources, multimodal fragmentation across apps, temporal continuity, and evolving user preferences.
summary_en.importance: Relevance to core pretraining is modest. The main contribution is an evaluation asset/framework for long-term memory in mobile settings, which can be useful if you work on continual pretraining, memory-augmented LMs, or personalization under distribution shift. It is less about improving base-model pretraining objectives/tokenization/scaling, and more about stress-testing agent memory systems under realistic constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach:
From the introduction, the paper proposes a benchmark built via a knowledge-grounded synthesis pipeline:
- Data unit: user app sessions, emphasizing cross-app, multimodal, temporally continuous personal experience streams.
- Trajectory construction: synthesize coherent, temporally consistent long-horizon trajectories from fragmented sessions, using grounding/constraints to reduce timeline inconsistencies and factual drift typical of unconstrained LLM synthesis.
- Intended evaluation axes (inferred): memory write/compress/retrieve/update; budgeted storage and latency; handling stale information and preference drift; local-first privacy constraints.
Without the full task/metric section, it is unclear whether the benchmark primarily evaluates retrieval-style memory or learned memory management policies.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content does not include dataset scale statistics, task suite details, baselines, or quantitative results. When checking the full paper, focus on: (i) how temporal consistency and cross-app event alignment are enforced/validated, (ii) leakage/duplication risks that could inflate scores, and (iii) whether resource constraints are explicitly parameterized in the protocol (storage/latency/compute budgets). No reliable numbers can be reported from the current excerpt.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–40 minutes):
1) Task definitions and protocol: does it test static recall or evolving user models over time?
2) Data construction/synthesis: what grounding sources and consistency constraints are used, and what QC is applied?
3) Baselines + error analysis: which approaches fail under on-device budgets, and what are the dominant failure modes (forgetting, hallucinated memories, timeline errors, preference drift)?
To quickly decide relevance, read the dataset statistics table, task list, and the main baseline comparison table.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据合成管线和任务切分；若轨迹模板干净，它会是长期记忆 agent 的有用压力测试。
recommendation.en: Read the synthesis pipeline and task splits; if the trajectories are not too templated, this is a useful stress test for long-memory agents.

paper.title: G0.5: One Autoregressive Stream for Robot Reasoning and Action
paper.abstract: The prevailing recipe for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models couples a pretrained VLM with a separately trained flow-matching action expert. This makes the VLM a context encoder rather than a decision-maker. We introduce G0.5, a pretrained autoregressive VLA in which a single transformer decoder emits reasoning and action tokens under a single objective. Three components make this tractable at foundation-model scale: a learnable cross-embodiment action tokenizer that maps heterogeneous robot ac

summary.core_problem: 主流 VLA 模型把预训练 VLM 与独立训练的 flow-matching 动作专家拼接，使 VLM 退化为上下文编码器而非决策者；G0.5 尝试用单一自回归流同时输出推理与动作 token。
summary.importance: 范式创新：把 VLA 从 VLM+flow expert 的双塔结构改为单 decoder 自回归生成 reasoning+action，对统一多模态建模有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 三个组件：(1) 可学习的 cross-embodiment action tokenizer，把异构机器人动作映射到共享词表；(2) 原生 chain-of-thought 流，把任务分解、物体 grounding、动作提示与动作 token 交错；(3) 视觉记忆模块，通过 vision encoder 注入数秒历史。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给具体参数量/数据量/数值对比；声称在指令遵循、动作粒度/任务视野/OOD 场景可由 prompt 直接控制。

summary_en.core_problem: Dominant VLA recipes couple a pretrained VLM with a separately trained flow-matching action expert, reducing the VLM to a context encoder; G0.5 instead emits reasoning and action tokens from a single autoregressive decoder under one objective.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm contribution: moves VLA from a two-tower VLM+flow-expert design to a single-decoder AR generation of reasoning+action, relevant to unified multimodal modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three components: (1) a learnable cross-embodiment action tokenizer mapping heterogeneous robot actions into a shared vocabulary; (2) a native CoT stream interleaving task decomposition, object grounding, and action hints with action tokens; (3) a visual memory module injecting multi-second history through the vision encoder.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract gives no parameter count, data size, or numerical baselines; it claims instruction following and prompt-controllable action granularity, task horizon, and OOD scene handling.

recommendation.zh: 把动作离散化成 token 与文本 CoT 联合 AR 生成，思路与统一语言建模相关；只看 action tokenizer 和 CoT-action 交错设计两节即可。
recommendation.en: Discretizing actions into tokens and jointly AR-generating them with textual CoT is relevant to unified LM; read the action tokenizer and CoT-action interleaving sections only.

paper.title: Test-Time Hallucination Control in Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Object Hallucination in large vision-language models (LVLMs), where models generate non-factual content about input images, remains a critical barrier to their reliability in real-world applications. Existing mitigation strategies can be categorized into training-based and training-free methods. Training-based methods often achieve strong performance but are costly, requiring extensive computational resources, large-scale data, and time-consuming fine-tuning. Training-free approaches are particu

summary.core_problem: 大视觉语言模型（LVLM）的物体幻觉问题，现有训练基方法成本高，训练无关方法存在多轮解码开销大或损害预训练知识的缺陷
summary.importance: 提出了一种新的训练无关测试时幻觉缓解方法，属于方法创新，解决了现有训练无关方法的两大痛点
summary.technical_approach: 提出测试时幻觉缓解方法TTH，用零样本多模态分类器（MMC）作为token验证器生成辅助logits，引导解码过程抑制幻觉token，无需多轮解码也不修改模型内部权重
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验设置、模型参数量、基线模型及量化提升幅度，仅说明方法为训练无关且无需多轮解码

summary_en.core_problem: Object hallucination in large vision-language models (LVLMs); existing training-based methods have high costs, while training-free methods suffer from either high multi-round decoding overhead or damage to pretrained knowledge.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel training-free test-time hallucination mitigation method, which is a methodological innovation solving two key pain points of existing training-free approaches.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Test-Time Hallucination mitigation (TTH): uses a zero-shot Multi-Modal Classifier (MMC) as a token validator to generate auxiliary logits, guiding decoding to suppress hallucinatory tokens without multi-round decoding or modifying model weights.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental setup, model parameter scale, baselines or quantitative improvement margins are disclosed in the abstract; only notes the method is training-free and requires no multi-round decoding.

recommendation.zh: 属于LVLM测试时幻觉缓解的增量方法，无预训练或后训练侧改动，仅了解思路即可，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Incremental method for test-time LVLM hallucination mitigation with no pretraining or post-training modifications; grasp the core idea only, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: VisEditBench: Can Vision-Language Models Edit Visualization Code from Multimodal Feedback?
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong capabilities in generating visualization code from textual or visual specifications. However, real-world visualization authoring is inherently iterative: users frequently revise existing visualizations to repair flawed charts or adapt them to desired styles. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate generation from scratch, leaving visualization code editing from multimodal feedback largely unexplored. We introduce VisEditBench, a benchmark of 1,395 h

summary.core_problem: 现有 VLM/LLM 评测多看“从零生成可视化代码”，但真实工作流更常见的是基于多模态反馈对既有可视化代码进行迭代编辑；缺少对应 benchmark。
summary.importance: 提供一个面向“多模态反馈驱动的代码编辑”的评测资产，覆盖修复与风格迁移两类真实场景；对做多模态代码能力/交互式编程 agent 的团队是补齐评测空白。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 VisEditBench：1,395 条人工标注的可视化代码编辑任务；两种设置——(1) feedback-guided repair：给 buggy/标注过的图表 + 文本反馈，要求修改代码；(2) reference-guided restyling：给目标图像，要求把代码改到匹配目标风格/外观。
summary.experiments: 评测 20 个 SOTA VLM；摘要提到 Claude-4.6-Sonnet 表现最好但任务仍困难（摘要截断，未给出完整数值与对比细节）。
summary.authors_note: York University / NTU / Salesforce AI Research；偏 benchmark 构建与多模态代码编辑评测。

summary_en.core_problem: Most VLM/LLM benchmarks test visualization code generation from scratch, while real workflows require iterative code editing from multimodal feedback; a benchmark is missing.
summary_en.importance: Provides an evaluation asset for multimodal feedback-driven code editing (repair + restyling), filling a gap for multimodal coding/interactive programming research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces VisEditBench with 1,395 human-annotated visualization code-editing tasks in two settings: (1) feedback-guided repair using buggy/marked charts plus textual feedback; (2) reference-guided restyling to match a target chart image by editing code.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 20 state-of-the-art VLMs; the abstract notes Claude-4.6-Sonnet performs best but the task remains challenging (abstract truncated; detailed numbers not provided here).
summary_en.authors_note: York University / NTU / Salesforce AI Research; benchmark-centric work.

recommendation.zh: 评测资产不错但偏窄（可视化代码编辑）；做通用 pretrain 的只需扫任务定义与失败案例，除非你在做多模态代码/交互式编辑。
recommendation.en: Good but narrow benchmark (viz code editing); for pretraining folks, skim task setup + failure modes unless you actively work on multimodal coding/editing.

paper.title: Lost in Reconstruction: Aligning Action Representations with Language in Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Action verbs describe not only the physical outcomes of actions, but also how those actions are performed. Yet action representations in vision-language-action models (VLAs) are typically optimized for reconstruction under L1/L2 losses in raw action space, where numerical proximity need not reflect linguistically meaningful distinctions. On BridgeV2, we show that action trajectories contain verb-grounding information beyond visual state changes, and that reconstruction-only discrete tokenization

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是 VLA 里一个常被忽略的接口问题：动作表示通常按连续控制空间的重建误差来学，尤其是离散 action tokenizer 往往只优化 L1/L2 或 VQ 重建，但这种“数值上接近”并不等于“语言上同类”。结果是，动作轨迹里原本携带的 verb grounding 信息在离散化和压缩过程中被系统性抹掉，语言条件策略只能在一个已经失真的动作词表上继续学习。论文的核心问题因此不是机器人控制本身，而是如何让 action representation 在离散化时就保留与语言，尤其是动词语义，对齐的结构。
summary.importance: 对 LLM / 统一预训练研究的启发主要在表示层，而不是具体机器人 benchmark。很多多模态统一建模工作默认“先把非文本模态 token 化，再交给 AR LM”即可，但这篇文章提醒：tokenizer 如果只保真低层重建目标，可能会在进入统一 LM 之前就丢掉最关键的语义因子。这个问题和视觉 tokenizer、语音离散单元、world model latent code 的设计是同一类。论文的贡献量级属于“把 action tokenizer 从压缩器改成语义接口”，对做 native multimodal pretrain、VLA、以及任何把控制序列离散化进 LM 的工作都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
文章先做了两个诊断，再提出 SALT。第一个诊断是证明动作轨迹确实含有超出视觉结果的 verb 信息。作者把 verb grounding 拆成两部分：action goals，对应 episode 起止状态的视觉变化；motion dynamics，对应 7-DoF 连续动作轨迹。通过信息分析，他们发现两者各自都携带对方无法完全替代的 verb 信息，也就是说，单看图像前后状态不足以恢复动作语义，动作过程本身包含语言相关结构。

第二个诊断是现有离散动作表示会损伤这种结构。作者比较了 Bin tokenization、VQ-VAE tokenizer 和 FAST 等方案，考察 tokenized action representation 与 verb 之间的 mutual information。结论是：只按重建训练的 tokenizer 会系统性降低 verb 相关信息，而且压缩越强，损失越大。更重要的是，后续语言条件 policy training 不能完全把这部分结构补回来，说明瓶颈发生在 tokenizer 这一步，而不是 policy head 太弱。

在此基础上，作者提出 SALT，Semantically ALigned action Tokenizer。它以 VQ-VAE 风格 tokenizer 为基础，但在 tokenizer 训练阶段加入一个语言对齐辅助目标：把量化后的 action latent 输入一个冻结的预训练 VLM，让它生成对应 episode instruction。这样做的关键不是让 tokenizer 直接分类 verb，而是通过 instruction generation 这个更丰富的监督，把“被相似语言描述的动作”拉到更接近的离散表示，同时保留连续控制空间的重建能力。训练目标因此是 reconstruction / commitment / codebook loss 与 instruction-generation loss 的联合优化。这里选择冻结 VLM，而不是端到端共同训练，目的是把语言语义作为稳定教师信号注入 tokenizer 学习，避免 policy 训练阶段再去间接恢复。

从建模角度看，SALT 的重要区别在于：它把 action tokenizer 从单纯的压缩模块变成了跨模态语义瓶颈。相比 per-dimension binning，SALT 学的是组合式离散词表；相比 reconstruction-only VQ-VAE，它显式约束 codebook 保留语言可恢复性；相比 FAST 这类频域压缩+BPE，它不只追求序列压缩率，而是优先保留对 instruction 有用的结构。
summary.experiments:
实验分三部分。第一部分是语义诊断。作者在 BridgeV2 上分析 verb 信息来源，结论是视觉终态和动作轨迹都含有独立贡献，支持“动作模态需要单独对齐语言”的前提。第二部分是 tokenizer 信息损失分析。Across Bin、VQ-VAE、FAST，token 化后的动作表示与 verb 的 mutual information 都下降，且压缩越强下降越明显；这说明离散接口确实是语言 grounding 的瓶颈。第三部分是下游控制验证。作者在 SimplerEnv 中训练基于不同 tokenizer 的 policy，SALT 的平均任务成功率达到 71.9%，明显高于 reconstruction-only VQ-VAE 的 42.7%，也高于 FAST 的 31.2%。这个提升幅度足够大，说明语义对齐并不是只改善可解释性，而是实打实影响闭环控制。

摘要还提到，虽然辅助目标没有显式标注 verb，学到的 action vocabulary 仍会围绕 verb-relevant distinctions 组织起来。这通常意味着论文里应有 codebook 可视化、最近邻分析、instruction recoverability 或 token cluster 的语义分析。精读时应重点看这些定性结果，因为它们决定 SALT 到底是在学“语言相关动作原语”，还是仅仅借助额外监督提升了重建质量。另一个值得看的是消融：instruction-generation loss 权重、codebook size、压缩率、冻结 VLM 的选择，以及 policy 训练是否在不同 tokenizer 容量下保持公平比较。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读但要抓住主线。先看 Section 2 和 Section 3，确认作者不是直接上新方法，而是先证明两个前提：动作轨迹里有额外 verb 信息；现有 tokenizer 会把它丢掉。若这两步不成立，SALT 就没有必要。然后看 Section 4 的训练目标和结构图，重点理解为什么 supervision 放在 tokenizer 阶段，而不是 policy 阶段；以及为什么用冻结 VLM 从量化 latent 生成 instruction，能逼迫 codebook 保留语言可恢复性。最后看 Section 5 的 SimplerEnv 主结果和 tokenizer 语义分析。

预计 35-50 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。最值得停下来看的图表通常是：verb information decomposition、mutual information vs compression、不同 tokenizer 的成功率主表、以及 codebook / token cluster 的可视化。如果你关心统一多模态预训练，阅读时可以把 action token 换成 image / audio token 去想：同样的问题很可能也存在，只是动作模态把问题暴露得更明显。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a representation bottleneck in vision-language-action models: action tokenizers are usually trained to reconstruct continuous control trajectories under L1/L2 or VQ-style objectives, but numerical fidelity in action space does not guarantee preservation of linguistically meaningful distinctions. As a result, verb-grounding information present in trajectories is systematically degraded during discretization and compression, and downstream language-conditioned policy learning has to operate on an already distorted action vocabulary. The central question is therefore how to make action representations preserve language-aligned structure at the tokenizer stage, not only at the policy stage.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is broader than robotics. Many multimodal LM pipelines assume that once a modality is tokenized, an autoregressive model can absorb the rest. This paper shows why that assumption can fail: if the tokenizer is optimized only for low-level reconstruction, it may discard the semantic factors that matter most before the unified model ever sees them. That lesson transfers directly to visual tokenizers, audio discretization, and latent codes used in world models or unified multimodal pretraining. The contribution is best viewed as turning the action tokenizer from a compression module into a semantic interface.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper first establishes two empirical diagnoses, then introduces SALT. The first diagnosis is that action trajectories contain verb information beyond visual state changes. The authors decompose verb grounding into action goals, represented by visual changes between episode endpoints, and motion dynamics, represented by the 7-DoF action trajectory. Their analysis shows that each carries verb-relevant information not fully captured by the other. This means that visual outcomes alone are insufficient; the action process itself contains language-relevant structure.

The second diagnosis is that existing discrete action representations erase this structure. The paper compares Bin tokenization, VQ-VAE tokenizers, and FAST, and measures the mutual information between verbs and tokenized action representations. Reconstruction-only tokenizers consistently reduce verb-related information, with stronger compression causing larger losses. Importantly, downstream language-conditioned policy training does not fully recover the missing structure, indicating that the bottleneck is created at the tokenizer interface rather than by an underpowered policy head.

SALT—Semantically ALigned action Tokenizer—is then built on top of a VQ-VAE-style tokenizer. During tokenizer training, the quantized action latents are fed into a frozen pretrained VLM, which is asked to generate the corresponding episode instruction. This adds a language-alignment objective to the usual reconstruction, commitment, and codebook losses. The point is not to classify verbs explicitly, but to force the codebook to preserve information that makes the original instruction recoverable. Actions described by similar language are therefore encouraged to occupy nearby or related discrete representations while maintaining control-space fidelity.

The key modeling difference is that SALT treats the tokenizer as a cross-modal bottleneck. Compared with per-dimension binning, it learns a compositional discrete vocabulary. Compared with reconstruction-only VQ-VAE, it explicitly constrains the codebook to retain language-recoverable structure. Compared with FAST-style frequency compression plus BPE, it prioritizes semantic preservation over compression alone. Using a frozen VLM as the teacher also stabilizes the language signal and avoids relying on downstream policy training to rediscover the missing semantics.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments have three parts. First, on BridgeV2, the paper analyzes where verb information comes from and shows that both visual endpoint changes and action trajectories contribute unique information. That supports the premise that action representations need their own language alignment rather than inheriting everything from vision-language pretraining.

Second, the paper studies information loss under tokenization. Across Bin, VQ-VAE, and FAST, mutual information between verbs and tokenized action representations drops, and the drop becomes larger under stronger compression. This is the core evidence that the discrete action interface is a semantic bottleneck.

Third, the paper evaluates downstream control in SimplerEnv. Policies trained with SALT reach 71.9% average task success, compared with 42.7% for a reconstruction-only VQ-VAE tokenizer and 31.2% for FAST. The gap is large enough to show that semantic alignment is not merely improving interpretability; it materially affects closed-loop control performance.

The abstract also notes that although the auxiliary objective does not explicitly label verbs, the learned action vocabulary becomes organized around verb-relevant distinctions. In the full paper, the most informative evidence here is likely to be codebook visualizations, nearest-neighbor analyses, instruction recoverability, or token-cluster semantics. Those qualitative analyses matter because they reveal whether SALT is truly learning language-aligned action primitives rather than simply benefiting from extra supervision. The most useful ablations to inspect are the weight of the instruction-generation loss, codebook size, compression level, the choice of frozen VLM, and whether policy comparisons are capacity-matched across tokenizers.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a good skim paper, but the logic matters. Start with Sections 2 and 3, because the method only makes sense if two premises hold: trajectories contain verb information beyond visual outcomes, and standard tokenizers destroy part of it. Then read the SALT method section and the training objective carefully. The key question is why the semantic supervision is applied during tokenizer learning rather than deferred to policy learning, and why instruction generation from quantized latents is an effective way to preserve language-recoverable structure. Finish with the SimplerEnv results and the codebook or token-semantic analyses.

A useful first pass should take about 35–50 minutes. The figures worth focusing on are the verb-information decomposition, mutual information versus compression, the main downstream success-rate table, and any visualization of token clusters or codebook organization. If your interest is unified multimodal pretraining, it is worth mentally replacing action tokens with image or audio tokens while reading; the same failure mode likely exists there as well, but action makes it easier to observe.

recommendation.zh: 动作侧tokenizer加语义对齐辅助loss的简洁案例，对统一模态离散化设计有参考；只看tokenizer loss设计和verb聚类图即可。
recommendation.en: Clean case study on adding a semantic auxiliary loss to an action tokenizer; skim the tokenizer objective and verb-code clustering figures for multimodal-tokenizer transferable ideas.

paper.title: SpikeWorld: Fast-State Adaptation for Frozen Spiking World Models
paper.abstract: A predictive model receives a self-supervised signal whenever the consequence of an action is observed. Using that signal after deployment is difficult when dynamics and semantics share parameters: freezing prevents adaptation, whereas weight updates require optimizer state and may alter the learned representation. Here we introduce SpikeWorld, a 1.45M-parameter sparse spiking model jointly trained for heterogeneous sensory prediction, semantics, image-text binding and action-conditioned dynamic

summary.core_problem: 解决世界模型部署后在分布偏移下难以继续利用自监督信号适配环境、但又不希望更新主模型参数的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作有一点基础模型味道：冻结主干、外接快速状态适配路径、同时做多模态预测与动作条件动态建模。它更接近 embodied/world model 研究，不是 LLM 预训练主线，但对“冻结基座 + 外部状态更新”这个接口有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SpikeWorld，一个 1.45M 参数的稀疏脉冲世界模型，联合训练异构感知预测、语义、图文绑定和动作条件动态。部署时完全冻结参数，只通过两条外部路径适配：一条基于累计固定库损失选择有界动作修正，另一条用 route-specific residual matrices 改进下一状态预测；全程不依赖标签、奖励或教师信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出 1.45M 参数规模，并报告联合优化后动作下一状态 MSE 降低 17.10%，同时多模态预测、语义准确率和图文检索也有提升。实验重点是冻结模型后的在线适配，而不是大规模预训练、语言建模或 scaling 分析。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses how a deployed world model can keep using self-supervised signals under distribution shift without updating the frozen backbone parameters.
summary_en.importance: This has a mild foundation-model flavor: a frozen backbone with external fast-state adaptation, plus multimodal prediction and action-conditioned dynamics. It is closer to embodied/world-model research than core LLM pretraining, but the interface idea is somewhat relevant.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpikeWorld is a 1.45M-parameter sparse spiking world model jointly trained for heterogeneous sensory prediction, semantics, image-text binding, and action-conditioned dynamics. At deployment all weights are frozen, and adaptation happens through two external paths: bounded action correction selected from cumulative fixed-bank losses, and route-specific residual matrices for next-state refinement, without labels, rewards, or teacher outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 1.45M model and a 17.10% reduction in action next-state MSE, along with gains in multimodal prediction, semantic accuracy, and image-text retrieval. The focus is online adaptation after training, not large-scale language pretraining or scaling.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但“冻结主干、把适配写进外部状态”这个思路值得记；只看部署期更新机制，别被 spiking 包装带偏。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the idea of keeping the backbone frozen and pushing adaptation into external state is worth noting; read only the deployment-time update mechanism.

paper.title: Listen, See and Track: Spatio-Temporal Audio-Visual Sound Event Reasoning for Omni-Modal Language Models
paper.abstract: Understanding dynamic sound sources requires jointly determining what produces a sound, where the source is located, and how it moves over time. Yet existing audio-language models often represent clips as global acoustic events, while vision-language models lack the spatial audio cues needed to localize and track individual sources. To evaluate this missing capability, we introduce ST-OmniQA, a spatio-temporal audio-visual question-answering benchmark built from panoramic videos paired with sync

summary.core_problem: 现有音频-语言模型和视觉-语言模型缺乏对动态声源的时空定位与跟踪能力的问题
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献+方法创新，提出首个时空音视频问答基准ST-OmniQA，并构建了对应的多模态模型ST-Omni-R1
summary.technical_approach: 基于全景视频和同步一阶Ambisonics（FOA）音频构建数据集，包含40K视频和400K问答对，覆盖声音事件识别、到达方向、声源距离、运动轨迹、时序 grounded 音视频推理4个能力层级；ST-Omni-R1整合FOA衍生的语义和轨迹表示与全景视觉上下文，通过渐进式课程学习训练
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体基线对比和量化结果，仅说明数据集规模和模型设计思路

summary_en.core_problem: Existing audio-language and vision-language models lack the ability to localize and track dynamic sound sources in space and time
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution + methodological innovation: proposes ST-OmniQA, the first spatio-temporal audio-visual QA benchmark, and the corresponding ST-Omni-R1 multimodal model
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs dataset from panoramic videos paired with synchronized first-order Ambisonics (FOA) audio of moving sound sources, containing 40K videos and 400K QA pairs across 4 capability levels; ST-Omni-R1 integrates FOA-derived semantic and trajectory representations with panoramic visual context, trained via progressive curriculum learning
summary_en.experiments: No specific baseline comparisons or quantitative results are provided in the abstract, only dataset scale and model design are described

recommendation.zh: 音视频时空推理的新benchmark，做多模态预训练的可以了解下数据集构造思路，无需深读
recommendation.en: A new benchmark for audio-visual spatio-temporal reasoning; multimodal pretraining researchers can note the dataset construction approach, no deep read needed

paper.title: PhysX-CoT: Structured Physical Reasoning from a Single Image to Simulation-Ready 3D Assets
paper.abstract: Simulation-ready 3D assets are central to robotics and embodied AI. Generating them from a single image is usually framed as a vision-language model that emits a serialized asset for a decoder to turn into geometry and physical fields, leaving the image-to-3D reasoning implicit. We argue the limiting factor is this output-centric view: part placement and local shape are entangled in one global-coordinate token stream, and the intermediate physical states are never exposed for supervision, condit

summary.core_problem: 从单张图像生成仿真就绪3D资产时，现有方法将图像到3D的推理隐式化，零件放置与局部形状纠缠在全局坐标token流中
summary.importance: 方法创新，将单图像3D资产生成重新建模为显式结构化物理推理过程，而非端到端序列化输出
summary.technical_approach: PhysX-CoT把生成分解为零件级状态的有序可解析轨迹（分解、2D/3D grounding、关系、粗几何、表面线索），各阶段分别监督并作为几何条件和奖励目标；几何因子化为3D box（位置）+ local code（形状）；用CoT对齐的GRPO优化解析有效性
summary.experiments: 单图像到仿真就绪3D资产生成任务，验证结构化推理轨迹相比隐式序列化输出的优势
summary.authors_note: 作者含Chen Qian等，跨机构合作

summary_en.core_problem: Existing single-image-to-3D-asset methods treat image-to-3D reasoning implicitly, entangling part placement and local shape in one global-coordinate token stream
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation reframing single-image 3D asset generation as an explicit structured physical reasoning process rather than end-to-end serialized output
summary_en.technical_approach: PhysX-CoT decomposes generation into an ordered, machine-parseable trajectory of part-level states (decomposition, 2D/3D grounding, relations, coarse geometry, surface cues), each separately supervised and used as geometry conditioning and reward targets; geometry factorized into 3D boxes (placement) + local codes (shape); CoT-aligned GRPO optimizes parse validity
summary_en.experiments: Single-image to simulation-ready 3D asset generation, validating structured reasoning trajectory over implicit serialized output
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Chen Qian; cross-institutional collaboration

recommendation.zh: 核心是3D生成，结构化推理+GRPO的思路对post-training有微弱参考，但与LLM预训练距离远，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Core is 3D generation; the structured-reasoning-plus-GRPO angle has marginal post-training relevance but is far from LLM pretraining. Abstract suffices.

paper.title: Improving Generalization Robustness of Multimodal RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) makes Multimodal Large Language Models more accurate, but the gains are brittle: simply paraphrasing a question or changing the prompt template can degrade them, which challenges reliable deployment in high-stakes scenarios like medical VQA. We trace this to two issues of the standard RL objective. First, the binary verifier conflates format with content, so the reward signal cannot tell a wrong answer apart from a misformatted one. Second, t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究多模态 RLVR 的泛化脆弱性：模型在训练时拿到可验证奖励后，遇到语义等价但表述不同的 prompt 或模板时性能会明显下滑。
summary.importance: 这对 pretrain 研究员是间接相关但有价值的，因为它暴露了后训练奖励设计中的一个老问题：reward 把格式和语义混在一起，会诱导策略学到脆弱捷径。若这一点成立，它会反过来影响如何设计 verifier、合成数据和 mid-train / RL 接口。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把问题归因于标准 RL 目标的两点缺陷：一是二值 verifier 无法区分“答案错”和“格式错”；二是训练分布过窄，导致策略对未见 prompt 变体不稳。对应地，方法上强调两件事：把 reward 中的格式约束与语义正确性解耦；并在策略优化中引入更广的语义等价 prompt 分布，以提升对 paraphrase 和模板变化的鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和提升数字，但明确场景是多模态 RLVR，并以 prompt paraphrase / template shift 下的泛化退化为主要评测维度。若正文包含 clean 的 in-distribution vs out-of-template 对照和 reward ablation，这篇会比一般 RL trick 更值得看，因为它在测训练信号本身的失真。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a brittleness issue in multimodal RLVR: models improve under verifiable rewards during training, yet degrade noticeably when faced with semantically equivalent prompts or different templates at test time.
summary_en.importance: This is indirectly relevant to pretraining researchers because it exposes a familiar post-training failure mode: the reward mixes formatting with semantics, encouraging brittle shortcuts. If the diagnosis is correct, it has implications for verifier design, synthetic data generation, and the pretrain-to-RL interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors attribute the problem to two flaws in the standard RL objective. First, a binary verifier cannot distinguish a wrong answer from a misformatted but semantically correct one. Second, the training distribution covers only a narrow slice of possible prompts, so the learned policy is unstable under unseen prompt variants. The proposed remedy is to separate format from semantic correctness in the reward and optimize over a broader distribution of semantically equivalent prompts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, or exact gains, but it clearly frames prompt paraphrase and template shift as the key generalization tests in multimodal RLVR. If the full paper includes clean in-distribution vs out-of-template comparisons and reward-design ablations, it is more informative than a typical RL trick paper because it probes distortion in the training signal itself.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看的是 reward 设计而不是多模态外壳：若实验对 template shift 控得干净，它会直接影响你怎么做 verifier、怎么写 RL 数据格式。
recommendation.en: Read this for the reward-design lesson, not the multimodal wrapper: if the template-shift setup is clean, it should change how you build verifiers and format RL data.

paper.title: Does More Retrieved Evidence Help Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Diffusion Language Models?
paper.abstract: Visual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) commonly expands the retrieved evidence set to improve answer-page coverage, implicitly assuming that all available evidence should be passed to the generator. We show that this assumption does not hold for diffusion language models (DLMs): retrieving more pages increases answer-page recall, whereas unconditionally passing all retrieved pages to the generator often reduces answer accuracy, primarily because of semantic conflict. A latent-source analysi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很具体、但对新型语言建模范式很关键的问题：在视觉 RAG 里，给 diffusion language model 提供更多检索证据，为什么会出现“检索覆盖更高，但最终答案更差”的反常现象。传统 AR-RAG 的直觉是 top-k 越大，答案页被召回的概率越高，生成器就更容易答对；但在多模态 DLM 中，多个页面会同时进入并行去噪过程，所有未决 token 位置共享这些视觉条件。这样一来，若不同页面分别支持不同但各自自洽的答案，模型在位置级并行提议时会把不兼容的信息拼接起来，生成一个没有任何单一页面支持的混合答案。论文把这个问题刻画为 source-coherence loss，即并行去噪破坏了“答案应来自同一潜在证据源”的耦合约束。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于提出了一个通用 DLM 训练目标，而在于它把 diffusion/并行生成范式在 RAG 场景下的一个结构性弱点讲清楚了。AR 模型逐 token 条件化，天然更容易沿着单一证据链展开；DLM 的并行去噪则可能在早期就把多个来源混合。这个观察对后续几类工作都有启发：一是多模态 DLM 的上下文构造不能直接照搬 AR-RAG 的“多给证据总没错”；二是 generator-side evidence admission 需要和 DLM 的去噪几何匹配，而不是只看 retriever 分数；三是第一步去噪分布本身可以作为诊断和控制信号。这类分析对 diffusion LM、any-order LM、masked LM 一类非 AR 生成器如何接入外部知识，属于有方法论价值的补充。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上分两部分。第一部分是机制分析。作者先在固定 top-k 输入设置下，对 3 个多模态 DLM 和 5 个视觉 QA benchmark 做系统比较，发现 Recall@k 随 k 上升，但宏平均答案准确率反而下降。随后他们把额外页面分成不同条件，指出真正造成退化的是 semantic conflict，而不是“多图输入”本身。理论上，论文在 first unresolved denoising state 上做了一个受限 latent-source 分析：若正确页和冲突页分别支持不同完整答案，而答案跨多个 token 位置，那么理想模型应在这些位置上共享同一个 latent source 选择；但位置独立的 proposal 会丢掉这种耦合，于是给 cross-source answer 分配非零概率，而且冲突跨度越长，unsupported mass 越大。第二部分是训练外的证据筛选框架 ECF。它包含 multi-granularity evidence construction 和 generator-side admission 两步。前者把整页和版面区域一起建索引，解决答案局部化问题；后者不直接依据检索分数选页，而是对每个候选页 ci，在 {c1, ci} 与 {c1, blank(ci)} 两种条件下比较目标 DLM 第一去噪步 answer block 的熵，得到 conditional confidence gain。这个设计的关键在于用 blank 对照消掉“多一个视觉输入槽位”带来的结构性影响，只测候选内容本身是否降低竞争源风险。最后再结合 rank prior 决定是否从 top-1 扩展到更多证据，以及扩展到哪一页。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个多模态 DLM、5 个视觉 QA 数据集，并在统一的 VisRAG 排序候选池、prompt、解码预算和答案评分器下比较 fixed top-k 与选择式证据接入。核心结果有三层。第一，现象层：top-k 从 1 增到 2、3 时，answer-page recall 持续上升，但在 15 个 model-dataset 组合上的宏平均答案准确率下降。第二，机制层：在作者构造或归类的页面条件中，conflicting pages 导致的精度下降最大；而且这种干扰在第一步 answer-block 分布里就能看到——在自然检索到的 ChartQA 样本上，冲突页条件下 first-step answer-block accuracy 降幅最大，与 correct-only 分布的 Jensen-Shannon divergence 也最大，并且这与最终答案退化方向一致。第三，方法层：ECF 在 5 个 benchmark、3 个 DLM 上，相比最强 fixed top-k 输入平均提升 2.62 个百分点；在 LLaDA2.0-Uni 上，相比最强 training-free baseline 平均再高 2.37 个百分点。论文还强调，ECF 的收益在 candidate pool 扩大时更稳定，说明它确实把“候选池大小”和“最终上下文大小”解耦了，而不是只在某个固定 k 上碰巧有效。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合带着“DLM 为什么和 AR 在 RAG 上行为不同”这个问题去读。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1、Figure 2，把 availability–accuracy mismatch 以及 first-step signal 的经验事实抓住。然后重点读 3.3 的 latent-source analysis 和对应命题，那里是全文最有信息量的部分：作者不是泛泛地说“多证据会冲突”，而是把冲突如何在并行去噪里变成 unsupported mixed answer 讲清楚了。接着看 ECF 的定义，尤其是 {c1, ci} 对 {c1, blank(ci)} 的 counterfactual 设计，理解为什么要做 geometry-matched 对照，而不是直接比较加入候选前后的熵。实验部分建议重点看三类表图：top-k 扫描、冲突类型分解、first-step 与 final-answer 的对应关系。若时间有限，读完机制分析和主结果就够；若想深挖，可以继续看 multi-granularity evidence construction 的实现细节，判断它的收益有多少来自更好的检索覆盖，有多少来自 generator-side filtering。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific but important failure mode of diffusion language models in visual RAG: retrieving more evidence improves answer-page recall, yet passing all retrieved pages to the generator often hurts final answer accuracy. The usual AR-RAG intuition is that larger top-k should help because the answer-bearing page is more likely to be included. The authors show that this intuition breaks for multimodal DLMs. During parallel denoising, multiple visual pages jointly condition all unresolved answer positions. If different pages support different coherent answers, position-wise proposals can mix incompatible sources and assign probability to hybrid answers that are supported by neither page. The paper frames this as source-coherence loss: the denoising process fails to preserve the coupling that all answer tokens should come from the same latent evidence source.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining-oriented readers is not a new training objective, but a clear account of a structural weakness of non-AR generation under retrieval augmentation. AR models expand answers token by token and are less exposed to this kind of cross-source mixing. DLMs, because they denoise many positions jointly, can fail much earlier in the generation process. That matters for diffusion LM, masked LM, and any-order LM research more broadly: evidence selection cannot simply inherit AR-era heuristics such as “more retrieved context is safer.” The paper also suggests that generator-native signals from early denoising steps can be used for context control, which is a useful design direction for retrieval interfaces to non-autoregressive generators.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has two main parts. First, it establishes and explains the mismatch. Under fixed top-k input settings, the authors evaluate three multimodal DLMs on five visual QA benchmarks using the same VisRAG-ranked candidate pools, prompts, decoding budgets, and answer scorer. They show that Recall@k increases with k, while macro-average answer accuracy drops. They then isolate the cause and find that semantic conflict, not merely the presence of multiple images, is the main driver of degradation. The theoretical analysis focuses on the first unresolved denoising state. When a correct page and a conflicting page each support a different coherent answer, the correct latent structure requires multiple answer positions to share one source choice. A position-factorized proposal breaks this dependence and allocates probability mass to cross-source answers; the unsupported mass grows as the conflict spans more answer positions. Second, the paper proposes ECF, a training-free evidence admission framework. It combines multi-granularity evidence construction, where both full pages and layout-derived regions are indexed, with generator-side candidate filtering. For each additional candidate ci, ECF compares the target DLM’s first-step answer-block entropy under {c1, ci} versus {c1, blank(ci)}. This yields a conditional confidence gain that controls for the structural effect of adding another visual slot and measures whether the candidate content itself reduces competing-source risk. A rank-prior selection rule then decides whether to expand beyond the top-1 page and which candidate to admit.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans three multimodal DLMs and five visual QA benchmarks. The main empirical findings come in three layers. First, the phenomenon itself: increasing top-k from 1 to 2 or 3 consistently raises answer-page recall, but lowers macro-average answer accuracy across 15 model-dataset combinations. Second, the mechanism: conflicting pages produce the largest accuracy drop among the tested evidence conditions. The same interference is already visible in the first-step answer-block distribution. On naturally retrieved ChartQA cases, the conflicting-page condition causes the largest drop in first-step answer-block accuracy and the largest Jensen-Shannon divergence from the correct-only distribution, and this aligns with the largest final-answer degradation. Third, the method result: across five benchmarks and three DLMs, ECF improves over the strongest fixed top-k input by 2.62 percentage points on average. With LLaDA2.0-Uni, it also beats the strongest training-free baseline by 2.37 points on average. The paper further reports that ECF remains more stable as the candidate pool grows, which supports the claim that it decouples candidate-pool size from final context size rather than merely tuning a better fixed k.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it with one question in mind: why does retrieval behave differently for DLMs than for AR generators? Start with the introduction and the main figures showing the availability-accuracy mismatch and the first-step signal. Then spend most of the time on the latent-source analysis in Section 3.3 and the associated propositions. That is where the paper becomes more than an empirical warning; it gives a concrete mechanism for how parallel denoising creates unsupported mixed answers. After that, look closely at the ECF design, especially the counterfactual comparison between {c1, ci} and {c1, blank(ci)}. The blanked control is important because it isolates candidate content from the mere geometry of adding another visual input. In the experiments, focus on three pieces: the top-k sweep, the conflict-type breakdown, and the correspondence between first-step distributions and final answers. If reading time is limited, the mechanism section plus the main result tables are enough to capture the contribution.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看机制，不是看 RAG trick：它说明 DLM 的并行去噪会放大多源冲突，先读 latent-source analysis 和 first-step 分布那部分。
recommendation.en: Read it for the mechanism, not the RAG trick: it shows parallel denoising in DLMs amplifies multi-source conflict; start with the latent-source analysis and first-step distribution evidence.

paper.title: C$^3$PO: Evaluating Cross-Modal Composition and Counterfactual Performance in Omnimodal Models
paper.abstract: Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can process diverse sensory inputs, yet their reasoning remains heavily biased toward a dominant modality, resulting in brittle cross-modal reasoning. We introduce C$^3$PO, a benchmark of 3,404 samples spanning video, audio, image, and text, evaluating two abilities: information composition (fusing dispersed evidence) and counterfactual conflict (resolving deliberate contradictions). C$^3$PO's paired IC/CC structure and four-tier design enable tar

summary.core_problem: 当前多模态大模型存在严重模态偏倚，现有评测基准无法有效诊断跨模态组合推理与反事实冲突消解能力，且扩展成本高。
summary.importance: 该基准明确量化了当前全模态模型在跨模态组合推理和冲突消解上的能力缺口，尤其是开源模型在冲突场景下的性能崩溃现象，为多模态预训练的模态平衡对齐、跨模态融合目标设计提供了针对性的评测抓手。全自动生成管线的设计也为大规模多模态评测集构建提供了可复用的范式。
summary.technical_approach: 构建C³PO基准，包含3404个样本，覆盖视频、音频、图像、文本四种模态。设计两个核心评测维度：一是信息组合，解题所需证据分散在不同模态，必须跨模态融合才能答对；二是反事实冲突，模态间故意设置矛盾，模型需要消解冲突才能答对。基准分为四层认知复杂度等级，基于25个逻辑自洽的任务模板，采用全自动管线生成——以真实世界基础媒体为锚点合成互补模态，兼顾真实性与精细控制能力。
summary.experiments: 人类准确率为88.64%，最强闭源模型Gemini-3.1-Pro仅达到73.17%，开源模型在冲突场景下出现严重性能下降。所有受测模型均表现出明显的模态偏倚，普遍优先依赖语言先验，忽视其他模态的证据，在存在矛盾的场景下尤为突出。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约25-30分钟。重点关注两个评测维度（信息组合/反事实冲突）的设计逻辑和四层复杂度分级结构；实验部分重点看闭源与开源模型在冲突场景下的性能差距。单个任务模板的详细描述可跳过。
summary.authors_note: 具体作者与机构未在提供的文本中披露

summary_en.core_problem: Current multimodal LLMs suffer from severe modality bias, and existing benchmarks cannot effectively diagnose cross-modal compositional reasoning and counterfactual conflict resolution while remaining scalable.
summary_en.importance: The benchmark quantifies the concrete capability gap of current omnimodal models in cross-modal compositional reasoning and conflict resolution, especially the performance collapse of open-source models under conflict settings. It provides a targeted evaluation handle for multimodal pretraining research on balanced modality alignment and cross-modal fusion objective design. The fully automatic generation pipeline also offers a reusable paradigm for building large-scale multimodal evaluation datasets.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces C³PO, a benchmark with 3,404 samples covering video, audio, image, and text modalities. Two core evaluation axes: Information Composition, where required evidence is dispersed across modalities making cross-modal fusion mandatory; and Counterfactual Conflict, where deliberate contradictions are introduced across modalities requiring resolution to answer correctly. The benchmark has four tiers of increasing cognitive complexity, built via a fully automatic pipeline using 25 logically grounded task templates. It uses real-world base media as anchors and synthesizes complementary modalities to balance realism and fine-grained control.
summary_en.experiments: Human accuracy reaches 88.64%, while the best closed-source model (Gemini-3.1-Pro) only achieves 73.17%. Open-source models show severe performance degradation under conflict settings. Clear modality bias is observed across all tested models, which universally prioritize linguistic priors over evidence from other modalities, especially when contradictions exist.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time ~25–30 minutes. Focus on the design logic of the two evaluation axes (Information Composition / Counterfactual Conflict) and the four-tier complexity structure. In the experiment section, pay attention to the performance gap between closed-source and open-source models under conflict settings. Detailed descriptions of individual task templates can be skipped.
summary_en.authors_note: Specific author names and affiliations not provided in the available text.

recommendation.zh: 模态主导的量化结论对多模态预训练有直接参考价值，重点看注意力探针分析部分，基准本身可作为内部评测参考
recommendation.en: The quantified modality-dominance finding is directly relevant to multimodal pretraining; focus on the attention-probe analysis, the benchmark can serve as an internal eval reference

paper.title: Spoken Function Calling: A New Perspective on Spoken Language Understanding for Large Audio Language Models
paper.abstract: Spoken Language Understanding (SLU) is the core component of task-oriented dialogue systems and a pivotal link in achieving seamless human-agent interaction. While traditional SLU can effectively extract user semantics for closed-set tasks after in-domain supervised fine-tuning, it faces significant challenges in leveraging in-context learning for open-domain tasks due to its ambiguous rule definitions. This work proposes Spoken Function Calling (SFC), a novel semantic understanding perspective

summary.core_problem: 论文把传统语音语义理解从“意图分类 + 槽位填充”改写为 Spoken Function Calling：给定语音、环境上下文和函数 schema，直接生成可执行的结构化函数调用。核心问题是，面向开放域语音 Agent 时，模型不应依赖 SFT 记住固定 intent/slot 规则，而应能通过 ICL 理解动态工具定义。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，更接近音频大模型的评测与 post-training。但它给语音 LM 研究提供了一个有用接口：语音理解不只评 ASR 或传统 SLU，而是评模型能否在带噪声、口语省略和多意图场景下对齐工具 schema。对 audio LM / LALM 预训练研究的启发在于，语音 token 表示和语言表示是否足够支持结构化语义抽取，不能只靠转写质量判断。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，论文先形式化传统 SLU：输入原始语音，输出 intent 和 slot 的语义框架。随后提出 SFC 形式化：输入语音 A、环境上下文 E、函数定义 D_func，输出一组结构化 function calls，包括函数名、参数键和值；缺失参数用 NAN 标记，交给后续补全机制。这个设计的关键是把 intent 和 slot 的约束合并进函数 schema。相比传统 SLU 的标签集合，函数定义给了更强的结构先验，也更适合开放域 ICL。数据侧，作者从已有 SLU 数据集中整理出 300 个 spoken functions，并用 multi-agent system 合成多层级 query 与标注，构建 SFC-Bench。训练侧，作者采用 GRPO 做 LALM post-training，避免 PPO 额外训练 value model 的成本，并设计细粒度 reward 来约束函数名、参数、结构合法性等输出维度。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕三个问题展开：SFC 是否比传统 SLU 更适合 LALM；现有 LLM/LALM 在不同难度 SFC 上的瓶颈在哪里；RL post-training 后的 SpokenFC-7B 是否能改善结构化语音调用能力。论文报告 SFC 在语音语义抽取上优于传统 SLU 视角，尤其在动态函数定义和复杂参数边界上更稳定。高层级任务仍然困难，主要涉及多意图、语义歧义和口语省略。作者训练的 SpokenFC-7B 在 SFC 任务上超过若干强闭源模型，同时保持普通任务能力，包括语音识别和音频推理。已知规模信息包括 300 个 spoken functions 和 7B 级模型；更细的分数、分层难度收益和 reward 消融需要看实验表格。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 SLU 到 SFC 的问题重述，Methodology 中 SFC 的形式化定义，以及 dataset/reward 相关小节。若只关心预训练，可跳过传统 SLU 背景，重点看 SFC-Bench 的数据构造、难度分层、细粒度 reward，以及 SpokenFC-7B 是否牺牲 ASR/音频推理能力。值得深挖的是：SFC 的收益来自语音模型更强的语义能力，还是来自函数 schema 对输出空间的强约束；这会影响它对 audio LM 预训练目标设计的参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reframes spoken language understanding from intent classification and slot filling into Spoken Function Calling. Given speech, environmental context, and a function schema, the model must emit executable structured calls. The central issue is open-domain spoken agent interaction: the model should interpret dynamic tool definitions through in-context learning rather than memorize fixed SLU schemas through in-domain SFT.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a core pretraining paper. Its main value is in evaluation and post-training for large audio-language models. Still, it is useful for audio LM research because it changes what is being measured. Spoken understanding is not only transcription quality or closed-set SLU accuracy; it is whether the model can map noisy, underspecified, multi-intent speech into schema-constrained actions. This is a sharper interface for studying whether speech representations align well with language and tool-use representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first formalizes standard SLU as mapping raw speech to semantic frames with intent labels and slot-value pairs. It then defines SFC as mapping speech A, environmental context E, and function definitions D_func into a set of structured function calls. Each call contains a function name and key-value arguments; missing arguments are represented as NAN to trigger later completion. The important design choice is that the function schema jointly constrains intent selection and slot extraction. This is stronger than a flat label set and better matched to open-domain ICL. On the data side, the authors curate 300 spoken functions from existing SLU datasets and use a multi-agent synthesis pipeline to build SFC-Bench with multi-level queries and labels. On the training side, they use GRPO for LALM post-training, avoiding the extra value model required by PPO, and introduce fine-grained rewards for structured calling behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments test whether SFC is a better framing than traditional SLU, where current LLMs and LALMs fail on SFC, and whether RL post-training helps. The paper reports that SFC gives stronger semantic extraction for LALMs than the traditional SLU formulation, especially when dynamic function definitions and complex parameter boundaries are involved. High-level SFC tasks remain hard, mainly due to multi-intent speech, ambiguity, and implicit spoken context. The resulting SpokenFC-7B is reported to outperform several strong closed-source models on SFC tasks while preserving normal speech recognition and audio reasoning performance. The concrete scale details available here are 300 spoken functions and a 7B model; exact scores, difficulty-wise breakdowns, and reward ablations should be checked in the experiment tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the problem reformulation in the introduction, the formal SFC definition in the methodology section, the SFC-Bench construction pipeline, and the reward design for GRPO. Readers focused on pretraining can skip most traditional SLU background and inspect whether the benchmark reveals limitations of speech-language representations rather than only output-format constraints. A useful question to keep in mind is whether the gains come from better spoken semantic modeling or from the schema narrowing the output space.

recommendation.zh: 把function calling范式引入口语理解是合理方向，数据集合成方法和后训练recipe对音频多模态LM研究有参考，看§3数据集和§5实验即可。
recommendation.en: Applying function calling to spoken language understanding is a reasonable direction; dataset synthesis and post-training recipe are informative for audio multimodal LM research, read §3 and §5 only.

institutions: Shanghai Jiao Tong University,Token Foundry, Alibaba Group
Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai Innovation Institute

paper.title: Perception Before Reasoning: Dynamic Latent Reasoning for Video Understanding and Question Answering
paper.abstract: Video question answering requires models to ground language queries in visual evidence and, when necessary, reason over that evidence across time. Existing methods typically rely on long textual chain-of-thought rationales, even though many questions can be answered as soon as the relevant object, action, or frame is localized. We propose Dynamic Latent Reasoning (DyLaR), which first grounds a question in a short block of perception latents (continuous hidden states that encode query-relevant vi

summary.core_problem: 现有视频QA方法过度依赖长文本CoT推理，而很多问题在定位到相关视觉证据后即可直接回答，存在推理冗余和效率低下的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出“先感知后推理”的动态潜在推理框架，减少不必要的文本CoT推理，兼顾准确率和效率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DyLaR框架：1）将查询ground到短感知潜在块（连续隐状态，编码查询相关视觉证据）；2）自适应决定是否追加推理潜在（在隐空间对证据进行推理）；3）训练流程：用验证的视觉证据ground感知潜在，蒸馏验证的推理链到推理潜在，再用RL优化推理时机的决策。
summary.experiments: 在9个视频benchmark、4个多模态LLM骨干上进行实验，平均准确率优于基线（摘要截断，具体提升幅度未披露）。
summary.authors_note: 作者含Vicente Ordonez（多模态领域知名研究者），所属机构含莱斯大学。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video QA methods over-rely on long textual Chain-of-Thought reasoning, while many questions can be answered immediately after localizing relevant visual evidence, leading to redundant reasoning and low efficiency.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a dynamic latent reasoning framework following the 'perception before reasoning' paradigm, reducing unnecessary textual CoT while balancing accuracy and efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DyLaR: 1) grounds queries into short perception latent blocks (continuous hidden states encoding query-relevant visual evidence); 2) adaptively decides whether to append reasoning latents for latent-space evidence reasoning; 3) training pipeline: grounds perception latents with verified visual evidence, distills verified rationales into reasoning latents, then refines reasoning timing via RL.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 9 video benchmarks with 4 multimodal LLM backbones, achieving higher average accuracy than baselines (abstract truncated, exact improvement margins not disclosed).
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Vicente Ordonez, a well-known researcher in multimodal learning, affiliated with Rice University.

recommendation.zh: 多模态中动态切换感知/推理阶段的思路对统一预训练的潜在推理设计有参考，仅看方法框架即可。
recommendation.en: Dynamic perception-reasoning switching in multimodal models informs latent reasoning design for unified pretraining; only review the method framework.

paper.title: UHP Detection: LVLMs have their Unique Hallucination Pattern in the Consistency Space
paper.abstract: Large vision--language models (LVLMs) demonstrate strong multimodal reasoning capabilities but remain prone to hallucination, where model predictions are not grounded in visual evidence. Existing black-box hallucination detection methods estimate uncertainty through a single consistency metric, implicitly assuming that model uncertainty can be adequately characterized by a single measure. However, hallucinations exhibit diverse manifestations of uncertainty across different behavioral probes, ma

summary.core_problem: 现有LVLM幻觉检测方法依赖单一一致性指标，无法充分刻画幻觉在不同行为探针下的多样不确定性表现
summary.importance: 提出基于一致性空间结构化模式的幻觉检测框架，属于多模态幻觉分析方向的方法改进
summary.technical_approach: 从扰动模态（图像/文本）和逻辑极性（陈述/否定）两个轴构建四组互补一致性度量，提取组内和组间特征作为唯一幻觉模式，通过黑盒方式检测幻觉
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中披露具体模型、数据集及性能提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Existing black-box LVLM hallucination detection methods rely on a single consistency metric and fail to capture diverse uncertainty manifestations of hallucinations
summary_en.importance: Proposes a structured uncertainty pattern framework for hallucination detection; methodological improvement in multimodal hallucination analysis
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs four complementary consistency groups along perturbation modality (image vs. text) and logical polarity (statement vs. negation) axes, extracts within-group and cross-group features as unique hallucination patterns in a fully black-box manner
summary_en.experiments: Specific models, datasets, and performance improvements not disclosed in the abstract

recommendation.zh: LVLM幻觉检测的分析性工作，方法有一定启发性但属于多模态下游问题，对预训练研究员仅作背景了解
recommendation.en: Analytical work on LVLM hallucination detection with some methodological insight; only background reference for pretraining researchers

paper.title: DocTrace: Towards Traceable Long Document VQA via Hierarchical Evidence Graph Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long Document Visual Question Answering (LongDocVQA) requires Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to locate, integrate, and reason over heterogeneous document elements distributed across multiple pages. Existing approaches, including end-to-end MLLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and document agents, often lack explicit mechanisms to represent and verify how grounded evidence is progressively composed during reasoning, limiting both answer accuracy and traceability. In th

summary.core_problem: 现有长文档VQA方法缺乏显式的证据组合表示与验证机制，导致答案准确率低、推理过程不可追溯
summary.importance: 将长文档VQA建模为显式证据图推理问题（范式创新），同时给出可训练的分层框架与配套两阶段训练方案
summary.technical_approach: 提出DocTrace分层框架，依次执行证据定位、结构化文档解析、证据图推理，实现证据来源可追溯；采用两阶段训练：联合SFT初始化证据定位与图推理能力，第二阶段优化推理一致性
summary.experiments: 未披露具体模型规模与训练数据量，核心实验验证了显式证据图建模可同时提升长文档VQA的答案准确率与推理可追溯性

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LongDocVQA methods lack explicit mechanisms to represent and verify grounded evidence composition, leading to low answer accuracy and untraceable reasoning processes
summary_en.importance: Formulates LongDocVQA as explicit evidence graph reasoning (paradigm innovation) and proposes a trainable hierarchical framework with a matching two-stage training pipeline
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DocTrace, a hierarchical framework that sequentially performs evidence localization, structured document parsing, and evidence graph reasoning for traceable evidence provenance; uses two-stage training: joint SFT initializes evidence localization and graph reasoning, followed by consistency optimization in the second stage
summary_en.experiments: No specific model scale or training data size disclosed; core experiments validate that explicit evidence graph modeling improves both answer accuracy and reasoning traceability for LongDocVQA

recommendation.zh: 显式证据图建模的思路可用于多模态后训练的推理监督设计，仅需关注§3的训练目标定义部分
recommendation.en: Explicit evidence graph modeling can inform multi-modal post-training reasoning supervision; only check §3 for training objective definition

paper.title: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics as Rewards for Audio Reasoning
paper.abstract: Audio reasoning is essential for machine understanding of the acoustic world. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can elicit such reasoning, yet existing reward designs are complementary in their limitations: outcome-based rewards supervise only the final answer and let the model reach it without attending to the audio, whereas process-based rewards score the reasoning itself but rely on coarse, hand-crafted, and fixed criteria that neither adapt to each question nor stay grounded in

summary.core_problem: 音频推理任务中现有RL奖励设计存在局限：结果奖励只监督最终答案、过程奖励依赖静态手工标准，无法适配不同问题且随策略提升而失效。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出自适应、音频锚定的细粒度推理过程奖励框架，为多模态RL奖励设计提供新的可演化rubric思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出AudioRubrics框架，使用LLM自动为每个样本生成随训练演化、与音频证据绑定的细粒度评分rubric作为RL奖励，替代静态手工过程奖励和纯结果奖励。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中披露具体模型规模、数据集与量化提升幅度，仅说明框架覆盖感知类和多步推理类两类音频问题。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括马里兰大学、UIUC、UIC和微软研究院，作者含Philip S. Yu（数据挖掘与多模态领域资深学者）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL rewards for audio reasoning are limited: outcome rewards supervise only final answers while process rewards rely on static, hand-crafted criteria that fail to adapt across questions and degrade as policy improves.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation introducing an adaptive, audio-grounded fine-grained reward framework, providing a new evolvable-rubric direction for multimodal RL reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes AudioRubrics, which uses LLMs to automatically generate per-sample, training-evolvable, audio-evidence-bound fine-grained scoring rubrics as RL rewards, replacing both static handcrafted process rewards and pure outcome rewards.
summary_en.experiments: Model scale, datasets and quantitative gains are not disclosed in the abstract; the framework is stated to cover both perceptual and multi-step reasoning audio tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations include University of Maryland, UIUC, UIC and Microsoft Research; authors include Philip S. Yu, a senior researcher in data mining and multimodal learning.

recommendation.zh: 演化rubric作为奖励的思路可迁移到文本RL，但论文是音频垂直场景，看摘要和方法框架即可，无需深挖。
recommendation.en: The evolvable-rubric reward idea is transferable to text RL, but the work is audio-domain specific; read only abstract and method outline, no deep dive needed.

paper.title: Where did the ambiguity go? Examining how multimodal models interpret polysemous words
paper.abstract: Human language is highly polysemous. Many common words (e.g., 'bank' or 'palm') carry several distinct meanings that shape what humans communicate and imagine. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to understand this multiplicity of meaning, but much less is known about how polysemy surfaces in other modalities such as images. We study this across 17 text-to-image and 15 text-generation models by giving each a polysemous word with no context to fix its meaning and measuring which senses a

summary.core_problem: 多模态模型在处理无上下文的多义词时，文本生成与图像生成模态对词义的选择多样性存在系统性差异，且二者的义项分布与人类想象的分布差距尚未被量化，该工作对这一跨模态差距及成因进行测量分析。
summary.importance: 为多模态预训练的表示对齐研究提供了实证观测依据，揭示了多模态模型对歧义的「认知」与「生成」存在脱节，也为后续多模态预训练的词义消歧、输出分布多样性优化提供了可参考的评测范式。
summary.technical_approach: 构建100个经过人类验证的多义词测试集，每个词对应固定的候选义项集合；对17个文生图模型、15个文本生成模型，每个词采样30次独立输出，采用GPT-5.4作为裁判将输出归类到对应义项（或模糊/多义等兜底标签），计算义项分布的归一化熵等指标，并与匹配场景下收集的人类基线对比；额外做了架构类型（扩散vs自回归）、偏好调优前后的消融，以及模型自身对人类义项分布的预测能力测试。
summary.experiments: 观测到明确的跨模态差距：同模型家族内，生成图像的义项归一化熵仅为0.10，生成文本的为0.25，二者均远低于人类的多样性水平；模型被要求预测人类的义项分布时，能输出接近人类的多样性结果，远高于自身实际生成的多样性；偏好调优会进一步收窄义项分布，但对齐并非全部差距的来源；扩散架构与自回归架构的多样性表现存在差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction的问题提出与核心结论，Methodology的测试集构建与评测流程，Results的跨模态差距核心数据；附录的多义词列表可作为评测资源参考。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal models show systematic differences in sense selection diversity across text and image generation when processing polysemous words without disambiguating context, and the gap between their sense distributions and human imagined priors remains unquantified. This work measures this cross-modal gap and analyzes its drivers.
summary_en.importance: It provides empirical observations for multimodal pretraining representation alignment research, exposing a disconnect between what multimodal models know about lexical ambiguity and what they produce during generation. It also offers a reusable evaluation paradigm for future work on polysemy-aware multimodal pretraining and output diversity optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors construct a test set of 100 human-verified polysemous words, each associated with a closed inventory of candidate senses. They sample 30 independent outputs per word-model pair across 17 text-to-image models and 15 text generation models, use GPT-5.4 as a judge to assign each output to a sense (or fallback labels for unclear/multiple cases), and compute metrics including normalized entropy of sense distributions against a human baseline collected under matched framing. Additional ablations compare behavior across architecture classes (diffusion vs autoregressive) and before/after preference tuning, plus a separate test of models' own predictions of human sense distributions.
summary_en.experiments: A clear cross-modal gap is observed: within the same model family, generated images have a normalized sense entropy of 0.10, versus 0.25 for generated text, both far below human diversity levels. When asked to predict human sense distributions, models produce near-human diversity scores much higher than their own generation output. Preference tuning further narrows sense distributions, but alignment does not account for the full gap. Diffusion and autoregressive architectures show distinct diversity patterns.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction for core motivation and headline findings, the Methodology section for test set construction and evaluation protocol, and the Results section for cross-modal gap metrics. The appendix with the full polysemous word list is a useful evaluation resource. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多模态语义坍缩的定量证据干净，0.10 vs 0.25 vs 0.47 的熵对比值得看；对理解 VLM 对齐和表示坍缩有直接参考。
recommendation.en: Clean quantitative evidence of multimodal semantic collapse; the 0.10 vs 0.25 vs 0.47 entropy comparison is worth reading for VLM alignment and representation collapse insights.

paper.title: Faster but Different: Diagnosing and Controlling Content Drift in Accelerated Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Training-free acceleration makes diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) more deployable, but it may silently change generated content. We study this serving-time consistency problem on 300 real images, comparing Fast-dLLM outputs with the same model's unaccelerated outputs. Across the mild parallelism induced in our long-form setting (1.05--1.25 committed tokens per step), confidence-threshold tuning changes decoding behavior but not baseline agreement. State-refresh ablations

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散式多模态语言模型在无训练加速推理时出现“内容漂移”的问题，即加速后输出内容与同一模型未加速解码结果不一致。
summary.importance: 这项工作不是在做更高分的生成，而是在诊断 serving-time consistency。对扩散/并行解码范式来说，这比单纯报速度更关键，因为部署侧常见的 cache、并行提交和状态复用会悄悄改写生成内容。
summary.technical_approach: 作者以 Fast-dLLM 为主，比较加速版与未加速版在真实图像长文本生成上的输出一致性；通过 confidence-threshold 调参、state-refresh 消融、image-swap 干预来定位漂移来源，指出陈旧的视觉状态和已生成文本状态是主要因素。进一步提出缩短 KV-cache refresh interval，得到速度与一致性的单调折中曲线；并在 dLLM-Cache、LaViDa 上做了初步外推验证。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 300 张真实图像，关注长文本场景下较轻度并行提交（每步约 1.05–1.25 committed tokens）。结果显示：调 confidence threshold 会改变解码行为，但不能改善与原始解码的一致性；缩短 KV 刷新间隔可稳定提升 agreement，并在实测约 1.3x 加速下接近精确复现未加速输出。对 dLLM-Cache 和 LaViDa 也观察到类似诊断现象，但 dLLM-Cache 只有同时收紧两类 cache 才能恢复一致性，代价是速度优势基本消失。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京理工大学和浙江大学。不是头部实验室的大规模系统报告，但问题设定很贴近扩散式 MLLM 的真实部署。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies content drift in accelerated diffusion-based multimodal LMs, where training-free serving-time acceleration changes the generated content relative to the same model's unaccelerated decoding.
