summary_en.importance: The contribution is not about chasing higher task scores, but about serving-time consistency. For diffusion and partially parallel decoding, this matters because cache reuse and stale states can silently alter outputs even when speedups look modest.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using Fast-dLLM as the main case, the authors compare accelerated and unaccelerated generations on real-image long-form tasks. They run confidence-threshold tuning, state-refresh ablations, and image-swap interventions to localize the source of drift, identifying stale visual states and stale generated-text states as key contributors. They then shorten the KV-cache refresh interval and obtain a monotonic speed-agreement tradeoff. Similar diagnostics are also checked on dLLM-Cache and LaViDa.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses 300 real images in a long-form setting with mild parallelism, around 1.05-1.25 committed tokens per step. Confidence-threshold tuning changes decoding behavior but does not improve baseline agreement. Shorter KV refresh intervals steadily improve agreement and recover near-exact outputs at a measured 1.3x speedup. Similar drift appears in dLLM-Cache and LaViDa, while dLLM-Cache only regains agreement after tightening both caches, which largely removes its speed benefit.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Beijing Institute of Technology and Zhejiang University. This is not a frontier-lab scaling report, but the problem setup is directly relevant to real deployment of diffusion-style multimodal LMs.

recommendation.zh: 做 dLM/dMLLM serving 的人该看：它提醒你速度提升未必是“同一个模型”，先看状态刷新与 cache 失真，读消融和 speed-agreement 曲线就够了。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about diffusion-LM serving: a speedup is not necessarily the same model anymore, and the useful part is the cache/state-refresh diagnosis plus the speed-agreement frontier.

paper.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots

summary.core_problem: 发布 Gemini Robotics 2，主打面向机器人的 'whole body intelligence'，即把视觉、语言与肢体控制统一到一个模型中。
summary.importance: 顶级实验室具身智能方向的模型发布，但当前仅有公告，无技术报告。
summary.technical_approach: 未披露具体架构、训练数据或训练目标；从描述看是多模态 VLM 与机器人控制的联合建模。
summary.experiments: 无公开实验数据。
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind 官方公告，摘要缺失，信息有限。

summary_en.core_problem: Announces Gemini Robotics 2, emphasizing 'whole body intelligence' that unifies vision, language, and body control in one model.
summary_en.importance: A top-lab embodied-AI model release, but currently only an announcement with no technical report.
summary_en.technical_approach: No architecture, training data, or objective is disclosed; described as joint modeling of multimodal VLM capabilities with robot control.
summary_en.experiments: No public experimental results.
summary_en.authors_note: Official Google DeepMind announcement; abstract unavailable, so details are limited.

recommendation.zh: 只有公告没有论文，无法判断技术含量；标记关注，等技术报告再评估是否值得读。
recommendation.en: Announcement-only with no paper, so technical merit is unassessable; bookmark and revisit when the report drops.

paper.title: Seen, Said, or Forgotten? A Causal Audit of Visual KV Memory Across Dialog Turns
paper.abstract: Stateful multimodal assistants encode an image once but may answer questions about it many turns later. Attention-guided visual-KV eviction assumes that evidence irrelevant now will remain dispensable, although future questions are unknown. We ask when a visual fact is actually safe to forget and introduce the Causal Visual Memory Audit (CVMA), a paired single-prefill framework that tests what later answers lose when a visual region, the whole image, or prior assistant text becomes unavailable.

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究多轮 VLM 中的视觉 KV cache 是否可以安全丢弃。具体问题是：当前轮 attention 低的视觉区域，是否真的对未来问题无用。作者指出，attention-based visual KV eviction 隐含了一个强假设：当前不重要的视觉证据，未来也不重要。但在多轮对话里，未来问题未知，这个假设经常不成立。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对 VLM 记忆机制、长上下文多模态 serving、视觉 token 压缩有启发。它把“视觉信息是否已被模型看到、是否已被说出、是否仍保存在 KV 中”拆开分析。这个拆分很重要，因为多轮 VLM 的性能下降可能来自三种不同机制：视觉证据被错误删除、后续问题其实不依赖视觉、或者视觉事实已经迁移到 assistant text KV。对做 native multimodal LM 或视觉 token 压缩的人，论文的主要价值是提供了更干净的因果审计方法，而不是提出新的压缩策略。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Causal Visual Memory Audit，简称 CVMA。它保持单次 image prefill 的 stateful trajectory，然后在同一个对话轨迹内做 paired intervention。干预对象包括特定视觉区域、整张图像对应的 KV、以及历史 assistant text KV。技术细节上，drop 操作让对应 cache 位置不可读，但保持 cache 长度、位置索引和 RoPE index 不变，从而减少位置分布变化带来的混淆。评价指标是 reference answer 内容 token 的平均 cross-entropy。作者定义了 regional future utility，用删除某个区域后未来轮次 NLL 的上升衡量该区域未来是否有用；定义 all-image dependence，用删除整张图像后的损失衡量该对话是否仍需要视觉证据；还用 random retention 和 marginal-utility retention 控制，区分“attention 代理失效”和“选择问题本身无解”。最后，通过 image-text factorial interventions 分析 assistant 输出文本能否替代已删除的视觉 KV。
summary.experiments: 主实验使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct BF16，因果审计还测试 Idefics3-8B-Llama3，附录中有 Qwen 3B scale check。数据包括 VisDial v1.0 validation 的 2,064 个十轮对话，以及 ConvBench 的 547 个三轮长回答对话，其中 546 个可用。完整 policy comparison 用全部样本；regional audit 在排除 72 个早期 pilot/confirmation ID 后，固定随机顺序取前 200 个样本。主要发现是：当前轮 attention 对未来区域效用的排序很差，在 VisDial 上甚至可能比随机更差；但 marginal-utility control 显示仍有选择空间，说明不是任务本身无法选择，而是 attention proxy 不适合预测未来。总体分数下降有时不大，因为很多后续轮次不依赖视觉，甚至可能因删除噪声视觉 KV 而改善。更细的 fact-level 分析显示，assistant text KV 可以替代那些已经被明确说出的视觉事实；没有说出的隐藏视觉事实是否保留，取决于模型和上下文，不稳定，也不一定能支持正确回答。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 CVMA 的 causal estimands 和 intervention 设计，尤其是如何在不改变 cache 几何结构的情况下删除视觉证据。实验部分优先看 attention ranking 与 future regional utility 的对比、all-image dependence 分桶结果、以及 image-text factorial intervention。若关注推理效率或 VLM serving，可以重点读 policy regret 和 retention budget 相关图表；若关注多模态预训练，可以关注视觉事实何时迁移到文本 KV，这对理解跨模态记忆边界更有用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when visual KV entries in a stateful multimodal assistant can be safely forgotten. The concrete question is whether visual regions that receive low attention in the current turn are truly irrelevant for future turns. The paper argues that attention-guided visual KV eviction makes a strong assumption: evidence that is not useful now will remain unnecessary later, even though future user questions are unknown.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for VLM memory analysis, multimodal long-context serving, and visual token compression. Its main contribution is to separate three mechanisms that aggregate scores usually mix together: the model may have seen a fact, the assistant may have verbalized it into text, or the visual KV that carried it may still be available. That distinction matters for native multimodal models because a small average loss after KV eviction can hide failures on visually dependent future turns.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the Causal Visual Memory Audit, or CVMA. It keeps a single stateful trajectory in which the image is prefetched once, then applies paired interventions within the same dialog. The interventions remove access to a visual region, the entire image span, or prior assistant text KV. The drop operation preserves cache length, positions, and RoPE indices, so the intervention targets availability of evidence rather than sequence geometry. The outcome is the mean cross-entropy on reference answer content tokens. Regional future utility is measured by the loss increase after removing a region over later turns. All-image dependence measures whether the future dialog needs visual KV at all. Random and marginal-utility retention controls test whether attention is a bad proxy or whether selection is intrinsically difficult. Image–text factorial interventions then test when assistant text can replace missing visual evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct in BF16. The causal audit also includes Idefics3-8B-Llama3, with a Qwen 3B scale check in the appendix. The datasets are VisDial v1.0 validation with 2,064 ten-turn dialogs and ConvBench with 547 three-turn long-form dialogs, 546 of which are usable after excluding one degenerate reference. Full policy comparisons use all available dialogs. The regional audit removes 72 earlier pilot or confirmation IDs, shuffles the remaining set with a fixed seed, and freezes the first 200 examples. The main empirical result is that current attention can rank future-useful regions poorly, and on VisDial joint retention can be worse than random. A marginal-utility control shows that useful selection is still possible, so the issue is the proxy rather than the absence of signal. Aggregate degradation can look modest because many later turns do not require vision, and some low-dependence cases benefit from denoising. At the fact level, assistant text KV can substitute for visual KV when the fact has been stated, while unstated visual facts are not reliably recoverable.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the CVMA definitions, the intervention invariants, and the comparison between current attention and future regional utility. The most useful results are the dependence-conditioned analyses, the retention-budget regret plots, and the image–text factorial interventions. For serving and compression work, the key lesson is that low current attention is not enough evidence for irreversible visual KV deletion. For multimodal pretraining research, the useful part is the analysis of when visual facts move into text memory and when they remain dependent on image KV.

recommendation.zh: 做过多模态 KV-cache 压缩的人该看：它直接打脸"按当前注意力分数驱逐"的默认假设，只看 §3 的 CVMA 设计和 Fig 中 random vs attention 对比即可。
recommendation.en: If you work on multimodal KV-cache compression, this directly challenges the default attention-score eviction heuristic; read §3 and the random-vs-attention comparison, skip the rest.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

paper.title: LENS: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Zooming for Keyframe Sampling in Long-Form Videos
paper.abstract: Despite rapid progress in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs), understanding long-form videos is still bottlenecked by limited context windows. While recent keyframe sampling methods attempt to mitigate this by distilling video inputs into a compact set of query-relevant frames, navigating the vast spatio-temporal search space remains challenging, as spatial detail and temporal coverage often conflict. To address this, we introduce LENS, a training-free keyframe sampling framework that dyn

summary.core_problem: 长视频理解中关键帧采样存在空间细节与时间覆盖难以兼顾、时空搜索空间过大的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无需训练的自适应时空缩放关键帧采样框架，为长视频多模态推理的输入压缩提供新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出LENS框架，根据文本查询动态分配有限帧预算：对单帧内查询相关区域做空间放大以保留细粒度细节，对时间维度做多帧聚合实现时间范围扩展，兼顾多粒度推理需求。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中披露具体模型规模、数据集及量化对比结果，仅说明覆盖多种长视频理解场景。
summary.authors_note: Carnegie Mellon University Robotics Institute，作者含Katia Sycara（多智能体与机器人领域知名学者）。

summary_en.core_problem: Keyframe sampling for long-form video understanding faces a tradeoff between spatial detail and temporal coverage, leading to an intractable spatio-temporal search space.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: a training-free adaptive spatio-temporal zooming framework that offers a new input compression strategy for long-video multimodal reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: LENS adaptively allocates a limited frame budget between spatial zoom-ins on query-relevant regions within individual frames and temporal zoom-outs via multi-frame aggregation, enabling multi-granularity reasoning conditioned on the text query.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not specify model scale, datasets, or quantitative baselines; only states coverage across multiple long-video understanding scenarios.
summary_en.authors_note: Robotics Institute, Carnegie Mellon University; includes Katia Sycara, a well-known researcher in multi-agent systems and robotics.

recommendation.zh: 作为长视频多模态输入压缩的弱信号参考，仅看方法部分的时空预算分配策略即可，无训练动态或预训练相关insight。
recommendation.en: Weak signal reference for long-video multimodal input compression; only read the method section for spatio-temporal budget allocation, no pretraining-relevant insight.

paper.title: MAViE: A Multi-scale Adaptive Vision Encoder for Fine-grained Visual Perception and Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models commonly project all tokens produced by a pretrained vision encoder into a large language model. However, final-layer features can discard text, local attributes, and spatial relationships, while high-resolution inputs substantially increase context length and inference latency. We introduce \method, a Multi-scale Adaptive Vision Encoder. \method uses position-dependent gates to fuse shallow, intermediate, and deep features from a vision Transformer, preserving global sema

summary.core_problem: VLM中仅用视觉编码器最后层特征会丢失局部细节与空间关系，高分辨率输入又会导致上下文过长、推理延迟高的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出多尺度自适应视觉编码器，兼顾视觉特征质量与token效率
summary.technical_approach: 用位置相关门控融合ViT浅、中、深层特征，保留全局语义同时增强边缘、文本、局部结构；设计问题条件的token路由机制，按问题相关性、局部信息量、全局语义、空间覆盖度筛选token，预算随图像复杂度自适应；补充全到压缩表示的蒸馏与空间多样性正则缓解压缩损失
summary.experiments: 在统一7B语言模型框架的模拟实验中，平均视觉token数量显著降低，同时保留细粒度视觉推理性能（原文摘要截断，具体量化指标未完整披露）

summary_en.core_problem: Address the problem that VLMs lose local details and spatial relationships when using only final-layer vision encoder features, while high-resolution inputs cause excessive context length and inference latency
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a multi-scale adaptive vision encoder that balances feature quality and token efficiency
summary_en.technical_approach: Fuse shallow, intermediate, and deep ViT features via position-dependent gates to preserve global semantics while enhancing edges, text, and local structure; design question-conditioned token routing to select tokens based on relevance, local information content, global semantics, and spatial coverage, with a token budget adaptive to image complexity; add full-to-compressed representation distillation and spatial diversity regularization to mitigate compression loss
summary_en.experiments: Simulation experiments under a unified 7B LLM framework show significant reduction in average visual token count while preserving fine-grained visual reasoning performance (abstract truncated, full quantitative metrics not disclosed)

recommendation.zh: VLM视觉token压缩的增量改进，仅对做多模态基座视觉编码器选型的研究员有参考，看方法部分的门控与路由设计即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement for VLM visual token compression, only relevant for researchers working on multimodal foundation vision encoder selection, focus on the gating and routing design in the method section

paper.title: RP-OPSD: Resolution-Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) uses privileged information available only to the teacher to provide dense token-level supervision on trajectories generated by the student. However, existing methods often rely on verified solution traces, explanations generated by external models, or manually localized visual evidence, which limits their scalable application to multimodal large language models. To address this issue, we exploit the information gap between high- and low-resolution views of the

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型的在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）依赖外部验证解轨迹、外部模型解释或人工标注的视觉证据，难以规模化应用
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无需外部特权信息的自蒸馏方案，降低MLLM自蒸馏的标注成本
summary.technical_approach: 提出RP-OPSD，利用同一样本高低分辨率视图的信息差构造特权信息：训练时学生用1/4分辨率图像生成在策略轨迹，教师用原分辨率图像提供监督，最小化学生轨迹上两者输出分布的散度，让学生学习教师的高分辨率预测行为
summary.experiments: 原文摘要截断，未完整披露实验所用的MLLM规模、数据集及具体性能提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Address the scalability issue of existing On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) for MLLMs, which relies on external verified solution traces, model-generated explanations, or manually localized visual evidence as privileged information
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a self-distillation scheme without external privileged information, reducing the annotation cost of MLLM self-distillation
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose RP-OPSD, which exploits the information gap between high- and low-resolution views of the same image as privileged information: during training, the student generates on-policy trajectories from 1/4 resolution images, while the teacher provides supervision using original-resolution images; the divergence between their output distributions along student trajectories is minimized to transfer the teacher's high-resolution predictive behavior
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated, full details of MLLM scale, datasets, and quantitative performance improvements are not disclosed

recommendation.zh: MLLM自蒸馏的低成本方案，仅对做多模态对齐训练策略 ablation 的研究员有参考，看方法的特权信息设计即可
recommendation.en: Low-cost self-distillation scheme for MLLMs, only relevant for researchers doing ablation on multimodal alignment training strategies, focus on the privileged information design in the method section

paper.title: Show, Don't Tell: Evaluating Spatial Cognition in Generative Pixels Rather Than LLM Text
paper.abstract: Spatial intelligence is essential for agents to move from static semantic understanding toward interacting with the physical world. Many spatial tasks are grounded in continuous visual scenes, where locations, regions, and paths are more naturally expressed by pointing, marking, or drawing than by reporting precise coordinates or discrete textual symbols. Yet existing spatial reasoning benchmarks usually require coordinates, options, or text, creating an answer-interface mismatch for image-gener

summary.core_problem: 现有空间推理评测几乎都假设模型用“文本/坐标/选项”作答，导致对图像生成模型（以像素为原生输出）的空间能力评测出现严重的 answer-interface mismatch：模型可能能“画出来/标出来”，但基准无法用原任务指标计分，也难以与文本输出 VLM 在同一语义任务下可控对比。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对“统一多模态生成范式（AR+diffusion/原生图像生成）如何被公平评测”有现实影响：如果评测接口不匹配，训练信号与模型选择会系统性偏向文本输出范式，间接影响多模态预训练路线的目标设计与数据构造。更具体的启发在于：把生成式模型的输出约束为可解析协议（protocolized output），用解析器回到结构化指标空间，能减少对 VLM-judge 的依赖与不确定性。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 ProVisE（Protocolized Visual Evaluation）框架：
1) 以“视觉协议”替代文本/坐标答案接口：要求图像生成模型在输出图像中以预定义格式表达答案（例如用特定颜色/形状标注区域、画路径、指向目标等），使输出天然落在像素空间但满足可解析约束。
2) 解析器把协议化图像输出转换为结构化预测（如 bbox/mask/路径点/方向标签等），从而复用原空间任务的标准指标，实现与文本输出 VLM 的 metric-compatible 对比。
3) 讨论手工为每个任务设计协议不可扩展，因此提供“Agentic construction path”：用代理式流程自动构造/选择协议与解析步骤（全文在引言处点到，细节需看方法章节）。
与常见替代方案的差异：
- 不走“VLM judge 读图给答案”的路线，避免把评测误差与 judge 能力耦合；
- 不把任务改写成文本多选/坐标回归，而是让生成模型用其擅长的像素表达，同时仍回到原任务指标。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文片段主要是问题定义与框架动机，尚未包含可复述的关键数字、模型清单、协议类型覆盖范围、解析鲁棒性统计、以及与 judge-based 评测的一致性/方差对比等结果细节。若论文后续章节提供：
- 不同协议在同一任务上的可解析率（parse success rate）与指标方差；
- 生成模型与文本 VLM 在同一任务语义下的可比性实验；
- 解析器误差对最终分数的敏感性分析；
这些会是判断其工程可落地性的关键证据。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 重点看 Figure 1（interface mismatch 的具体例子）以及方法章节对“协议约束 + 解析回结构化指标”的定义：协议如何设计、允许哪些自由度、如何防止模型钻协议空子。
- 优先找两类实验：①与 VLM-judge 方案的对照（相关性、方差、失败模式）；②跨任务/跨协议的可扩展性（是否每个任务都要重写大量规则）。
- 如果关心对预训练的启发，重点看作者是否讨论“把协议化输出作为训练目标/中间监督”的可能性，以及它与 unified multimodal generation（如 AR+diffusion）训练接口的关系。

summary_en.core_problem: Spatial reasoning benchmarks typically force answers into text, coordinates, or discrete options. This creates a severe answer-interface mismatch for image generation models whose native output is pixels: they may be able to externalize spatial judgments by drawing/marking, but the benchmark cannot score those outputs with the original task metrics, making controlled comparison with text-output VLMs unreliable.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on pretraining recipes, but it matters for how multimodal generative paradigms (native image generators, AR+diffusion unified models) are evaluated and therefore selected and optimized. The key idea—constraining generative outputs into a parseable protocol and mapping them back to structured predictions—reduces dependence on VLM-as-a-judge and can make evaluation signals less model-dependent and less noisy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ProVisE (Protocolized Visual Evaluation) proposes:
1) Protocol-constrained visual answers: the generator must express the answer in a predefined visual format (e.g., specific markers, highlights, trajectories) rather than text/coordinates.
2) A task-specific parser converts the generated image into structured outputs compatible with the benchmark’s original metrics (bbox/mask/path/labels), enabling metric-compatible evaluation.
3) Since hand-crafting protocols per task does not scale, an agentic construction pipeline is introduced to help build protocols/parsers (the provided excerpt signals this; details should be in the methods section).
Compared to common workarounds:
- It avoids judge-based scoring where a separate VLM interprets the generated image, which entangles evaluation with judge reliability.
- It avoids rewriting tasks into unnatural symbolic interfaces that disadvantage pixel-native models.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full-text excerpt is largely motivation and framing; it does not include reproducible quantitative results (models, datasets, protocol coverage, parse success rates, robustness, or correlations vs judge-based evaluation). The most decision-critical evidence to look for in later sections is:
- Parse success rate and failure modes across protocols/tasks.
- Agreement/variance comparisons against VLM-judge baselines.
- Sensitivity of final scores to parser errors and protocol degrees of freedom.
- Cross-task scalability showing how much manual engineering is still required.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with Figure 1 to internalize the interface mismatch.
- Read the method section defining the protocol format and the parsing pipeline; check how they prevent loopholes and ensure unambiguous decoding.
- Jump to experiments that compare (a) protocol+parser scoring vs VLM-judge scoring, and (b) scalability across multiple spatial task types.
- If you care about pretraining implications, look for discussion on using protocolized visual outputs as training targets or intermediate supervision for unified multimodal generators.

recommendation.zh: 只看协议化像素答案解析；它可能影响统一生成模型的空间评测接口。
recommendation.en: Skim the protocol-constrained pixel parsing; it may matter for evaluating spatial reasoning in unified generative models.

paper.title: SiGMA: Sign-Guided Merging and Adaptation for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
paper.abstract: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) is crucial for adapting Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to evolving a sequence of downstream tasks. Prior methods mostly utilize Mixture of Experts or expansion merge approach, primarily focusing on catastrophic forgetting, yet they still suffer from negative interference during inference, where newly learned updates overwrite useful prior knowledge and degrade overall performance. To address this, we propose SiGMA (Sign Guided Merging and

summary.core_problem: 多模态持续指令调优中，新任务更新会覆盖旧知识，导致推理时负向干扰和灾难性遗忘。
summary.importance: 持续学习方向的方法改进，提出基于参数符号的调优与合并策略。
summary.technical_approach: SiGMA 包含两部分：训练时用符号引导的自适应调优减少与旧知识的参数冲突，推理时用符号引导的合并选择性放缩显著参数以保留任务特有知识。
summary.experiments: 在 UCIT 基准上测试，与 MoE 和 expansion merge 类方法对比，声明在遗忘和整体性能上更优，具体模型规模和提升幅度未在摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal continual instruction tuning suffers from negative interference at inference, where new task updates overwrite previously learned knowledge and cause catastrophic forgetting.
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement in continual learning; proposes a sign-guided parameter tuning and merging strategy.
summary_en.technical_approach: SiGMA has two components: sign-guided adaptive tuning during training to reduce parameter collisions with past knowledge, and sign-guided merging at inference to selectively scale salient parameters and preserve task-specific knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the UCIT benchmark against MoE and expansion merge baselines; claims better forgetting resistance and overall performance, with model scale and exact gains not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 持续指令调优的增量工作，参数符号引导思路与 TIES-Merging 同源，对预训练无直接价值，作为文献备查。
recommendation.en: Incremental continual instruction tuning work; sign-guided merging is related to TIES-Merging and has limited direct value for pretraining; keep as literature reference.

paper.title: ChronoStitch: Training-Free Composition of Visual KV Memories for Long-Horizon Temporal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long-video question answering requires a model to preserve visual evidence over time without repeatedly reprocessing the same video. A practical approach is to store the vision-language model's internal key-value (KV) cache for each video chunk and retrieve that state at query time. However, independently cached video chunks do not compose correctly: every chunk is prefilled from local rotary position zero, so naive concatenation collides temporal phases and removes the global order required for

summary.core_problem: 长视频 VLM 中，将视频分块独立预填充得到的 KV cache 直接拼接会导致多模态 RoPE 的时空位置冲突，无法支持跨块时序推理。
summary.importance: 指出多模态 RoPE（尤其是时空联合坐标）下 naive KV 拼接的几何不一致问题，给出训练无关的修复方案，对长视频/长上下文 KV cache 复用有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: ChronoStitch 在 post-rotary key 空间将各 chunk 的 KV 重映射到统一的全局三轴（time/height/width）RoPE 坐标系，而不是做一维标量 re-index；分析了一维 re-index 在视觉 token 上破坏空间结构的原因。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未给出完整模型与数据集规模，核心验证点是重基后跨 chunk 时序问题（先后、计数、变化）在不重训前提下恢复全局顺序。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-video VLMs, naively concatenating independently prefilled KV caches across video chunks causes multimodal RoPE phase collisions across time and space, breaking cross-chunk temporal reasoning.
summary_en.importance: It identifies a geometric inconsistency of naive KV stitching under joint spatio-temporal multimodal RoPE and proposes a training-free fix, relevant to long-context KV reuse for video LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: ChronoStitch re-bases stored post-rotary keys onto a unified global three-axis RoPE coordinate system (time, height, width), showing why 1D scalar re-indexing is geometrically inconsistent for visual tokens and scrambles spatial order.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify exact model sizes and datasets; the stated claim is that re-basing recovers global ordering across chunks without retraining, enabling questions about event order, frequency, and change.

recommendation.zh: 训练无关的 KV stitching 思路实用，但分析只在多模态 RoPE 几何层面，建议只看 §3 的坐标系重基推导，正文实验当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Useful as a training-free KV stitching trick, but the analysis stays at multimodal RoPE geometry; read §3 for the re-basing argument and treat experiments as a weak signal.

paper.title: VQ-Transplant: Efficient VQ-Module Integration for Pre-trained Visual Tokenizers
paper.abstract: Vector Quantization (VQ) underpins modern discrete visual tokenization. However, training quantization modules for state-of-the-art VQ-based models requires significant computational resources which, in practice, all but prevents the development of novel, cutting-edge VQ techniques under resource constraints. To address this limitation, we propose {\bf VQ-Transplant}, a simple framework that enables plug-and-play integration of new VQ modules into frozen, pre-trained tokenizers by replacing thei

summary.core_problem: 离散视觉 tokenizer 的 VQ 模块训练成本高，换一种量化方法通常需要端到端重训 encoder-decoder，限制了 VQ 设计迭代。
summary.importance: 提出在冻结预训练 tokenizer 上“移植”新 VQ 模块的低成本框架，对做离散视觉 tokenizer、统一多模态 token 研究的人有工程参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: VQ-Transplant 保留冻结的 encoder-decoder，仅替换原生 VQ 模块；为缓解 decoder 与新量化空间的失配，用 ImageNet-1k 上仅 5 epoch 的轻量 decoder 适配对齐特征先验。
summary.experiments: 在 ImageNet-1k 上做重建评估，论文声称移植后可接近现有 SOTA 重建质量，避免端到端重训成本；摘要未给出具体 baseline 名称和数值差距。
summary.authors_note: Tim G. J. Rudner 为共同作者，近期工作涉及 tokenization / discrete representation 方向。

summary_en.core_problem: Training VQ modules for modern discrete visual tokenizers is expensive, so swapping in a new quantization method usually requires end-to-end retraining of the encoder-decoder, slowing VQ research iteration.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a low-cost framework to transplant new VQ modules into frozen pretrained tokenizers, which is practically relevant for researchers working on discrete visual tokenizers and unified multimodal tokens.
summary_en.technical_approach: VQ-Transplant keeps the encoder and decoder frozen and only replaces the native VQ module; a lightweight decoder adaptation, trained for just 5 epochs on ImageNet-1k, aligns feature priors with the new quantization space to reduce decoder-quantizer mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: Reconstruction is evaluated on ImageNet-1k; the abstract claims near state-of-the-art reconstruction after transplantation without full end-to-end retraining, though exact baseline names and gaps are not specified in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Tim G. J. Rudner is a co-author, known for recent work on tokenization and discrete representations.

recommendation.zh: 对做离散视觉 tokenizer 的人是实用工程 trick：冻结 encoder-decoder 换 VQ head，别期待范式变化，只看 §3 和 reconstruction 表即可。
recommendation.en: A practical engineering trick for discrete visual tokenizer work—swap VQ heads while freezing encoder-decoder; do not expect a paradigm shift, just read §3 and the reconstruction table.

paper.title: Introducing Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber
paper.abstract: We’re introducing new Gemini models, including Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite and 3.5 Flash Cyber.

summary.core_problem: 发布三款新的 Gemini 系列轻量/专用模型产品线。
summary.importance: 产品发布公告，披露新模型家族定位，无技术细节与训练方法披露。
summary.technical_approach: 无公开技术方案，仅说明模型定位：Gemini 3.6 Flash 为新一代通用轻量模型，3.5 Flash-Lite 为更低成本版本，3.5 Flash Cyber 为网络安全专用模型。
summary.experiments: 无参数量、训练数据、基准测试等技术指标披露。
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind 官方产品发布博客。

summary_en.core_problem: Announces three new lightweight/specialized models in the Gemini product line.
summary_en.importance: Product release announcement disclosing the positioning of a new model family; no technical or training details disclosed.
summary_en.technical_approach: No public technical design; only positioning: Gemini 3.6 Flash as next-gen general lightweight model, 3.5 Flash-Lite as lower-cost variant, 3.5 Flash Cyber as cybersecurity-specialized model.
summary_en.experiments: No disclosure of parameter count, training data, benchmark results or other technical metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: Official product release blog from Google DeepMind.

recommendation.zh: 纯产品发布，无任何预训练相关技术细节，仅需关注产品线定位信号，不值得读正文。
recommendation.en: Pure product release with no pretraining-relevant technical details; only product-line positioning signal matters, no need to read the post.

paper.title: OrientSAM: Mitigating Camera-Centric Shortcut in Multimodal Spatial Reasoning via Orientation-Aware Spatial Alignment
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still struggle with spatial reasoning that requires perspective transformation. In particular, they often rely on camera-centric cues rather than reasoning from the reference object's viewpoint, leading to systematic errors in non-camera reference settings. In this paper, we first analyze this failure mode and show that object orientation is a key factor underlying such camera-centric shortcut behavior. To address this issue, we propose OrientSAM, an orie

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型在空间推理任务中依赖相机视角的捷径线索，而非从参考物体视角进行推理，导致非相机参考设置下出现系统性错误。
summary.importance: 方法创新与数据贡献：首次系统分析相机中心捷径的失效模式，提出方向感知的空间对齐框架，并构建大规模方向感知空间监督数据生成管线。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OrientSAM，通过方向感知token与傅里叶角度编码将显式朝向信息注入多模态表示，同时采用课程学习逐步提升视角感知推理能力；配套空间数据构造管线从大规模图像生成方向感知监督。
summary.experiments: 在Spatial-MM、ViewSpatial、3DS等空间推理基准上验证方法有效性，对比基线模型在非相机参考视角任务上的错误率下降与推理准确率提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal LLMs rely on camera-centric shortcut cues during spatial reasoning instead of reasoning from the reference object's perspective, causing systematic failures under non-camera reference settings.
summary_en.importance: Methodological and data contribution: it first systematically analyzes the camera-centric shortcut failure mode, proposes an orientation-aware spatial alignment framework, and builds a pipeline to generate large-scale orientation-aware spatial supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: OrientSAM injects explicit orientation information into multimodal representations via orientation-aware tokens and Fourier-based angle encoding, adopts curriculum learning to progressively improve perspective-aware reasoning, and uses a spatial data pipeline to generate orientation supervision from large-scale images.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Spatial-MM, ViewSpatial and 3DS benchmarks, demonstrating reduced error rates and improved accuracy on non-camera perspective spatial reasoning tasks compared with baseline models (specific metrics not fully provided in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 属于VLM空间推理的细分改进，对预训练研究员仅作弱信号参考，关注其方向编码设计即可，无需深入正文。
recommendation.en: A niche improvement for VLM spatial reasoning; only the orientation encoding design is worth noting as a weak signal, no need to read the full paper.

paper.title: Modularized Dynamic-Granularity Video LLM for Multi-Event Long Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) have made significant advancements in various video understanding tasks. However, long-video scenarios remain challenging due to the tension between limited visual token budgets and the need to capture multiple key events. Existing approaches typically process long videos in two stages, i.e., i) select keyframes and ii) perform detailed perception, which exhibit limitations: they lack a modular mechanism for adaptive capacity allocation and self-correctio

summary.core_problem: 长视频理解中视觉token预算有限与多事件捕捉需求存在矛盾，现有两阶段关键帧+感知方法缺乏自适应容量分配与自校正机制
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出模块化动态粒度长视频VLM框架，将时序定位与语义理解形成迭代自反射闭环
summary.technical_approach: 设计MoD-VLLM框架，包含正负视频段定位模块与模块化动态粒度反射模块，通过迭代逐步定位问题相关视频片段，自适应分配感知粒度
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验设置与量化结果，仅针对多事件长视频理解任务设计方案
summary.authors_note: 清华大学朱文武团队，团队在多媒体与多模态学习领域有长期积累

summary_en.core_problem: Long video understanding faces a tension between limited visual token budgets and the need to capture multiple key events, while existing two-stage keyframe + perception methods lack adaptive capacity allocation and self-correction mechanisms
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a modular dynamic-granularity video LLM framework is proposed, forming an iterative self-reflective closed loop between temporal grounding and semantic understanding
summary_en.technical_approach: The MoD-VLLM framework includes a Positive-Negative Video Segments Grounding module and a Modularized Dynamic-Granularity Reflection module, which iteratively localize question-related video segments and adaptively allocate perception granularity
summary_en.experiments: Experimental setup and quantitative results are not fully disclosed in the abstract; the method is designed for multi-event long video understanding tasks
summary_en.authors_note: Wenwu Zhu's group at Tsinghua University, with long-term accumulation in multimedia and multimodal learning

recommendation.zh: 长视频动态粒度token分配思路可参考，仅看方法部分的模块设计即可，实验披露不完整
recommendation.en: The dynamic granularity token allocation idea for long videos is worth noting; only read the method section for module design, as experiments are incompletely disclosed

paper.title: DiMaS: Distribution Matching for Steering Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Flow-matching-based vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as powerful policies for robotic manipulation, yet a critical capability remains underexplored: fine-grained behavioral control, the ability to govern how a robot performs a task by intervening on its internal representations. Representation steering is a well-established interpretability tool for language and vision-language models, where behavioral features are typically encoded as linear directions, but we show that these cl

summary.core_problem: DiMaS 研究的是 flow-matching VLA 的表示干预：当机器人策略由 VLM backbone 条件化一个连续动作生成器时，传统 LLM/VLM 中常用的线性 steering direction 难以稳定控制轨迹属性，论文尝试用分布匹配来控制动作速度、轨迹高度等连续行为特征。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不是基座预训练主线，但对两类问题有参考价值。第一，flow matching 不只用于图像或语音生成，也正在进入 action modeling；它的中间表示和离散 token LM 的 residual stream 不同。第二，representation steering 在连续控制模型中不能直接照搬线性方向假设，行为特征更像分布形状的变化，而不是单个向量偏移。对预训练研究员来说，启发点在于理解 VLM 表示如何条件化下游生成专家，以及当生成目标从 token 变成连续轨迹时，内部表征可控性的假设会发生变化。
summary.technical_approach: DiMaS 假设 VLA 由两部分组成：VLM backbone fV 处理图像、文本指令和状态信息，flow-matching action expert fA 从高斯噪声动作 a0 出发，经过 M 个 denoising/flow steps 迭代得到动作 chunk。论文不主要干预 VLM 的语言残差流，而是从 action expert 的 residual stream 取表示，表示带有 layer、token/robot-time-step、flow step 三个索引。方法将这些表示与一个连续行为特征配对，然后学习从一种行为分布到另一种行为分布的表示映射。核心差异在于，它不是加一个固定 steering vector，而是用 optimal-transport 风格的 distribution matching，让干预后的内部表示更接近目标行为条件下的表示分布。这样做是为了避免线性 shift 破坏任务成功率，也减少必须在执行中暂停干预的需求。
summary.experiments: 论文在 SmolVLA 和 π0.5 两类 flow-matching VLA 上验证，覆盖多个行为 steering 任务，并专门考察校准任务与测试任务越来越不相似时，控制效果如何衰减。主要结论是：固定线性方向在 VLA action expert 中不够稳定，容易带来任务成功率下降；DiMaS 在不暂停干预的情况下更能保持任务执行，同时改变目标轨迹属性。实验设计还包含表示结构分析，用来解释为什么 LLM/VLM 中常见的 linear representation hypothesis 在 visuomotor action expert 上不够合适。给出的文本没有足够信息确认具体百分比提升或每个任务的数值结果，因此不应把它当成已经具备通用机器人策略改写能力的证据。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15 到 25 分钟。先看第 3 节方法，重点看公式 1 中 flow-matching action expert 的动作迭代形式，以及 DiMaS 选择干预 action expert residual stream 而不是只改 VLM backbone 的原因。再看与 linear steering 的对比实验和任务迁移设置，关注校准任务与测试任务分布差异增大时的曲线。表示结构分析部分比机器人任务指标更有泛化价值，因为它说明连续动作生成模型的概念控制为什么不能简单复用 LLM 的线性方向工具。

summary_en.core_problem: DiMaS studies representation-level steering for flow-matching vision-language-action models. In these models, a VLM backbone conditions a continuous action expert, so output control is not the same as steering discrete token generation in an LLM. The paper asks how to control behavioral trajectory attributes, such as speed or height, without breaking task execution.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to multimodal model researchers who care about unified generative modeling and flow-based action heads. The useful lesson is that linear steering assumptions from LLMs and VLMs do not transfer cleanly to continuous visuomotor generators. In a flow-matching action expert, a behavioral feature may correspond to a change in the representation distribution across layers, robot time steps, and denoising steps, rather than a single additive direction. This matters for any attempt to attach continuous generative experts to pretrained multimodal backbones.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model abstraction has two components: a VLM backbone fV that encodes image, language instruction, and proprioceptive state, and an action expert fA trained with a flow-matching objective. The action expert starts from Gaussian action noise and iteratively updates the action representation over M flow steps. DiMaS sources residual-stream representations from the action expert, indexed by layer, token or robot time step, and flow step, then pairs them with a scalar behavioral feature. Instead of learning one fixed steering vector, it learns a distribution-matching intervention, motivated by optimal transport, that maps internal representations toward the distribution associated with the desired behavior. The design is meant to preserve task success while steering continuously, avoiding the pause-and-resume intervention pattern required by some linear methods.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on SmolVLA and π0.5 across several steering tasks. It also varies the gap between calibration tasks and evaluation tasks to measure how far behavioral control transfers. The reported qualitative conclusion is that classical linear steering is brittle in the action expert: it can control a feature in narrow settings but tends to harm task success or weaken under task shift. DiMaS is presented as more stable because it matches representation distributions rather than applying a constant offset. The supplied text does not provide enough numerical detail to report exact success-rate changes or per-task gains, so the evidence should be read as a method and representation-analysis result rather than a broad robotics deployment result.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15 to 25 minutes. Focus first on the method section, especially the flow-matching action update and the choice of intervention site inside the action expert. Then read the comparisons against linear steering and the task-transfer experiments. The most useful part for an LLM or multimodal pretraining researcher is the representation analysis explaining why a linear residual-stream direction is a weak model of behavioral control in continuous action generators.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和迁移实验：线性 steering 在 VLA 上失效这一点，比机器人结果本身更值得记住。
recommendation.en: Read the method and transfer experiments: the failure of linear steering in VLAs is more useful than the robotics numbers themselves.

paper.title: FormalAnalyticGeo: A Neural-Symbolic Based Framework for Multimodal Analytic Geometry Problem Generation
paper.abstract: Math reasoning has achieved significant progress with the rapid advancement of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), however analytic geometry remains largely underexplored, primarily due to the scarcity of annotated samples. Existing diagram generation approaches struggle with analytic geometry: template methods cannot handle constraint-driven layouts, and generative models lack the geometric precision to render annotated conic curves correctly. We present FormalAnalyticGeo, a scalable fram

summary.core_problem: 多模态解析几何题数据稀缺，现有图表生成方法无法同时满足约束驱动布局和几何精度要求。
summary.importance: 提出了一个可扩展的多模态数学题生成框架，属于数据合成类工具工作。
summary.technical_approach: FormalAnalyticGeo框架围绕形式化中间表示CDL构建，通过有符号距离场(SDF)引擎实现精确图表渲染，串联四个专用LLM组件（生成器、形式化器等）完成全自动题目生成。
summary.experiments: 验证了框架在解析几何题目生成上的多样性和几何精度，未做大规模模型训练评测。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal analytic geometry problem data is scarce; existing diagram generation methods fail at both constraint-driven layout and geometric precision.
summary_en.importance: A scalable multimodal math problem generation framework, categorized as a data synthesis tooling work.
summary_en.technical_approach: FormalAnalyticGeo is built around CDL, a formal intermediate representation bridging problem text and precise diagram rendering via a Signed Distance Field engine, with four sequential specialized LLM components.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on diversity and geometric precision of generated analytic geometry problems; no large-scale model training evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 形式化+SDF生成多模态数学题的思路有参考性，但属于小领域数据合成工具，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The formal-language-plus-SDF approach for multimodal math problem generation is interesting, but it is a niche data synthesis tool; read the abstract only.

paper.title: Audio-Native Speech Recognition with a Frozen Discrete-Diffusion Language Model
paper.abstract: Automatic speech recognition is dominated by autoregressive decoders that emit one token at a time. We ask whether a discrete diffusion language model can transcribe speech instead, refining a whole transcript in parallel over a small number of denoising steps. We train an audio-native interface for DiffusionGemma, a 26B mixture-of-experts model that generates text by uniform, random-token discrete diffusion rather than the absorbing-mask scheme common to recent diffusion language models. A froz

summary.core_problem: 现有语音识别以自回归解码器为主，探索离散扩散语言模型能否通过少量去噪步骤并行生成完整转录文本。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将26B参数的离散扩散MoE语言模型用于语音识别，仅训练0.16%的参数即可适配语音模态，发现并解决了扩散LM跨模态接地的梯度传递问题。
summary.technical_approach: 采用冻结的Whisper编码器提取声学特征，轻量投影层映射到DiffusionGemma（26B MoE，均匀随机令牌离散扩散范式）的嵌入空间，通过LoRA让冻结主干关注新模态；针对原生扩散目标梯度无法有效到达投影层的问题，引入CTC损失通过冻结主干传递梯度。
summary.experiments: 主干为DiffusionGemma 26B MoE，冻结Whisper编码器，仅训练42M参数（占主干的0.16%）；摘要内容截断，未完整展示最终识别精度与基线对比结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Current speech recognition relies heavily on autoregressive decoders; this work explores whether discrete diffusion language models can generate full transcripts in parallel via a small number of denoising steps.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first application of a 26B parameter discrete diffusion MoE LM to speech recognition, adapting to audio with only 0.16% of parameters trained, and identifying plus solving a gradient propagation issue in diffusion LM cross-modal grounding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses a frozen Whisper encoder for acoustic feature extraction, a lightweight projector maps features to the embedding space of DiffusionGemma (26B MoE, uniform random-token discrete diffusion paradigm), with LoRA to let the frozen backbone attend to the new modality; introduces CTC loss through the frozen backbone to address the failure of native diffusion objectives to deliver gradients to the projector.
summary_en.experiments: Backbone is DiffusionGemma 26B MoE, Whisper encoder is frozen, only 42M parameters (0.16% of backbone) are trained; abstract is truncated, full recognition accuracy and baseline comparisons are not shown.

recommendation.zh: 扩散LM跨模态适配的实践参考，重点关注CTC损失解决梯度回传受阻的思路，无需精读全文。
recommendation.en: Practical reference for diffusion LM cross-modal adaptation; focus on the CTC loss trick for gradient backpropagation, no need for full reading.

paper.title: Empowering Long-form Omni-modal Understanding with Robust Audio Perception
paper.abstract: Recent advances in large-scale multimodal models have drivenremarkable progress in vision-language tasks; however, comprehensiveomni-modal understanding remains under-explored, largely due to thescarcity of datasets with rich, explicitly aligned auditory cues. To bridgethis gap, we present AVDC (Audio-Visual Decoupled Captions), a large-scaledataset designed to disentangle visual and auditory semantics. Specifi-cally, we propose an automated pipeline that leverages off-the-shelf mod-els to annot

summary.core_problem: 全模态理解中缺乏丰富显式对齐听觉线索的大规模数据集，限制音频-视觉联合推理能力
summary.importance: 多模态数据贡献与评测贡献，构建了视听解耦的字幕数据集和CoT增强QA数据集
summary.technical_approach: 提出AVDC数据集，用现成模型自动为视频生成视觉-only、音频-only、联合视听三类解耦字幕；进一步构建AVDC-QA-CoT推理数据集；采用两阶段训练范式：先在AVDC上做全模态字幕预训练，再指令微调
summary.experiments: （摘要未给出具体模型规模和量化对比结果）

summary_en.core_problem: Omni-modal understanding is limited by the scarcity of datasets with rich, explicitly aligned auditory cues
summary_en.importance: Multimodal dataset and benchmark contribution for audio-visual understanding and reasoning
summary_en.technical_approach: AVDC dataset provides tripartite decoupled captions (visual-only, audio-only, joint audio-visual) generated via an automated pipeline using off-the-shelf models; AVDC-QA-CoT is a Chain-of-Thought augmented QA dataset; a two-stage paradigm uses caption pretraining followed by instruction tuning
summary_en.experiments: Specific model sizes and quantitative benchmark results not provided in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 视听多模态数据集工作，解耦字幕构造思路有一定参考性，看数据构建pipeline部分即可。
recommendation.en: Audio-visual multimodal dataset work; the decoupled caption construction pipeline is somewhat informative, read the data building section only.

paper.title: Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners
paper.abstract: Driven by next-token prediction, NLP shifted from task-specific models into powerful generalist foundation models. What, then, is the equivalent catalyst needed to achieve a general-purpose model in computer vision? In this paper, we contend that large-scale text-to-video generation serves as a strong pre-training paradigm for computer vision, providing the necessary spatiotemporal priors, vision-language alignment, and scalability required for general visual intelligence. We introduce GenCeptio

summary.core_problem: 计算机视觉缺少类似 NLP 中 next-token 预训练那样统一而可扩展的通用学习范式；这篇工作在问，大规模文本到视频生成是否可以充当这种视觉预训练催化剂。
summary.importance: 这是范式层面的多模态预训练主张。重要性不在某个下游任务，而在于它把视频生成 backbone 重新解释为通用视觉表征学习器，试图把生成式预训练和感知任务统一起来。对做统一多模态基座的人，价值在于它提供了“生成模型先学世界，再蒸馏成前馈感知器”的路线。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 GenCeption：先利用预训练的视频扩散生成骨干获得时空先验、视觉语言对齐和可扩展表示，再从该生成 backbone 派生一个前馈感知模型，用文本指令驱动完成多种视觉任务。核心不是简单拿 diffusion features 做线性 probing，而是把生成模型作为通用视觉 learner，再转成可执行感知器。
summary.experiments: 作者在深度估计、法线估计、相机位姿、表情指代分割、3D 关键点等多任务上评测，摘要声称达到或超过专用模型，如 DepthAnything3、SAM3 等。论文来自 Google DeepMind，作者名单包含 Kaiming He、Andrew Zisserman、Joao Carreira、Misha Andriluka 等。摘要未给出训练数据规模和参数量，但从设定看应依赖大规模 text-to-video 生成预训练。
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind 工作。作者包含 Kaiming He、Andrew Zisserman、Joao Carreira、Misha Andriluka、Eduard Gabriel Bazavan 等，团队长期做视觉预训练、视频理解与生成建模。

summary_en.core_problem: Computer vision still lacks an equivalent of next-token pretraining in NLP: a unified and scalable learning paradigm. This paper asks whether large-scale text-to-video generation can play that role.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is paradigm-level rather than task-level. The key claim is that a video generative backbone can serve as a general-purpose visual learner, unifying generative pretraining and perception. For researchers working on unified multimodal foundation models, the interesting part is the route of learning the world through generation and then deriving a feed-forward perception model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces GenCeption: a feed-forward perception model derived from a pretrained video diffusion generator. The generative backbone is expected to encode spatiotemporal priors, vision-language alignment, and scalable representations, while text instructions steer downstream perception tasks. This is more than feature extraction from a diffusion model; it reframes the generator itself as the pretraining substrate.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports strong results across depth estimation, surface normals, camera pose estimation, expression-referring segmentation, and 3D keypoint prediction, often matching or surpassing specialized models such as DepthAnything3 and SAM3. The paper comes from Google DeepMind and includes Kaiming He, Andrew Zisserman, Joao Carreira, and Misha Andriluka. Exact model sizes and training data scale are not given in the abstract, but the setup clearly relies on large-scale text-to-video generative pretraining.
summary_en.authors_note: A Google DeepMind paper with authors including Kaiming He, Andrew Zisserman, Joao Carreira, Misha Andriluka, and Eduard Gabriel Bazavan, all well known for work in visual pretraining, video understanding, and generative modeling.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你对“生成模型只负责生成、感知模型另训”的先验；先看方法图和任务表，若 transfer 真干净，值得内部复现一条生成→感知路线。
recommendation.en: This can change the prior that generators are only for generation and perception needs separate pretraining; read the method figure and transfer tables first, and replicate internally if the transfer setup is clean.

paper.title: Blind-Spots-Bench: Evaluating Blind Spots in Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Modern AI models achieve strong performance on many established benchmarks, yet they still fail on tasks that humans find almost trivial, such as manipulating a string or drawing a dog with five legs. These examples suggest that existing benchmarks may under-measure persistent blind spots in current systems. We introduce $\texttt{blind-spots-bench}$, a benchmark designed to expose such blind spots through tasks that appear simple for humans but remain challenging for modern AI. We collect raw qu

summary.core_problem: 现有 benchmark 往往测不出模型在人类看来很简单、但模型持续出错的“盲点”；这篇工作试图系统暴露这类能力缺口，覆盖语言、多模态和图像生成模型。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个小而尖的 blind-spot benchmark。它对基座研究的价值不在榜单，而在提醒研究者：常规评测可能高估了模型的通用性，尤其是对组合、操作性和常识外观简单任务的掌握。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从 AI 课程学生提出的原始问题中收集样本，清洗并标注参考答案，形成 235 条数据和一套任务 taxonomy；同时设计自动评分流程，统一评估开源/闭源 LLM、VLM 和图像生成模型在这些“看似简单”的任务上的表现。
summary.experiments: 数据规模不大，仅 235 个样本，但覆盖语言、视觉语言和图像生成模型。结果显示闭源前沿模型整体优于开源模型，但即便强模型也存在稳定盲点；摘要强调的是 blind spot 的持续存在，而不是某家模型绝对领先多少。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单中包含 Emmanuel Abbé。若为同名学者，则其在理论与学习方向有较高知名度；仅凭摘要无法确认团队完整背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a gap in current evaluation: models often fail on tasks that look trivial to humans, yet standard benchmarks under-measure these persistent blind spots.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a small but sharp benchmark for blind spots. The value for foundation-model researchers is not the leaderboard itself, but the reminder that standard evaluations may overestimate general competence, especially on simple-looking compositional or manipulative tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The dataset is built from raw questions collected from students in an AI course, then cleaned and annotated with structured reference solutions. The authors also design an automated grading pipeline to evaluate open-weight and closed-source language, vision-language, and image-generation models.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 235 samples, so it is not large, but it spans LLMs, VLMs, and image generators. Results suggest frontier closed-source models outperform open-weight ones overall, yet even strong models retain systematic blind spots on seemingly easy tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Emmanuel Abbé. If this is the well-known researcher of the same name, that adds some credibility, but the full team background cannot be confirmed from the abstract alone.

recommendation.zh: 不是大 benchmark，但方向对：拿来做 failure-case sanity check 很合适；正文未必值细读，先看 taxonomy 和错误例子。
recommendation.en: Not a major benchmark, but the direction is right: use it as a failure-case sanity check; the taxonomy and example failures matter more than the full paper.

paper.title: LUMI: Tokenizer-Agnostic LLM-Based Lossless Image Compression
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based lossless image compression methods typically represent pixel data through the native text interface of a pretrained model, converting pixel values into token sequences that the LLM processes through its vocabulary head. This design shows that pretrained language models can provide probability estimates for image coding, but it also couples compression to tokenizer behavior, vocabulary-specific numeric tokens, and model-family-specific adaptation. In this paper, w

summary.core_problem: 现有基于LLM的无损图像压缩方法依赖将像素转为文本token，与tokenizer、词表和模型家族强耦合，通用性差。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出与LLM tokenizer无关的无损压缩框架，为复用任意冻结LLM做图像概率建模提供统一路径。
summary.technical_approach: 用像素嵌入模块替代像素转文本的token化，将原始强度与通道信息映射到LLM连续嵌入空间；引入patch内位置编码保留展平后的二维空间结构；采用256路预测头输出像素概率分布。
summary.experiments: 未披露具体参数量与数据集规模，基于冻结LLM骨干在RGB无损图像压缩任务上验证，核心对比依赖tokenizer的像素-as-text方案。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自多所高校与研究机构，未识别出知名大模型预训练研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM-based lossless image compression methods convert pixels to text tokens, creating tight coupling with tokenizer design, vocabulary, and model families, which limits generality.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: a tokenizer-agnostic framework that enables arbitrary frozen LLMs to be reused for probabilistic modeling of image pixels without text-token conversion.
summary_en.technical_approach: Replaces pixel-as-text tokenization with a pixel embedding module that maps raw intensity and channel values into the LLM's continuous embedding space; adds intra-patch positional encoding to preserve 2D spatial structure after flattening; uses a 256-way prediction head for per-pixel probability estimation.
summary_en.experiments: Exact model size and dataset scale not disclosed; evaluated on RGB lossless image compression using frozen LLM backbones, with primary comparisons against tokenizer-dependent pixel-as-text baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are affiliated with multiple academic institutions; no well-known LLM pretraining researchers identified.

recommendation.zh: 核心是把图像直接投进LLM嵌入空间做压缩，对预训练研究员仅作多模态tokenizer替代思路的弱信号，看摘要和方法图即可。
recommendation.en: A weak signal on bypassing text tokenizers for multimodal input; only the abstract and method figure are worth a quick look for pretraining researchers.

paper.title: Vision Language Action (VLA) Models for Unmanned Aerial Robotics and Bimanual Manipulation: A Review
paper.abstract: Vision Language Action (VLA) models unify visual perception, natural-language understanding, and action generation within a single foundation model, allowing a robot to follow instructions such as fold the towel or fly to the red building directly from camera images. Because VLAs inherit world knowledge from internet-scale pre-training, they have become the dominant framework for learning-based manipulation, with bimanual coordination serving as the most demanding testbed: two arms with 7 degree

summary.core_problem: 综述 Vision-Language-Action 模型在无人机机器人和双臂操作中的架构、训练配方、动作表示和系统约束。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是领域综述。它对预训练研究员的价值主要在于整理 VLA 如何把视觉、语言和动作放进统一模型，以及 action representation、延迟、负载和双臂协调这些具身场景对基础模型接口提出的约束。
summary.technical_approach: 论文覆盖 2017-2026 年的 183 篇工作，并按七个维度组织：VLA 架构、训练 recipe、动作表示、双臂协调、无人机相关 VLA、部署约束与未来方向。它不是提出新模型，而是比较不同 VLA 系统如何从视觉观测和语言指令生成连续或离散动作。
summary.experiments: 作为综述论文，没有统一新实验或模型训练结果。摘要强调双臂任务需要两个 7 自由度机械臂协同完成折叠、装配、重定向等操作；无人机任务则需要在严格延迟和载荷约束下协调推力、姿态和可能的夹爪控制。

summary_en.core_problem: The review surveys Vision-Language-Action models for unmanned aerial robotics and bimanual manipulation, focusing on architectures, training recipes, action representations, and deployment constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is a domain review. Its value for pretraining researchers is in mapping how vision, language, and action are unified in VLA systems, and how action representation, latency, payload, and bimanual coordination stress the foundation-model interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper covers 183 contributions from 2017 to 2026 and organizes them along seven dimensions, including VLA architectures, training recipes, action representations, bimanual coordination, UAV-oriented VLA work, deployment constraints, and future directions. It does not propose a new model; it compares how VLA systems map visual observations and language instructions to actions.
summary_en.experiments: As a review, it reports no unified new experiments or model-training results. The abstract highlights bimanual manipulation with two 7-DoF arms for folding, assembly, and reorientation, and UAV tasks that require coordinating thrust, attitude, and sometimes gripper commands under strict latency and payload limits.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLA/action tokenization 目录可留档；不必细读，重点翻动作表示和训练 recipe 分类表。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a VLA and action-tokenization map; skip the prose and inspect the action-representation and training-recipe taxonomy.

paper.title: Pluralis v0.1: Towards a Multicultural, Multimodal, Multilingual Benchmark for AI Risk and Reliability
paper.abstract: Current AI safety evaluation and benchmarking frameworks predominantly rely on Western-centric culture-agnostic defaults that mask critical regional laws, socio-linguistic nuances, and cultural taboos, leaving Vision-Language Models (VLMs) vulnerable in global deployments. We introduce Pluralis v0.1: a novel multimodal, multi-regional, and multilingual dataset built from a culture-first perspective. Spanning 6,448 prompts across six Asia-Pacific countries (Bangladesh, India, Korea, Pakistan, Sin

summary.core_problem: 现有 AI 安全评测把“安全/对齐”当作文化无关的二元属性，默认用英语与西方语境定义“有害/不当”。这会系统性漏掉地区法律、宗教禁忌、语用礼仪等带来的真实风险，尤其在 VLM 场景里，文本与图像的组合会触发非对抗、但高度本地化的危险行为建议或文化冒犯。论文要解决的是：如何用可扩展、可复用的方法，把“地域条件化（locale-conditioned）的安全与文化适切性”做成一个多语种、多地区、原生多模态的基准，并配套一个能自动化评测、且能区分多种失败模式的 judge。
summary.importance:
对基座研究的直接价值不在“提升模型能力”，而在于把安全评测从单一全球共识标签，推进到“分地域、分语言、分文化规范”的可操作框架。它带来三类影响：
1) 评测范式：把 safety 与 cultural appropriateness 解耦，并显式引入 location-conditioned 维度，避免把分歧压扁成一个标签；
2) 多模态风险面：强调“文本+良性图片”的非对抗组合也能触发严重本地风险，提示 VLM 预训练/对齐时需要考虑跨模态触发器与语境条件；
3) Judge 设计：提出多轴 judge 需要同时识别 hallucination、over-refusal、以及安全与文化不当的边界，这对后续做自动化对齐评测、以及用 judge 反哺训练信号质量（reward / rejection sampling）有现实参考。
总体贡献量级更像“评测与方法论资产”，而不是一个直接改变预训练 recipe 的技术突破，但它会影响数据构建、对齐目标与评测闭环。
summary.technical_approach:
工作由三块组成：数据构建、标注与分析、自动化评测器。
1) 数据构建（culture-first）：不是从现成英文安全题库翻译，而是按 locale（论文给出 6 个亚太国家/地区）从当地法律、宗教与社会规范出发，原生写出 prompt，并覆盖 8 种语言（包含当地英语变体与官方语言）。关键点是“触发条件”往往来自语境：同一行为在不同地区合法性不同、禁忌不同。
2) 多模态设计：用“看似无害的文本查询 + 良性图片”去挖掘文化断层与地区边界条件，强调这不是 jailbreak，而是日常探索任务在本地语境下变成风险建议（例如某些地区对电子烟持有/购买的法律约束；某些文化语境下对丧葬/仪式的禁忌）。这类设计把风险从‘显式武器/暴力’扩展到‘本地化合规与礼仪’。
3) 双通道评测流水线：用 culturally matched 的人工标注作为 ground truth，同时训练/构建一个 location-conditioned 的 LLM-as-a-Judge。judge 采用 multi-axis 评分，核心是做两组解耦：
  - 安全合规 vs 多模态幻觉/事实错误 vs 过度拒答（over-refusal）；
  - 普适安全（universal harms）vs 文化适切性（locale-specific appropriateness）。
4) 失败根因 taxonomy：基于跨地区对比，把“文化不当”拆成可归因的根因类别（论文强调 bottom-up），用于解释模型在不同 locale/语言下的系统性盲点，而不是只给一个总分。
方法选择上的取舍很明确：不追求一个全球统一标签，而是承认分歧与条件化；不把文化评测停留在文本，直接把 VLM 的跨模态触发纳入；不只做人工评测，而是把自动 judge 做成可扩展组件。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可确认的量化信息主要是数据规模与覆盖面：6,448 个 prompts，覆盖 6 个亚太国家/地区与 8 种语言，并包含多模态输入。论文声称“初步发现模型频繁产生文化不当回应”，并强调能暴露传统 safety suite 忽略的盲区。
但在当前提供的内容中，尚未出现：
- 具体被测模型列表（哪些 VLM/LLM）、版本与推理设置；
- judge 的训练细节（提示词/微调/数据划分）、以及 judge 与人工一致性指标（如相关系数、Kappa、pairwise accuracy）；
- 关键对比数字（Pluralis 相比现有基准能多发现多少失败、各 locale 的失败率差异、over-refusal/hallucination 的占比等）。
如果全文后半部分包含这些表格与一致性评测，它们会是判断该基准“可用性与可复现性”的关键证据点。
summary.reading_guide:
精读优先级：
1) Figure 1/2（论文提到的三维动机与双通道评测流水线）：看清楚 locale-conditioned 的定义方式、multi-axis 维度如何拆分，以及人工与自动评测如何闭环。
2) 数据构建章节：重点看 prompt 的来源（法律条文/宗教规范/社会习俗）、语言覆盖策略（是否包含 code-switching、当地英语变体如何处理）、以及多模态样例如何设计成“非对抗但可触发”。
3) Judge 章节：重点看如何区分 safety violation、hallucination、over-refusal；是否用同一 judge 处理所有 locale 还是显式条件化；以及 judge 的可靠性验证方法。
4) Root-cause taxonomy 与跨文化分析：看它是否能给出可行动的训练信号（例如哪些类型最适合做数据补齐/对齐规则/拒答策略）。
如果时间有限：先看数据样例表 + judge 维度定义 + 人工一致性/自动一致性结果（若有），大约 40–60 分钟可建立对该基准的可信度判断。

summary_en.core_problem: Most safety benchmarks implicitly treat alignment/safety as a culture-agnostic binary property, largely grounded in English and Western norms. This collapses locale-specific legality, religious taboos, and sociolinguistic pragmatics into a single label, leaving VLMs brittle in global deployment. The paper targets a concrete gap: building a culture-first, multilingual and multimodal safety benchmark that is explicitly locale-conditioned, and pairing it with an automated judge that can separate safety compliance from hallucination and over-refusal, and also separate universal safety from cultural appropriateness.
summary_en.importance:
The main contribution is an evaluation asset and an evaluation methodology, not a new pretraining recipe. Still, it matters to foundation-model research in three ways:
1) Evaluation paradigm: it operationalizes disagreement and conditionality (locale/language) instead of forcing a global-consensus label, which is closer to how real deployments fail.
2) Multimodal risk surface: it highlights that benign images combined with seemingly innocuous text can trigger severe, region-specific hazards without adversarial jailbreak intent—useful for thinking about VLM pretraining and alignment coverage.
3) Judge design for training loops: a multi-axis, locale-conditioned LLM-as-a-Judge that disentangles hallucination and over-refusal is directly relevant if one wants to reuse judges as reward models or data filters; it pushes toward higher-quality training signals rather than a single “safe/unsafe” score.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Pluralis v0.1 is built around three pillars: culture-first data construction, dual human/automated evaluation, and a bottom-up taxonomy of failure causes.
1) Culture-first dataset construction: prompts are authored from local legal/religious/social norms across six Asia-Pacific locales, covering eight languages (including local English variants). This is intentionally not a translation of existing English safety sets.
2) Native multimodality: prompts pair text with benign images to elicit non-adversarial but contextually unsafe or culturally inappropriate responses. The design goal is to expose failures caused by applying globally averaged (often Western) safety priors to localized contexts.
3) Dual evaluation pipeline: culturally matched human annotations serve as ground truth; an automated, locale-conditioned LLM-as-a-Judge provides scalable scoring.
4) Multi-axis judge: the judge is designed to disentangle (i) safety compliance vs multimodal hallucination vs over-refusal, and (ii) universal safety vs locale-specific cultural appropriateness.
5) Root-cause taxonomy: the paper proposes a bottom-up categorization of why responses are culturally inappropriate, enabling more diagnostic analysis than a single aggregate score.
The key design choice is to preserve conditionality (locale/language) and explicitly model multiple failure modes, rather than optimizing for a single universal label.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the confirmed quantitative details are the dataset scope: 6,448 prompts spanning six locales and eight languages, with multimodal inputs.
The excerpt also claims frequent culturally inappropriate model behaviors and argues that Pluralis reveals blind spots missed by culture-agnostic benchmarks.
However, the excerpt does not include the critical experimental specifics needed to fully assess the benchmark: evaluated model list and decoding settings; judge construction/training details; human–judge agreement metrics; and breakdowns of failure rates by locale/language and by failure mode (unsafe vs hallucination vs over-refusal). Those tables/figures—if present later in the paper—are the decisive evidence for reliability and reproducibility.
summary_en.reading_guide:
What to focus on when reading closely:
1) The figures describing the motivation dimensions and the dual evaluation pipeline: verify how “locale-conditioned” is encoded and how the axes are defined.
2) Data construction methodology: sources of norms (law/religion/custom), language coverage (including local English variants and potential code-switching), and how multimodal examples are designed to be benign yet triggering.
3) Judge section: how the judge separates hallucination and over-refusal from safety, whether conditioning is explicit per locale, and how judge reliability is validated.
4) Root-cause taxonomy and cross-locale analysis: look for actionable categories that could translate into data augmentation or alignment policy changes.
If time is limited, read the dataset examples + axis definitions + any human/judge agreement results first (roughly 40–60 minutes to decide whether to adopt it).

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法论文，但值得知道：它把安全分布偏移从“语言差异”推进到“文化×模态组合触发”，做全球化部署评测的人应直接纳入测试池。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but worth knowing: it reframes safety shift from mere language variation to culture-by-modality interactions, so anyone evaluating global deployment should add it to the test suite.
