authors: Tom Wei-cyuan Lin Kashyap Ramanandula Manjusha

paper.title: Worldscape-MoE: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts World Model for Scalable Heterogeneous Action Control
paper.abstract: World models are rapidly becoming a core infrastructure for embodied intelligence and interactive agents: they provide controllable simulators in which agents can perceive, act, forecast, and acquire scalable experience. Yet current video generation world models are still organized around isolated control interfaces, such as camera trajectories, robot actions, or hand-joint signals. This fragmentation is increasingly a scaling bottleneck. The central challenge is not the absence of controllable

summary.core_problem: 如何把相机轨迹、机器人动作、手部关节等“异构控制信号”统一到同一个可扩展的世界模型里，而不是为每种控制单独训练/适配一个生成模型。
summary.importance: 属于“可控生成世界模型”的统一接口问题：用统一建模吸收多种 action supervision，减少控制接口碎片化带来的 scaling 瓶颈；对做多模态/生成式 world model 的预训练配方与路由设计有参考价值，但对纯文本 LLM 预训练关联中等。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Worldscape-MoE：以 Diffusion Transformer 为骨干，在控制侧引入 Mixture-of-Experts，把不同控制类型视作对同一潜在世界动力学的不同约束；通过 MoE 路由把异构控制映射到共享生成主干上，实现可扩展的“多控制统一训练”。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确的模型规模、数据规模、对比基线与量化提升幅度；仅能确认其在“异构控制条件下的视频/世界生成”场景做验证，并强调可扩展性与统一控制能力。

summary_en.core_problem: How to unify heterogeneous control signals (camera trajectories, robot actions, hand joints, etc.) into a single scalable world model, instead of training separate controllable generators per interface.
summary_en.importance: Targets the interface fragmentation bottleneck in controllable generative world models: a unified learning framework that can absorb diverse action supervision while sharing world dynamics. Moderately relevant to foundation-model pretraining researchers, more so for multimodal/world-model pretraining than text-only LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Worldscape-MoE: a Diffusion Transformer backbone with a Mixture-of-Experts control mechanism, treating different controls as different constraints over shared underlying dynamics; MoE routing maps heterogeneous controls into a shared generative core for scalable multi-control training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model/data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains; it only indicates validation on controllable video/world-model generation with heterogeneous controls and claims improved scalability/unification.

recommendation.zh: 把“多控制接口”问题用 MoE 路由统一到 diffusion world model 上，思路对做统一条件建模的人有用；但摘要缺关键实验细节，先看路由/训练目标再决定是否深读。
recommendation.en: MoE-routing as a unification layer for heterogeneous controls in diffusion world models is a useful design pattern; however, the abstract lacks critical experimental specifics—skim routing/training objective first.

paper.title: FlowCIR: Semantic Transport via Flow Matching for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
paper.abstract: Zero-shot composed image retrieval (ZS-CIR) aims to retrieve a target image by editing a reference image with a natural-language instruction, without relying on domain-specific annotated triplets. Most existing ZS-CIR methods rely on textual inversion to translate the reference image into pseudo-text tokens and then compose them with the instruction via simple concatenation in the text space, which can be lossy and brittle for fine-grained semantics. In this work, we propose a new paradigm, name

summary.core_problem: 现有零样本组合图像检索方法依赖文本反转将参考图转为伪文本token再与指令拼接，存在细粒度语义损失大、鲁棒性差的问题。
summary.importance: 提出一种新的零样本组合图像检索范式，将任务建模为条件语义传输，首次将flow matching引入多模态嵌入空间的语义组合任务。
summary.technical_approach: 提出FlowCIR，利用条件flow matching学习轻量传输场，以参考图像为条件将指令表示映射为目标对齐的查询嵌入，仅训练小模块，不更新预训练VLM的图像/文本编码器。
summary.experiments: 在预提取的VLM嵌入上训练，计算效率高；摘要未披露具体模型参数量、baseline与量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing zero-shot composed image retrieval (ZS-CIR) methods rely on textual inversion to convert reference images into pseudo-text tokens, leading to large fine-grained semantic loss and poor robustness.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a new ZS-CIR paradigm that frames the task as conditional semantic transport, introducing flow matching to semantic composition in multimodal embedding spaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlowCIR uses conditional flow matching to learn a lightweight transport field that maps instruction representations to target-aligned query embeddings conditioned on the reference image, training only a small module without updating pretrained VLM encoders.
summary_en.experiments: Trains on pre-extracted VLM embeddings with high computational efficiency; specific model parameters, baselines, and quantitative improvements are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 多模态检索领域的增量方法，将flow matching用于嵌入空间语义组合，对多模态预训练仅有微弱启发，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental multimodal retrieval method applying flow matching to embedding-space semantic composition, with weak inspiration for multimodal pretraining; read abstract only.

paper.title: Show Me Examples: Inferring Visual Concepts from Image Sets
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can follow complex textual instructions, yet they struggle to reason from purely visual context. In particular, current models fail to infer shared concepts from sets of example images and apply them to new inputs. We introduce Visual Concept Inference from Sets (VICIS), a task that evaluates this capability. Given a small context set of images sharing a concept and a query image, the model must generate new images that preserve the context-defined concept while rem

summary.core_problem: 评估并提升模型从“纯视觉上下文（示例图集合）”中归纳概念并用于生成的能力，而不是依赖文本指令。
summary.importance: 更接近“视觉版 in-context concept learning”的生成设定；对统一多模态预训练的启发在于：现有 VLM 往往忽略视觉上下文，可能需要显式的集合条件化与概念抽取表征。
summary.technical_approach: 提出任务 VICIS：给定一组共享概念的上下文图像 + 查询图像，生成同时保留概念且符合查询的图像；并给出训练框架与架构，从集合中推断概念、从查询提取概念相关 embedding 以条件化生成。
summary.experiments: 在合成数据与 ImageNet/WordNet 规模数据上训练/评测，报告现有 SOTA VLM 在该任务上表现差（忽略上下文或走偏置），所提方法在准确性/多样性与泛化上更好；摘要未给出具体模型规模与量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluating and improving the ability to infer a shared visual concept from a set of example images and apply it in conditional image generation without text instructions.
summary_en.importance: A “visual in-context concept learning” generation setting; relevant to multimodal pretraining because it exposes that many VLMs ignore visual context, suggesting explicit set-conditioning and concept extraction may be needed.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces VICIS: given a context set of images sharing a concept plus a query image, generate an image that preserves the context-defined concept while matching the query; proposes a training framework/architecture that infers concepts from sets and extracts concept-specific embeddings from queries to condition generation.
summary_en.experiments: Trained/evaluated on synthetic data and large-scale ImageNet/WordNet-derived data; reports SOTA VLMs perform poorly (ignore context or default to biases) while the proposed model improves accuracy/diversity and generalization; abstract does not specify model sizes or exact deltas.

recommendation.zh: 把“视觉 ICL”落到可操作的生成任务上，能暴露 VLM 忽略视觉上下文的硬伤；读任务定义+失败案例即可，训练细节未必能直接迁移。
recommendation.en: Turns “visual ICL” into an actionable generative task and clearly shows VLMs often ignore visual context; read the task setup and failure cases—training details may not transfer cleanly.

paper.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity
paper.abstract: We present Seed2.0, a model series that takes a meaningful step toward solving complex, real-world tasks. Our approach begins with identifying users' genuine needs and constructing a reliable, forward-looking evaluation system by selecting and abstracting benchmarks grounded in these needs and in realistic, complex scenarios. Guided by this evaluation system, Seed2.0 targets two persistent challenges, long-tail knowledge and complex instruction following, substantially improving the model's reli

summary.core_problem: 大模型在真实世界复杂任务中存在长尾知识不足、复杂指令跟随能力弱的问题，且现有评估体系脱离真实用户需求
summary.importance: 行业重大动态，字节跳动发布Seed2.0旗舰大模型系列，提出面向真实复杂场景的评估体系，模型能力覆盖推理、多模态、搜索等核心场景
summary.technical_approach: 以用户真实需求为导向，构建基于真实复杂场景的前瞻性评估体系，针对长尾知识和复杂指令跟随两个核心挑战优化模型，同步强化推理、视觉理解、搜索等核心能力
summary.experiments: 通过大量真实世界用例验证，Seed2.0具备初步处理复杂真实世界任务的能力，服务数亿用户；宣称推理、视觉理解、搜索能力处于世界领先水平（无公开量化对比数据）
summary.authors_note: 字节跳动Seed团队，字节跳动核心大模型研发团队，负责Seed系列大模型的研发与迭代

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs lack long-tail knowledge and complex instruction following ability for real-world complex tasks, and existing evaluation systems are disconnected from real user needs
summary_en.importance: Major industry development: Bytedance releases the Seed2.0 flagship LLM series, proposes a real-scenario aligned evaluation system, with capabilities covering reasoning, multimodal, search and other core scenarios
summary_en.technical_approach: Oriented by real user needs, builds a forward-looking evaluation system based on real complex scenarios, optimizes the model for two core challenges: long-tail knowledge and complex instruction following, while strengthening core capabilities like reasoning, visual understanding, and search
summary_en.experiments: Validated via extensive real-world use cases, Seed2.0 has initial ability to handle complex real-world tasks and serves hundreds of millions of users; claims world-leading reasoning, visual understanding, and search capabilities (no public quantitative comparison data available)
summary_en.authors_note: Bytedance Seed Team, the core LLM R&D team of Bytedance, responsible for the development and iteration of the Seed model series

recommendation.zh: 字节跳动Seed2.0旗舰模型发布的技术卡，可了解其评估导向与能力迭代方向，无核心预训练技术细节，读摘要与能力章节即可
recommendation.en: Bytedance Seed2.0 flagship model release card, useful for understanding its evaluation direction and capability iteration; no core pre-training technical details, read abstract and capability sections only

paper.title: Clearer Sight, Fewer Lies: Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization for Multimodal Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are prone to hallucination as their generation preferences are insufficiently calibrated to visual evidence, causing them to fall back on linguistic priors, rather than faithful grounding. In this work, we start from an empirical observation: when query-relevant visual evidence is explicitly strengthened using the model's own attention, generation becomes more accurate, suggesting that many failures do not arise solely from missing perception, but from an

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型（MLLM）因生成偏好未与视觉证据充分校准、过度依赖语言先验导致的幻觉问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将视觉证据强度纳入偏好对齐的约束维度，而非仅关注响应质量，为MLLM幻觉缓解提供了新的优化方向
summary.technical_approach: 提出Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization（OPPO），先通过模型自身注意力增强查询相关视觉证据构造不同强度的证据视图，再对比同一忠实响应在强/锚定/弱证据视图下的表现，将朴素视觉偏好转化为有序的视觉证据对齐目标
summary.experiments: 原摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据集规模、对比基线及定量提升幅度，仅通过经验观察验证了增强视觉证据可提升生成准确性

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses MLLM hallucinations caused by generation preferences being insufficiently calibrated to visual evidence, leading to over-reliance on linguistic priors
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation that first incorporates visual evidence strength into preference alignment constraints, rather than only focusing on response quality, providing a new optimization direction for MLLM hallucination mitigation
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization (OPPO): first constructs evidence views of varying strength by amplifying query-relevant visual signals via the model's own attention, then contrasts the same faithful response across strong/anchored/weak evidence views to turn naive visual preference into ordered visual-evidence alignment
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific model parameters, training dataset size, baselines, or quantitative improvement margins; only empirical observations confirm that enhancing visual evidence improves generation accuracy

recommendation.zh: 多模态幻觉对齐的小改进，核心是把证据强度放进偏好对比，可作为后训练 ablation 的弱参考，不用深读
recommendation.en: Minor tweak to multimodal hallucination alignment that injects evidence strength into preference ranking; useful only as a weak signal for post-training ablations, no deep read needed

paper.title: Consistency as Inductive Bias: Learning Cross-View Invariance for Robust Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Inductive biases steer learning toward generalizable solutions by encoding task structure. In this work, we identify a crucial missing bias in MLLMs: cross-view consistency, \textit{i.e.}, semantically invariant views of the same instance should lead to the same answer. Standard reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) objectives do not impose this constraint, but instead assign pointwise rewards to each visual input. Even with data augmentation (DA), transformed views are typically

summary.core_problem: 解决现有MLLM缺乏跨视图一致性归纳偏置，标准RLVR目标仅对单视图分配点式奖励，导致视图变换后推理结果不一致、鲁棒性差的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将跨视图一致性作为归纳偏置注入多模态RLVR训练流程，复用现有组采样机制实现，无需额外模型结构修改
summary.technical_approach: 提出ConsistRoll方法，将原图像与语义不变的变换视图（如裁剪、旋转、光照调整）放入GRPO的同一生成组，仅当配对生成结果均正确且语义一致时分配联合奖励，迫使模型学习跨视图不变的推理能力
summary.experiments: 原摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据集、对比基线及定量提升幅度，仅说明方法可将一致性约束转化为RL训练信号

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the lack of cross-view consistency inductive bias in MLLMs, where standard RLVR objectives only assign pointwise rewards to single views, leading to inconsistent reasoning and poor robustness after view transformation
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation that first injects cross-view consistency as an inductive bias into multimodal RLVR training pipelines, implemented via reuse of existing group sampling mechanisms without additional model architecture modifications
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ConsistRoll: places original images and semantically invariant transformed views (e.g., crop, rotation, lighting adjustment) into the same GRPO generation group, assigns joint rewards only when paired completions are both correct and semantically consistent, forcing the model to learn cross-view invariant reasoning
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific model parameters, training datasets, baselines, or quantitative improvement margins; it only states that the method converts consistency constraints into RL training signals

recommendation.zh: 把跨视图一致性做成RLVR的组奖励，思路干净但无范式突破，可参考其组采样复用技巧，不用读全文
recommendation.en: Injects cross-view consistency into RLVR via group reward reuse; clean idea but no paradigm shift, only the group sampling trick is worth noting

paper.title: Large Language Model Teaches Visual Students: Cross-Modality Transfer of Fine-Grained Conceptual Knowledge
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) possess broad conceptual knowledge acquired through large-scale text pretraining, yet their potential to supervise models in other modalities remains underexplored. In this work, we propose LaViD--Language-to-Visual Knowledge Distillation--a simple and effective framework for transferring high-level semantic knowledge from a language-only teacher to a vision-only student model. Instead of relying on paired multimodal data, LaViD elicits conceptual signals from an LLM

summary.core_problem: 现有跨模态细粒度知识蒸馏依赖配对多模态数据或视觉-语言模型（VLM）作为教师，难以充分利用LLM的文本预训练概念知识。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出仅用单模态LLM作为教师、无需配对多模态数据的跨模态细粒度知识蒸馏框架，为多模态知识迁移提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出LaViD框架，通过提示LLM生成探测视觉类语义差异的多选题（MCQ），将每个视觉类映射到MCQ上的软标签分布作为概念签名，用辅助蒸馏损失监督纯视觉学生模型训练。
summary.experiments: 在多个细粒度视觉基准上，仅用单模态LLM教师的LaViD consistently优于基于VLM教师的MaKD等近期方法；提供的摘要未披露具体模型规模、训练数据量。
summary.authors_note: 作者含Yong Jae Lee（多模态领域知名研究者），机构信息未在公开条目中明确披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing cross-modal fine-grained knowledge distillation relies on paired multimodal data or vision-language models (VLMs) as teachers, failing to fully leverage conceptual knowledge from text-pretrained LLMs.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; first cross-modal fine-grained distillation framework using only unimodal LLMs as teachers without paired multimodal data, offering a new paradigm for multimodal knowledge transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes LaViD, which prompts LLMs to generate multiple-choice questions (MCQs) probing semantic distinctions between visual classes, maps each class to a soft label distribution over MCQs as a conceptual signature, and supervises a vision-only student via an auxiliary distillation loss.
summary_en.experiments: Consistently outperforms recent VLM-based distillation methods like MaKD across multiple fine-grained visual benchmarks; no specific model scales or training data volumes disclosed in the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Yong Jae Lee (well-known multimodal researcher); institutional affiliations not explicitly provided in the entry.

recommendation.zh: 思路新颖但仅适用于细粒度视觉分类，仅看摘要和方法部分的MCQ软标签设计即可，无需复现。
recommendation.en: Novel idea but limited to fine-grained visual classification; only read the abstract and MCQ soft-label design in the method section, no need to reproduce.

paper.title: Ask, Solve, Generate: Self-Evolving Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation via Self-Consistency Rewards
paper.abstract: Most unified large multimodal models (LMMs) that support both visual understanding and image generation still rely on curated post-training supervision, such as human annotations, preference labels, or external reward models. We ask whether a unified LMM can improve both abilities autonomously using only unlabeled images. We propose a self-evolving training framework with three internal roles: a Proposer that generates visual questions, a Solver that answers and evaluates them, and a Generator t

summary.core_problem: 现有支持“理解+生成”的统一多模态模型后训练高度依赖人工标注数据，已有的无监督自进化方法存在两个核心缺陷：一是样本级自洽奖励容易退化为低熵的无信息一致信号，导致训练不稳定；二是理解与生成任务优化目标脱节，理解能力提升无法有效传导到生成质量，且现有方法通常仅在单一生成范式上验证，通用性不足。
summary.importance: 该工作验证了完全使用无标注图像同时提升多模态理解与生成能力的可行性，提出的token级不确定性奖励、理解模型介导的生成评估方案，为跨任务自监督优化提供了可迁移的思路，对混合AR+扩散架构的统一多模态模型预训练后持续优化有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 基于冻结的统一多模态主干，训练三个LoRA功能角色：Proposer生成视觉问题，Solver回答问题并作为内部评估器，Generator合成图像。针对奖励退化问题，提出Solver Token Entropy（STE）指标，用token级预测不确定性作为连续的难度度量，解决样本级自洽饱和后无有效训练信号的问题，支撑冷启动阶段的课程学习；针对跨任务耦合弱的问题，用Solver作为生成结果的内置评估器，结合QA保真度（生成图像是否匹配prompt描述属性）、循环一致性（生成图像重打caption与原prompt的匹配度）、多样性三个维度计算生成奖励，让理解能力的提升直接优化生成奖励的质量。整个训练流程不需要人工标注或外部奖励模型，且适配不同生成范式。
summary.experiments: 在三类采用不同生成范式的统一多模态模型上完成验证：扩散架构BLIP3o、整流流架构BAGEL、自回归架构VARGPT-v1.1。同一套训练流程在三个主干上均获得一致提升：理解类百分点指标提升1.9~3.6，MME子项获得双位数提升，GenEval生成指标提升3%，未出现跨任务性能权衡。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点关注方法部分对奖励退化问题的解决方案（STE设计）、跨任务耦合的评估机制，以及跨三类生成范式的通用实验设置，理解同一套流程适配不同架构的核心逻辑，无需关注特定主干的实现细节，预计阅读时间18分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing unified multimodal models supporting both visual understanding and image generation rely heavily on curated annotated data for post-training. Prior unsupervised self-evolution methods suffer from two core limitations: sample-level self-consistency rewards often degenerate into low-entropy, uninformative agreement signals that cause training instability; understanding and generation objectives are poorly coupled, so improvements in understanding do not transfer to generation quality, and existing methods are usually validated on a single generation paradigm with limited generality.
summary_en.importance: This work demonstrates the feasibility of improving both multimodal understanding and generation using only unlabeled images. The proposed token-level uncertainty reward and solver-mediated generation evaluation scheme provides a transferable recipe for cross-task self-supervised optimization, relevant to post-pretraining continual improvement of unified multimodal architectures including hybrid AR+diffusion designs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework trains three LoRA-based role adapters on a frozen unified multimodal backbone: a Proposer that generates visual questions, a Solver that answers questions and acts as an internal evaluator, and a Generator that synthesizes images. To address reward degeneracy, Solver Token Entropy (STE) is introduced as a continuous difficulty measure derived from token-level prediction uncertainty, which remains informative even when sample-level consistency saturates, enabling curriculum learning from cold start. To address weak cross-task coupling, the Solver is used as an evaluator for generated images, combining QA fidelity (whether generated images match prompt attributes), cycle consistency (match between re-captioned generated images and original prompts), and diversity to compute generation rewards, so improvements in understanding directly sharpen reward signals for generation. The full pipeline requires no human annotations or external reward models, and is designed to be portable across generation paradigms.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across three unified multimodal backbones spanning fundamentally different generation paradigms: diffusion-based BLIP3o, rectified-flow-based BAGEL, and autoregressive VARGPT-v1.1. The same training recipe delivers consistent gains across all three backbones: 1.9 to 3.6 point improvements on percentage-based understanding metrics, double-digit gains on MME sub-scores, and +3% on the GenEval generation benchmark, with no observed cross-task performance tradeoffs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this paper. Prioritize the design of STE for resolving reward degeneracy, the solver-mediated cross-task evaluation mechanism, and the cross-paradigm experimental setup to understand why the recipe works across different generation architectures. Implementation-specific training details for individual backbones can be skipped unless adapting the method to a new model. Expected reading time: 18 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 三角色自博弈+token熵难度调度的设计对统一多模态自训练有参考，重点看§3.2的STE信号定义和§4.3的生成任务评估方案。
recommendation.en: The three-role self-play plus token-entropy difficulty scheduling design is informative for unified multimodal self-training; focus on §3.2 for STE definition and §4.3 for generation evaluation scheme.

paper.title: Paying More Attention to Visual Tokens in Self-Evolving Large Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Recently, self-evolving large multimodal models (LMMs) have received attention for improving visual reasoning in a purely unsupervised setting. However, multi-role self-play and self-consistency reward schemes in existing self-evolving LMMs optimize answer agreement without ensuring the decoder attends to visual content, relying instead on statistical language priors to produce self consistent outputs. This leads to a persistent failure mode we term visual under-conditioning, where the decoder r

summary.core_problem: 现有无监督自进化多模态模型以答案自洽为优化目标，训练过程中解码器会依赖统计语言先验而非真实视觉输入生成结果，产生视觉欠条件（visual under-conditioning）问题：生成时对视觉token注意力不足，出现幻觉、模态旁路，在需要细粒度视觉感知的描述、区域定位类任务上性能甚至低于基模型。
summary.importance: 该工作明确指出了自进化LMM训练中一个普遍存在的信号偏差：自洽奖励不等价于正确的视觉接地。提出的不变性正则思路为多模态模型无标注对齐、持续优化提供了可复用的方案，对统一多模态模型预训练后的无监督迭代有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出VISE框架，放弃传统多角色自博弈设计，采用单模型自提问模式，全程不需要人工标注、元数据或外部奖励模型。训练信号来自两个互补的不变性奖励，直接约束模型的视觉条件依赖而非答案一致性：1）几何不变性奖励：对图像施加已知空间变换（裁剪、缩放等）后，要求模型给出的目标定位、描述结果保持空间一致；2）语义不变性奖励：对模型预测的目标区域做局部扰动遮挡后，要求模型能够识别对应视觉证据缺失，无法输出原预测结果。
summary.experiments: 在覆盖图像描述、VQA、视觉推理、幻觉检测的18个基准上，跨4类主干网络、多个模型规模完成验证：COCO描述CIDEr最高提升16.85，TextCaps CIDEr提升19.66，Chair-I物体幻觉指标降低5.0点，VQA和推理基准也获得一致提升，消除了过往自进化方法“推理性能上升、细粒度描述性能下降”的权衡问题。注意力可视化验证，训练后解码器各层对视觉token的注意力权重显著提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点关注引言部分对视觉欠条件现象的定义和实证观察，以及两个不变性奖励的设计逻辑，实验部分的注意力分析结果可快速浏览，无需深究训练超参数细节，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing unsupervised self-evolving large multimodal models optimize for answer self-consistency during training, which allows decoders to rely on statistical language priors instead of actual visual input. This causes visual under-conditioning: insufficient attention to visual tokens during generation, leading to hallucinations, modality bypass, and degraded performance on fine-grained vision-language tasks such as captioning and region-level description, where performance often drops below the base model level.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a pervasive training signal bias in self-evolving LMM pipelines: self-consistency rewards do not guarantee proper visual grounding. The proposed invariance-based regularization provides a reusable recipe for unsupervised alignment and continual optimization of multimodal models, with direct relevance to post-pretraining iteration of unified multimodal systems without labeled data.
summary_en.technical_approach: The VISE framework replaces prior multi-role self-play setups with a single-model self-questioning pipeline, requiring no human annotations, metadata, or external reward models. Training uses two complementary invariance rewards that directly regularize visual conditioning rather than answer agreement: (1) Geometric invariance reward enforces spatial consistency of localization and description outputs under known image transformations such as cropping and scaling; (2) Semantic invariance reward requires the model to detect missing visual evidence when predicted object regions are occluded, so predictions cannot be generated without corresponding visual support.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across 18 benchmarks covering image captioning, VQA, visual reasoning, and hallucination detection, across 4 backbone families at multiple scales. The method delivers up to +16.85 CIDEr on COCO, +19.66 CIDEr on TextCaps, 5.0 point reduction on the Chair-I object hallucination metric, with consistent gains on VQA and reasoning benchmarks. It eliminates the previously observed tradeoff between improved reasoning performance and degraded fine-grained visual description. Attention analysis confirms increased attention weight on visual tokens across decoder layers after training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this paper. Prioritize the introduction section for the empirical characterization of visual under-conditioning, and the design rationale for the two invariance rewards. The attention analysis in the experiments section is worth a quick look, but detailed hyperparameter ablations can be skipped unless implementing the method. Expected reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 视觉欠条件化这个失效模式的诊断对VLM对齐有启发，只看§3的奖励设计和§4的注意力可视化即可，方法本身是自监督后训练的增量改进。
recommendation.en: The diagnosis of visual under-conditioning is insightful for VLM alignment; read only §3 for reward design and §4 for attention visualizations, the method itself is incremental self-supervised post-training.
