paper.title: Safe Autoregressive Image Generation with Iterative Self-Improving Codebooks
paper.abstract: Unlike diffusion-based models that operate in continuous latent spaces, autoregressive unified multimodal models produce images by sequentially predicting discretized visual tokens. These tokens are derived from a codebook that maps embeddings to quantized visual patterns. The language-like architecture enables unified multimodal models to effectively capture text conditional information for generation, making them promising for text-to-image tasks. This also raises an interesting question: how

summary.core_problem: 基于离散视觉码本的自回归统一多模态模型会生成有害图像，而现有扩散模型安全方法大多在连续空间中操作，无法直接用于离散 token 生成场景。
summary.importance: 对统一多模态自回归模型的安全对齐提供了一条不依赖外部安全分类器、也不依赖大规模人工标注的轻量路线；其“在码本层面移除有害子空间”的思路，对研究离散视觉 tokenizer 与生成模型安全耦合有参考意义。但整体贡献偏后训练安全调整，不属于预训练建模范式层面的关键进展。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是迭代自改进码本：先用统一多模态模型自身对生成结果进行理解与判断，自动找出有害生成样本；再比较有害样本与安全样本在模型内部视觉特征上的差异，构造“有害空间”；随后在与该有害空间正交的零空间中，用安全图文对对码本进行自适应微调，尽量保持生成质量。两个步骤反复迭代，持续缩小有害表示。关键点是不去重训整个生成模型，而是直接修正离散码本所承载的视觉语义映射。
summary.experiments: 在 I2P、CoPro 等 8 个有害提示数据集上评估有害生成抑制效果，并在常规基准上检查能力保持。验证了 5 个统一多模态生成模型上的适用性，包括 Janus 和 VILA-U。消融显示迭代去除优于同数据量下单轮去除；OOD 提示下也有一定泛化。论文未在已读内容中给出更细的绝对数值和生成质量损失曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 适合快速泛读。建议重点看方法部分里“有害空间如何构造、码本如何在零空间约束下更新”的两节，以及跨模型泛化和迭代轮次消融。预计阅读 10–15 分钟。若不是专门做多模态安全或离散视觉生成，可跳过实验细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive unified multimodal models that generate images via discrete visual codebooks can produce unsafe outputs, but existing safety methods designed for diffusion models mostly operate in continuous spaces and do not transfer naturally to discrete token generation.
summary_en.importance: The paper proposes a lightweight safety alignment path for autoregressive multimodal models that does not rely on external safety classifiers or large-scale human annotation. The idea of removing harmful subspaces directly in the codebook is relevant to researchers studying the coupling between discrete visual tokenizers and generative safety, although the contribution is primarily a post-training safety intervention rather than a pretraining paradigm shift.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses iterative self-improving codebooks. First, the unified multimodal model itself judges generated outputs and identifies unsafe samples without human annotation. It then compares internal visual features from harmful and safe generations to construct a harmful subspace. Finally, the codebook is fine-tuned only within the null space orthogonal to that harmful direction, using safe image-text pairs so that visual quality is better preserved. These two steps are repeated iteratively. The key design choice is to modify the discrete codebook mappings rather than fully retraining the generative model.
summary_en.experiments: Safety evaluation is conducted on eight harmful prompt datasets, including I2P and CoPro, while capability retention is checked on standard generation benchmarks. The method is applied across five unified multimodal generation models, including Janus and VILA-U. Ablations show that iterative removal outperforms single-round removal under the same data budget, and there is some generalization to out-of-distribution prompts. More detailed absolute numbers and quality degradation curves are not available in the provided excerpt.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read as a quick skim. Focus on the two core sections: how the harmful subspace is estimated from model features, and how codebook updates are constrained to the null space. Also look briefly at cross-model generalization and the iteration ablation. Estimated reading time: 10–15 minutes. Skip dense experimental tables unless working directly on multimodal safety or discrete visual generation.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“把安全约束下沉到视觉 codebook”这条接口思路；但自举判别很容易自证循环，重点检查评测是否含对抗提示与正常画质退化。
recommendation.en: The interesting bit is treating safety as a visual-codebook interface; but self-bootstrapped judging can become self-fulfilling—check adversarial eval and benign-quality regression first.

paper.title: S1-Omni-Image: A Unified Model for Scientific Image Understanding, Generation, and Editing
paper.abstract: We present S1-Omni-Image, an open-weight unified multimodal model for scientific image understanding, generation, and editing. Unlike general-purpose image generation models, scientific image tasks require not only high-fidelity synthesis, but also robust understanding of scientific semantics, structural relations, domain knowledge, and task intent. To this end, S1-Omni-Image builds on the scientific multimodal reasoning backbone S1-VL-32B and couples its understanding capability with an image g

summary.core_problem: 这项工作试图把科学图像理解、生成和编辑放进同一个多模态模型中，解决通用图像生成模型在科学语义、结构关系、文本标注和任务意图控制上不稳定的问题。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座研究的价值在统一多模态建模接口。它不是单纯做科学绘图应用，而是把 VLM 的理解与扩散式图像生成模块连接起来，让语言/视觉推理隐状态直接条件化生成过程。这个方向与 Chameleon、Show-o、Janus、Emu 系列等统一理解-生成模型有关，但这里聚焦科学图像，强调长文本上下文、结构拓扑、区域编辑、医学/材料/地质等专业图像转换。对预训练研究员而言，值得关注的是两个问题：第一，推理 trace 的 hidden states 能否比原始 prompt 更好地约束扩散生成；第二，统一模型在领域图像任务上是获得通用表示，还是主要依赖任务集合和数据格式的工程整合。
summary.technical_approach: 模型以 S1-VL-32B 作为科学多模态推理 backbone。给定用户指令后，模型不是直接把 prompt 送入图像生成器，而是先生成任务导向的 reasoning trace、文本答案和任务 special token。随后把这些 token 的 hidden states 通过 reasoning-to-diffusion alignment layer 注入 MMDiT 图像生成/编辑模块，用作生成或编辑条件。这形成了“think-before-generate”的流程：先解析科学语义、结构关系和任务意图，再执行视觉生成。任务覆盖科学图像生成、科学图像编辑、分割、图像翻译和超分辨率等，并释放 SciGenEdit-10K、模型权重和推理服务代码。与通用 image-to-image 或 text-to-image 扩散模型相比，差别在于条件信号来自一个科学 VLM 的中间表征，而不只是文本编码器；与纯 VLM 相比，差别在于模型能输出图像，并通过扩散模块承担像素级生成。
summary.experiments: 提供内容显示实验覆盖科学图像生成、科学图像编辑和科学图像理解 benchmark，并通过示例展示框架图、机制图、医学图像处理、区域级编辑、图像翻译和超分辨率等能力。明确数字包括 backbone 为 S1-VL-32B，开放数据为 SciGenEdit-10K，开源协议为 Apache 2.0。摘要和引言没有给出完整指标表，因此不宜过度解读性能幅度。能确认的实验结论是：作者把统一模型放在多类科学图像任务上评测，目标是证明 reasoning-conditioned generation 在科学结构一致性和任务遵循上优于直接 prompt-to-image 的通用生成路线。真正需要检查的是消融：去掉 reasoning trace、去掉 task special token、只用文本答案条件化扩散、冻结或训练 alignment layer 时，各任务是否仍保持收益。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看模型结构图和 training/inference pipeline，确认 S1-VL-32B hidden states 如何进入 MMDiT，以及 reasoning-to-diffusion alignment layer 的训练目标。其次看数据部分，重点关注 SciGenEdit-10K 的任务组成、是否包含合成指令、是否有多轮编辑轨迹、是否混入医学分割和图像翻译这类强任务先验数据。实验部分建议重点看 ablation，而不是只看主表；如果没有充分消融，这项工作的结论应限制在“统一接口有效”，不能轻易推出“推理隐状态带来更强科学视觉生成能力”。对预训练方向最值得深挖的是多模态推理 token 与扩散 latent 之间的对齐方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The work aims to unify scientific image understanding, generation, and editing in one multimodal model, addressing the weakness of general image generators on scientific semantics, structural relations, text rendering, and task-level controllability.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research lies in the interface between multimodal reasoning and diffusion-based generation. The model does not treat scientific image generation as plain prompt-to-image synthesis. Instead, it conditions generation on hidden states produced by a scientific VLM. This connects to the broader line of unified understanding-generation systems such as Emu, Show-o, Janus, and related AR-plus-diffusion models. The useful research questions are whether reasoning traces provide better conditioning than raw prompts, and whether such a system learns reusable multimodal representations or mainly benefits from task formatting and curated domain data.
summary_en.technical_approach: S1-Omni-Image is initialized from S1-VL-32B, used as the scientific multimodal reasoning backbone. Given a user instruction, the model first produces a task-oriented reasoning trace, a textual answer, and a task special token. The hidden states associated with these outputs are passed through a reasoning-to-diffusion alignment layer and injected into an MMDiT image generation/editing module. This implements a think-before-generate pipeline: parse the scientific intent and structure first, then generate or edit the image. The framework covers scientific image generation, image editing, segmentation, image translation, and super-resolution. The released assets include open weights, inference code, and SciGenEdit-10K under Apache 2.0. Compared with ordinary diffusion pipelines, the conditioning signal is a scientific VLM representation rather than only a prompt embedding; compared with a text-only or VQA-style VLM, the model has an explicit pixel-generation path.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content states that experiments span scientific image generation, scientific image editing, and scientific image understanding benchmarks, with qualitative examples including diagrams, mechanism illustrations, medical image processing, region-level editing, image translation, and super-resolution. Concrete numbers available from the supplied text include the S1-VL-32B backbone and the SciGenEdit-10K training/resource release. The introduction does not include full metric tables, so the magnitude of gains should be treated cautiously. The most important empirical evidence to inspect is the ablation set: removing the reasoning trace, removing the task special token, conditioning only on the textual answer, or changing the reasoning-to-diffusion alignment layer. Without these controls, the main claim should be read as evidence for a practical unified interface, not as definitive proof that reasoning hidden states improve scientific visual generation in a general way.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the architecture and inference pipeline to understand how S1-VL-32B hidden states are aligned with the MMDiT generator. Then read the dataset section for the composition of SciGenEdit-10K, especially whether the data contains synthetic instructions, multi-turn editing traces, or task-specific supervision such as segmentation and image translation. In the experiments, focus on ablations rather than headline benchmark numbers. The technically interesting part for pretraining researchers is the alignment mechanism between multimodal reasoning tokens and diffusion latents.

recommendation.zh: 关注其 'think-before-generate' 范式在多模态统一建模中的应用，特别是如何将推理轨迹的 hidden states 注入生成模块。
recommendation.en: Focus on its 'think-before-generate' paradigm in unified multimodal modeling, especially how hidden states of reasoning traces are injected into the generation module.

paper.title: MuseVLA: An Adaptive Multimodal Sensing Vision-Language-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
paper.abstract: Humans naturally leverage diverse sensing modalities to interact with the physical world, while most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotics rely solely on RGB observations. This limits their ability to perceive physical properties that are difficult or impossible to infer from RGB cameras, such as temperature, sound, or radar response. We present MuseVLA, an adaptive multimodal sensing VLA model that integrates novel sensors as on-demand tools for robotic manipulation. Given a task ins

summary.core_problem: 现有机器人Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型仅依赖RGB视觉，无法感知温度、声音、雷达等物理属性。
summary.importance: 首次将传感器作为可调用工具集成到VLA模型中，在多模态机器人感知层面有一定方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: MuseVLA首先生成传感器token和目标描述来选择感知模态（类似工具调用），然后将传感器测量值转换为统一的'传感器图像'中间表示，实现异质传感器数据与VLA骨干网络的解耦融合。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中提供具体实验参数和量化结果。
summary.authors_note: Xingyuming Liu等，含Jiaolong Yang、Baining Guo（微软亚洲研究院资深研究者）。

summary_en.core_problem: Current robotic Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely solely on RGB vision, unable to perceive physical properties like temperature, sound, or radar signals.
summary_en.importance: First integration of sensors as callable tools in a VLA model, with some methodological novelty in multimodal robotic perception.
summary_en.technical_approach: MuseVLA first generates a sensor token and target description to select a sensing modality (analogous to tool calling), then converts the sensor measurement into a unified 'sensor image' intermediate representation for decoupled fusion with the VLA backbone.
summary_en.experiments: Specific experimental parameters and quantitative results not provided in abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Xingyuming Liu et al., including Jiaolong Yang and Baining Guo (senior researchers at Microsoft Research Asia).

recommendation.zh: 将传感器视为可调用工具的思想对多模态LLM的工具扩展有微弱启发，但核心是机器人应用，可略读摘要了解思路。
recommendation.en: The sensor-as-callable-tool idea provides minor inspiration for multimodal LLM tool extension, but the core is robotics application — skim the abstract only.

paper.title: PearlVLA: Progressive Embodied Action-Plan Refinement in Latent Space
paper.abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models face a trade-off between efficient action generation and explicit deliberation. Directly decoding actions from vision-language backbone representations enables low-latency control, whereas explicit reasoning through textual chains, pixel-level subgoals, or action search can improve planning but incurs substantial latency and computational cost. We propose PearlVLA, a VLA framework that moves deliberation into the latent space of a vision-language model

summary.core_problem: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型存在低延迟直接解码与显式推理规划的性能trade-off，显式推理方法延迟高、计算开销大。
summary.importance: 方法创新类贡献，提出将规划过程迁移到VLM latent空间的范式，兼顾具身操控的推理能力与低延迟要求。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PearlVLA框架，拆分VLM元查询为固定视觉grounding分支与迭代latent规划分支，通过轻量冻结latent世界模型输出无动作的未来观测latent引导规划，用RefineNet逐步将粗语义草稿细化为细粒度动作计划。
summary.experiments: 在具身操控基准上测试，对比直接解码与显式推理基线，在相近延迟下提升规划成功率，延迟显著低于文本链/像素子目标等显式推理方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models face a tradeoff between low-latency direct decoding and explicit reasoning planning, with explicit reasoning methods incurring high latency and computational cost.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation contribution; proposes a paradigm that shifts planning to the VLM latent space to balance reasoning capability and low latency for embodied manipulation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes PearlVLA framework: splits VLM meta-queries into a fixed visual grounding branch and iterative latent planning branch, uses a lightweight frozen latent world model to output action-free future observation latents for planning guidance, and applies RefineNet to progressively refine coarse semantic drafts into fine-grained action plans.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on embodied manipulation benchmarks; compared to direct decoding and explicit reasoning baselines, it improves planning success rate under similar latency, with significantly lower latency than explicit reasoning methods like text chains or pixel-level subgoals.

recommendation.zh: 具身VLA领域的架构增量改进，与纯文本LLM预训练关联弱，仅做多模态预训练的研究员可略读摘要。
recommendation.en: Incremental architecture improvement for embodied VLA, weak relevance to text-only LLM pretraining; multimodal pretrain researchers can skim the abstract only.

paper.title: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation
paper.abstract: We introduce Qwen-RobotWorld, a language-conditioned video world model for embodied intelligence. With natural language as a unified action interface, it predicts physically grounded future visual trajectories from current observations across robotic manipulation, autonomous driving, indoor navigation, and human-to-robot transfer. This unified formulation provides three promising application directions: synthetic data generation for policy training augmentation, scalable virtual environments for

summary.core_problem: 构建一个以自然语言为统一动作接口的具身智能视频世界模型，用于预测物理上合理的未来视觉轨迹。
summary.importance: 提出了一种统一的具身世界建模范式，通过语言条件下的视频生成，实现了跨机器人操作、自动驾驶、室内导航和人机迁移的统一建模，为策略训练增强、策略评估和下游控制提供了新途径。
summary.technical_approach: 1) 双流 MMDiT 架构：结合冻结的 Qwen2.5-VL 语义和视频 VAE 潜变量，通过层级联合注意力进行动作编码；2) 构建了包含 8.6M 视频-文本对（200M+ 帧）的具身世界知识（EWK）语料库，涵盖 20+ 种具身形态和 500+ 动作类别。
summary.experiments: 在机器人操作、自动驾驶等多个具身场景下进行了验证，但摘要未提供具体的定量结果。
summary.authors_note: 来自阿里 Qwen 团队的技术报告，展示了其在具身智能和多模态世界模型方向的最新进展。

summary_en.core_problem: Building a language-conditioned video world model for embodied intelligence to predict physically grounded future visual trajectories using natural language as a unified action interface.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a unified embodied world modeling paradigm through language-conditioned video generation, achieving unified modeling across robotic manipulation, autonomous driving, indoor navigation, and human-to-robot transfer, providing new avenues for policy training augmentation, policy evaluation, and downstream control.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Double-Stream MMDiT architecture: couples frozen Qwen2.5-VL semantics with video-VAE latents through layer-wise joint attention for action encoding; 2) Constructed the Embodied World Knowledge (EWK) corpus with 8.6M video-text pairs (200M+ frames) covering 20+ embodiments and 500+ action categories.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across multiple embodied scenarios such as robotic manipulation and autonomous driving, but the abstract does not provide specific quantitative results.
summary_en.authors_note: A technical report from the Alibaba Qwen team, showcasing their latest progress in embodied intelligence and multimodal world models.

recommendation.zh: 阿里 Qwen 团队的具身世界模型技术报告，关注其如何将语言作为统一接口来建模跨领域的视频生成，对多模态统一预训练有启发。
recommendation.en: Technical report on embodied world models from the Alibaba Qwen team. Worth noting how they use language as a unified interface for cross-domain video generation modeling, offering insights for multimodal unified pretraining.

paper.title: DAM-VLA: Decoupled Asynchronous Multimodal Vision Language Action model
paper.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models inherit a shared synchronous clock from vision-language pretraining, processing every input at one rate. This is misaligned with physical interaction, where a high-frequency modality changes at hundreds of hertz, vision evolves more slowly, and language stays constant across an episode. A synchronous VLA oversamples slow modalities, undersamples fast ones, and caps action generation at the lowest effective frequency. We hypothesize that decoupling temporal pro

summary.core_problem: 现有VLA模型继承VL预训练的同步时钟假设，无法适配物理交互中不同模态更新速率差异，导致高频模态欠采样、性能受限
summary.importance: 提出解耦异步时序的多模态VLA架构，在不改动预训练主干的前提下支持异频模态接入
summary.technical_approach: 为每个模态维护独立的隐状态缓冲区，按各自传感器频率刷新，动作头持续读取缓冲区输出；新增高频模态通过门控交叉注意力接入，全程冻结预训练主干
summary.experiments: 在7个真实世界接触丰富的机器人操作任务上，平均成功率较同步VLA基线提升1倍以上

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLA models inherit the synchronous clock assumption from vision-language pretraining, which mismatches the varying update rates of different modalities in physical interaction, leading to undersampling of high-frequency modalities and limited performance.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a decoupled asynchronous multimodal VLA architecture that supports integration of modalities with different sampling rates without modifying the pretrained backbone.
summary_en.technical_approach: Maintains per-modality latent buffers refreshed at native sensor rates, continuously read by the action head; new high-frequency modalities are integrated via gated cross-attention while keeping the pretrained backbone fully frozen.
summary_en.experiments: Across 7 real-world contact-rich robot manipulation tasks, average success rate is more than double that of synchronous VLA baselines.

recommendation.zh: 异步多模态解耦思路有一定参考性，但设计针对机器人场景，无通用多模态预训练实验，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: The asynchronous multimodal decoupling idea is a useful reference, but the design is robotics-specific with no general multimodal pretraining experiments; read the abstract only.

paper.title: Mitigating Manifold Departure: Uncertainty-Aware Subspace Rectification for Trustworthy MLLM Decoding
paper.abstract: MLLMs frequently hallucinate objects inconsistent with visual inputs. This issue is typically attributed to the over-reliance on language priors, which can override the visual context. Recent training-free decoding strategies address this by penalizing language priors. However, these methods overlook the dual nature of language priors, where they can be both helpful and harmful depending on the alignment with visual evidence. In particular, blindly suppressing language priors often disrupts the

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MLLM 解码阶段的目标幻觉，但切入点不是再做一轮“更强的对比解码”，而是解释为什么很多 training-free 抑制方法会在减幻觉的同时伤害正常描述。作者把问题表述为：语言先验并不总是有害；当视觉证据充分且与文本先验一致时，先验会帮助模型稳定生成。现有线性抑制方法把先验当成统一噪声做全局减法，容易把隐藏状态从正常解码的高密度语义区域推离，导致描述能力下降。作者把这个几何失效模式命名为 Manifold Departure，并据此设计只在“先验子空间”内做选择性衰减的解码干预。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献有限，它主要是一个 MLLM 推理期校正方法。但有两个点对预训练研究仍有启发。第一，它把“语言先验过强”从经验现象推进到表示空间几何问题，说明解码干预若不尊重隐藏状态流形，容易破坏模型已经学到的语义结构。第二，它把 hallucination 缓解从 logit 级别的统一减法，改成 hidden-state 级别的子空间选择性控制，这种思路对后续研究预训练阶段的表示解耦、模态冲突诊断、以及是否能在训练中显式塑造‘安全干预方向’有参考价值。整体看，更像一篇有想法的 decoding paper，而不是会直接改变预训练 recipe 的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 MGAP，Manifold-Guided Adaptive Projection。它分三步。第一步，估计语言先验子空间。作者构造 blind hidden states，也就是在缺失或弱化视觉条件时模型产生的隐藏状态，把这些状态视作语言先验较强的样本集合，然后对其做 SVD，提取一个低秩 prior subspace。这个设计的含义是：不去假设先验是一个固定偏置向量，而是承认先验在表示空间里更像一个低维方向簇。

第二步，在每个解码步把当前隐藏状态分解为子空间内分量和正交分量。只有投影到 prior subspace 的那一部分会被干预，正交部分尽量保留。这样做是为了避免传统方法那种对整个表示做平移，连与视觉一致的语义成分也一起削弱。

第三步，自适应衰减。作者不是固定强度地压制 prior component，而是先检测 vision-language conflict，再决定衰减幅度。冲突越强，prior 分量衰减越多；若视觉与语言一致，则尽量少动。这一点对应论文一开始强调的“先验有双重作用”。

论文还给出一个流形视角的分析框架。作者用正常解码得到的 hidden-state bank 近似 semantic manifold，并用 kNN 距离定义 off-manifoldness score。若某种干预后隐藏状态的 kNN 距离显著增大，就认为发生了 manifold departure。这个定义不算严格理论证明，但作为诊断工具是清楚的：它把‘为什么减幻觉会伤 fluency 和 fidelity’变成了可观测量。

和已有方法相比，差异主要有三点。其一，干预位置从 logits 转到 hidden states。其二，干预形状从全局线性减法变成子空间投影后的局部修正。其三，干预强度从固定系数变成冲突感知的自适应系数。代价是需要额外构建参考 hidden bank、估计子空间，并在解码时做投影与邻域统计，工程上比简单 contrastive decoding 更重一些。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在 POPE 和 CHAIR 上，目标是看 hallucination 缓解与描述保真之间的 trade-off。全文给出的结论是，MGAP 相比几类 training-free baseline 能更稳定地降低幻觉，同时较少损伤正常描述质量。作者反复强调的不是单点最优，而是 Pareto trade-off 更好：在相近的幻觉抑制强度下，MGAP 保留更多语义 fidelity；或者在相近描述质量下，MGAP 能进一步压低 hallucination 指标。

从消融看，几个部件都不是可有可无。去掉 prior subspace，只做整体抑制，会更容易出现 manifold departure；去掉 adaptive conflict gating，方法会退化成较硬的统一压制，在视觉一致样本上损失更明显；若不在 hidden-state 层面做分解，而回到 logit-level bias subtraction，几何优势会减弱。论文还展示了 off-manifoldness score 与生成退化之间的相关性，支持它提出的诊断框架。

需要说明的是，给定你提供的全文片段里没有完整表格数字、模型规模和所有超参，我不能可靠复述具体百分点提升、rank 维度、bank 大小等精确数值。能确认的是：实验重点不是大规模训练，而是多个现有 MLLM 上的 training-free decoding 对比；评价维度围绕 object hallucination、caption fidelity，以及作者定义的 manifold departure 指标展开。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可，重点看三处。第一是 Introduction 和方法动机图，先把“language prior 既可能帮忙也可能添乱”这个前提吃透，否则会把它误读成普通的 prior suppression。第二是 Section 3.3 附近关于 Manifold Departure 的定义和 Figure 3，这部分是全文最有信息量的地方，它解释了作者为什么坚持在 hidden-state 子空间里做干预。第三是方法章节里 prior subspace 的构造、投影分解和 adaptive attenuation 公式，再配合消融表看每个模块的作用。

预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主线。如果只关心是否值得跟进，不必深究所有几何表述；重点判断两件事：一是 blind states 学到的子空间是否真的稳定、可迁移；二是这种 hidden-level intervention 是否能推广到更强的多模态模型或训练期正则化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies object hallucination in MLLM decoding, but the real target is narrower and more interesting than generic hallucination reduction. It asks why many training-free suppression methods reduce hallucinations yet also damage normal generation. The authors argue that language priors are not uniformly harmful: when visual evidence is weak or conflicting, priors can cause hallucinations; when vision and language agree, the same priors stabilize and sharpen decoding. Existing linear suppression methods treat priors as a global bias to subtract, which can push hidden states away from the high-density region of normal decoding. The paper names this failure mode Manifold Departure and proposes a decoding intervention that only attenuates the prior-related subspace instead of shifting the whole representation.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, and its direct impact on LLM pretraining is limited. Still, it carries two useful ideas for foundation-model researchers. First, it reframes over-reliance on language priors as a representation-geometry issue rather than only a calibration issue. Second, it moves the intervention from logits to hidden-state subspaces, suggesting that safe control of multimodal generation may require respecting the learned semantic manifold. That perspective could matter for future work on representation disentanglement, modality-conflict diagnostics, or even training-time objectives that make intervention directions cleaner. In short, it is more relevant as a decoding/representation paper than as a new pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is MGAP, short for Manifold-Guided Adaptive Projection. It has three main components.

First, it estimates a language-prior subspace. The authors collect blind hidden states, meaning hidden states produced when visual information is removed or weakened, and treat them as samples dominated by language priors. They then run SVD on this bank and extract a low-rank prior subspace. This is a meaningful departure from prior work: instead of assuming priors are a single bias vector, the paper models them as a low-dimensional subspace in representation space.

Second, at each decoding step, the current hidden state is decomposed into two parts: the component inside the prior subspace and the orthogonal residual. Only the projected prior component is modified. The orthogonal component is preserved as much as possible. This is the key mechanism for avoiding the blunt global translation used by logit-level suppression methods.

Third, the attenuation is adaptive. MGAP does not always suppress the prior component with the same strength. It first detects vision-language conflict, then scales the suppression accordingly. Strong conflict leads to stronger attenuation; aligned vision-language evidence leads to weaker intervention. This directly matches the paper’s claim that priors have a dual role.

The paper also introduces a manifold-based diagnostic view. A bank of hidden states from normal decoding is used as a proxy for the semantic manifold, and kNN distance defines an off-manifoldness score. If an intervention increases this score substantially, the hidden state is considered to have departed from the manifold. This is not a formal theorem, but it is a useful empirical diagnostic for explaining why some hallucination-mitigation methods hurt fluency and fidelity.

Relative to prior training-free baselines, the differences are clear: intervention at hidden states instead of logits, subspace-selective modification instead of global subtraction, and conflict-aware adaptive scaling instead of a fixed suppression coefficient. The trade-off is extra machinery: a reference hidden-state bank, subspace estimation, and projection during decoding.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are centered on POPE and CHAIR, with the main goal being the trade-off between hallucination reduction and descriptive fidelity. The paper’s main empirical claim is not just a better single operating point, but a better trade-off curve: at similar hallucination levels, MGAP preserves more faithful description; at similar fidelity levels, it reduces hallucinations more than prior training-free baselines.

The ablations support the design choices. Removing the prior subspace and applying global suppression makes manifold departure more likely. Removing adaptive conflict gating turns the method into a harder uniform suppression scheme and hurts visually aligned cases more. Moving back from hidden-state intervention to logit-level bias subtraction weakens the geometric advantage. The paper also shows that the proposed off-manifoldness score correlates with generation degradation, which supports the diagnostic framing.

One caveat: the provided full-content excerpt does not include the complete result tables, model sizes, or all hyperparameters, so I cannot safely restate exact gains, rank choices, or bank sizes. What is clear is that the evaluation is done as a training-free decoding comparison on existing MLLMs, with metrics covering object hallucination, caption fidelity, and the proposed manifold-departure analysis.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the motivation figure to internalize the paper’s central claim: language priors can be helpful or harmful depending on visual alignment. Without that, MGAP looks like another suppression trick. Second, read the section around the Manifold Departure definition and Figure 3. That is the most informative part of the paper because it explains why the authors intervene in hidden-state space. Third, read the method details for prior-subspace construction, projection, and adaptive attenuation, then check the ablations to see which component actually matters.

About 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If the goal is only to assess relevance, the two questions worth keeping in mind are whether the blind-state subspace is stable across models and whether hidden-level intervention could be turned into a training-time regularization idea.

recommendation.zh: 训练自由解码的几何化改造，思路干净但属推理侧小改进；看 §3 的子空间构造和门控公式就够了。
recommendation.en: A clean geometry-based training-free decoding tweak; read §3 for the subspace construction and gating formula, then move on.

paper.title: SPACE: Source-free Proxy Anchor Concept Erasure for MLLMs
paper.abstract: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face growing privacy risks and regulatory constraints, machine unlearning (MU) has emerged as a crucial solution for removing sensitive data while preserving model performance. However, existing MU methods typically rely on visual data of the target concepts, which is often unavailable due to strict data retention policies, thus creating a demand for source-free unlearning approaches that operate without access to the target data. In this work, we prop

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型 (MLLM) 的概念遗忘/去学习通常需要目标概念的视觉数据，但因隐私政策往往不可得，需要无数据源 (source-free) 的遗忘方法。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首个面向 MLLM 的 source-free 概念擦除框架，在无需目标视觉数据的前提下实现概念遗忘。
summary.technical_approach: SPACE 包含两阶段：(1) 文本引导的代理锚点选择 (TPAS)，从共享特征空间中检索语义对齐的代理锚点；(2) 双约束语义隔离 (DCSI)，将更新限制在保留知识的零空间中以间接擦除目标概念。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未提供具体量化结果；声称理论保证并在多个敏感概念数据集上优于现有 MU 基线。

summary_en.core_problem: Machine unlearning for MLLMs typically requires visual data of the target concepts, which is often unavailable under privacy policies; a source-free unlearning approach is needed.
summary_en.importance: Method novelty: first source-free concept erasure framework specialized for MLLMs, achieving unlearning without access to target visual data.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPACE has two stages: (1) Text-Guided Proxy Anchor Selection (TPAS) retrieves semantically aligned proxy anchors from the shared feature space; (2) Dual-Constraint Semantic Isolation (DCSI) optimizes anchors within the null space of retained knowledge to indirectly erase target concepts.
summary_en.experiments: Claims theoretical guarantees and outperforms existing MU baselines on multiple sensitive-concept datasets; specific quantitative metrics not in abstract.

recommendation.zh: MLLM 概念遗忘的创新性工作，但对 LLM 预训练研究员启发有限，DCSI 零空间约束的想法值得扫一眼。
recommendation.en: Novel MLLM unlearning work but limited relevance to LLM pretrain; the null-space constraint idea in DCSI is worth a quick scan.

paper.title: Test-Time Scaling in Multimodal Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Generation and Reasoning
paper.abstract: Test-time Scaling (TTS) has emerged as a pivotal research direction for enhancing model performance by dynamically allocating computational resources during inference. Recent advancements have adapted this paradigm to Multimodal Foundation Models (MFMs), unlocking their potential in multimodal reasoning and generation. Despite rapid progress, the field lacks a systematic survey and unified theoretical framework to delineate the developmental landscape of multimodal TTS. To bridge this gap, we pr

summary.core_problem: 梳理多模态基础模型中的 test-time scaling 方法，回答推理时如何动态分配额外计算以提升生成与推理能力。
summary.importance: 这是综述而非新方法，但主题与当前 inference-time compute、search、feedback、sampling 的研究主线直接相关；对预训练研究员的价值在于建立问题地图，而不是提供新证据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个统一分类框架，将多模态 TTS 方法分为 sampling-based、feedback-based、search-based 三类，并整理其在多模态生成与推理中的应用场景、常用 benchmark 以及开放问题。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，不提供新的模型规模、训练数据或基准突破；实验部分主要是对已有工作和评测资产的归纳，而非原创实证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper surveys test-time scaling in multimodal foundation models, asking how extra inference compute can be allocated to improve generation and reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey rather than a new method, but the topic is directly tied to current work on inference-time compute, search, feedback, and sampling. Its value to pretraining researchers is in organizing the space, not in providing new evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a unified taxonomy that groups multimodal TTS methods into sampling-based, feedback-based, and search-based approaches, and reviews their applications, benchmarks, and open challenges in multimodal generation and reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not introduce new model scales, training data, or benchmark gains. The empirical content is a synthesis of prior methods and evaluation assets rather than original experimentation.

recommendation.zh: 综述价值大于研究价值；如果你在想 pretrain 与 inference-time compute 的接口，只看 taxonomy 和 benchmark 表即可，不必通读。
recommendation.en: More useful as a map than as research; if you're thinking about the pretrain ↔ inference-time compute interface, the taxonomy and benchmark tables are enough.

paper.title: H2HMem: A Multimodal Memory Benchmark for Agents in Human-Human Interactions
paper.abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed in human-human interaction settings, such as meeting assistants and clinical documentation systems, where they must observe conversations and retain information for downstream queries. Unlike traditional human-assistant settings, these environments are inherently multimodal, involve complex discourse phenomena such as anaphora and deixis, and contain asynchronous or conflicting information from multiple participants. However, existing memory

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent记忆benchmark聚焦单用户纯文本交互，无法覆盖多人多模态对话场景中的回指、指示语、异步信息等复杂话语现象。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献：发布H2HMem，首个面向人与人多模态交互的Agent记忆能力评测基准。
summary.technical_approach: 包含双人及多方多模态对话流，从记忆回忆、记忆推理、记忆应用三个维度评测Agent。
summary.experiments: 用多个先进Agent进行实验，揭示现有系统在复杂多人交互记忆能力上存在显著不足。
summary.authors_note: UC Merced等机构，Ming-Hsuan Yang为知名CV研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent memory benchmarks focus on single-user text-only interactions, failing to cover anaphora, deixis, and asynchronous information in multi-party multimodal dialogues.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: H2HMem is the first multimodal memory benchmark for evaluating agents in human-human interaction settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: Includes dyadic and multi-party conversations with multimodal streams; evaluates agents along three dimensions: memory recall, reasoning, and application.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments with state-of-the-art agents reveal substantial limitations in complex multi-party interaction memory capabilities.
summary_en.authors_note: UC Merced and others; Ming-Hsuan Yang is a well-known computer vision researcher.

recommendation.zh: Agent记忆评测benchmark设计有参考价值，对pretrain研究员主要看实验结果部分了解现有模型缺陷。
recommendation.en: Agent memory benchmark design is useful reference; pretrain researchers mainly need the experimental results section to understand current model limitations.

paper.title: Introducing Gemma 4 12B: a unified, encoder-free multimodal model

summary.core_problem: 发布 Gemma 4 12B，一个 unified、encoder-free 的多模态模型，目标是在单一模型内处理语言与视觉等多模态输入。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的价值在于 encoder-free 多模态建模路线：它挑战了常见的“视觉编码器 + 投影器 + LLM”VLM 组装范式，直接关系到视觉 tokenizer、统一表示和 native multimodal pretraining。
summary.technical_approach: 题目明确指出模型是 unified 且 encoder-free，暗示它减少或移除了独立视觉编码器，把多模态信息更直接地纳入语言模型主干或统一 token 流；但给定信息没有披露视觉离散化方式、训练混合、上下文格式、loss 设计或是否支持生成。
summary.experiments: 给定摘要为 N/A，无法确认模型参数量以外的训练数据、benchmark、baseline、推理成本或效果指标；12B 规模是唯一明确的模型规格。
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind 发布的 Gemma 系列模型博客；未提供具体作者列表。Gemma 系列通常是 Google 开源/开放权重小模型路线的一部分，但此处不能确认技术细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The post introduces Gemma 4 12B, a unified, encoder-free multimodal model intended to handle language and visual modalities within a single model family.
summary_en.importance: The relevant signal for pretraining researchers is the encoder-free multimodal direction. It pushes against the common VLM stack of a separate vision encoder, projector, and LLM, and therefore matters for visual tokenization, unified representations, and native multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The title states that the model is unified and encoder-free, suggesting that it reduces or removes a standalone vision encoder and integrates multimodal information more directly into the LM backbone or a shared token stream. The provided metadata does not reveal the visual tokenization method, data mixture, context format, loss design, or generation support.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is unavailable, so training data, benchmarks, baselines, inference cost, and result numbers cannot be verified from the provided information. The only explicit model specification is the 12B parameter scale.
summary_en.authors_note: Published by Google DeepMind as a Gemma model blog; no specific author list is provided. The Gemma line is associated with Google's open-weight small-model efforts, but technical details cannot be confirmed from the metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: encoder-free multimodal 值得读方法细节；先找 tokenizer 和数据混合，博客指标不足以改变 VLM prior。
recommendation.en: The encoder-free multimodal claim is worth inspecting, but look first for tokenizer and data-mixture details; blog metrics alone should not move your VLM priors.

paper.title: Explicit Representation Alignment for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
paper.abstract: Multimodal affective analysis aims to understand human sentiment and emotion by jointly modeling heterogeneous modalities such as text and images. However, multimodal models often fail to consistently outperform strong text-only baselines, with performance varying significantly across fusion strategies. In this work, we identify representation misalignment between independently pretrained modality encoders as a key bottleneck for effective multimodal learning, and show through controlled experim

summary.core_problem: 多模态情感分析中，多模态模型往往无法稳定超过强文本-only baseline，性能随融合策略波动大。
summary.importance: 方法创新。通过控制实验指出：融合前的表示对齐通常比融合复杂度更重要；提出基于 VLM 的显式表示对齐框架。
summary.technical_approach: 利用 VLM 将视觉内容转换为结构化文本描述，把异质模态投影到共享语言空间，实现可解释的以文本为中心的推理；引入混合学习策略结合语义 token 选择进一步提升鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 通过控制实验展示对齐前于融合的重要性；未报告具体 benchmark 上的量化成绩。

summary_en.core_problem: In multimodal sentiment analysis, multimodal models often fail to consistently outperform strong text-only baselines, with performance varying significantly across fusion strategies.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation. Controlled experiments reveal that representation alignment before fusion is often more important than fusion complexity; proposes a VLM-based explicit representation alignment framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses VLMs to convert visual content into structured textual descriptions, projecting heterogeneous modalities into a shared linguistic space for interpretable text-centric reasoning; adds a hybrid learning strategy with semantic token selection for robustness.
summary_en.experiments: Controlled experiments demonstrate the importance of pre-fusion alignment; specific benchmark quantitative results not fully reported in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 观察（对齐比融合复杂更重要）对多模态预训练有微弱启发，属于小领域任务的增量方法，不值得深读。
recommendation.en: The observation (alignment matters more than fusion complexity) offers weak signal for multimodal pretraining; otherwise an incremental method in a niche task — not worth deep reading.

paper.title: CapRL++: Unified Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Dense Image and Video Captioning
paper.abstract: Image and video captioning are fundamental tasks that bridge the visual and linguistic domains, playing a critical role in pre-training Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Current state-of-the-art captioning models are typically trained with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), a paradigm that relies on expensive, non-scalable annotations and often causes models to memorize specific ground-truth answers, limiting their generality and ability to generate diverse, creative descriptions. To overcome the

summary.core_problem: 多模态captioning用SFT依赖昂贵标注且易记忆参考答案，难以用可扩展信号优化开放式描述质量。
summary.importance: 把RLVR（可验证奖励）从“有唯一答案”的任务扩展到开放式caption，通过“效用型”可验证信号构造奖励；对VLM后训练与可验证信号设计有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: CapRL++：两阶段解耦训练，先由LVLM生成caption，再用非视觉语言模型基于caption回答与图像/视频相关的问题，把“能否支撑问答”作为reference-free可验证奖励来做RL优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据、具体基线与提升幅度；任务覆盖dense image/video captioning，核心对比应为SFT captioning与其他RL/metric优化方案。

summary_en.core_problem: SFT-based multimodal captioning relies on costly annotations and tends to memorize references, limiting generality for open-ended descriptions.
summary_en.importance: Extends RL with verifiable rewards to open-ended captioning by turning caption quality into a utility-based, reference-free verifiable signal; relevant to VLM post-training and reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: CapRL++ uses a decoupled two-stage pipeline: an LVLM generates captions, and a non-visual LM answers questions conditioned on the caption; QA success serves as a verifiable reward for RL optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits model sizes, datasets, baselines, and gains; targets dense image/video captioning with comparisons likely against SFT and prior RL/metric-based training.

recommendation.zh: 值得看它怎么把“开放式caption”改造成可验证奖励（读奖励定义与训练管线即可）；但要警惕QA代理带来的reward hacking与分布偏置。
recommendation.en: Read for how they turn open-ended captioning into a verifiable-reward problem (focus on reward + pipeline); watch for QA-agent-induced reward hacking and bias.

paper.title: RhinoVLA Technical Report
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation, but real-time deployment on edge hardware remains challenging. In this work, we identify VLM visual and context tokens as a major source of deployment latency: for GEMM-dominated projection operators, computation grows linearly with the number of input tokens when model dimensions are fixed. Motivated by this observation, we propose RhinoVLA, a deployment-oriented VLA model co-designed with the Huixi R1 edg

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 模型在边缘硬件实时部署时，视觉与上下文 token 数过多导致投影算子和整体推理延迟过高的问题。
summary.importance: 这是部署导向的 VLA 技术报告，价值主要在多模态 token 效率与软硬件协同设计。对做统一多模态预训练的人有一些启发，但离 LLM 基座预训练主线仍有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RhinoVLA：基于 token-efficient 的 Qwen3-VL 骨干和连续动作专家，减少 VLM 侧 token 与计算负担；同时设计统一机器人接口，把 View Registry、72 维物理状态-动作槽位和 robot-instance LoRA 结合起来，以支持异构机器人在共享策略下对齐观测与动作空间；部署上与 Huixi R1 边缘 SoC 协同优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调部署延迟来自输入 token 数线性增长，并声称在跨机器人学习和边缘部署上有效，但未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、主要 baseline 和具体性能/时延数字。更像系统技术报告而非可复用的预训练 recipe。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Huixi Intelligence，属于机器人/VLA 工程团队；从题目和摘要看，重点是 edge deployment 与 VLA 软硬件协同，而不是通用多模态基座训练。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the real-time deployment bottleneck of VLA models on edge hardware, where too many visual and context tokens drive up projection cost and end-to-end latency.
summary_en.importance: This is a deployment-oriented VLA technical report. Its main value lies in multimodal token efficiency and hardware-software co-design. It offers some signal for unified multimodal pretraining, but it is still off the main path of LLM foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: RhinoVLA uses a token-efficient Qwen3-VL backbone plus a continuous action expert to reduce VLM-side token and compute load. It also introduces a unified robot interface combining a View Registry, a 72D physical state-action slot space, and robot-instance LoRA to align heterogeneous robot observations and action schemas under a shared policy, co-designed with the Huixi R1 edge SoC.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract argues that latency scales linearly with input token count for GEMM-dominated projection operators and claims gains in cross-robot learning and edge deployment, but does not report model size, training scale, baselines, or concrete quality/latency numbers. It reads more like a systems technical report than a reusable pretraining recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Huixi Intelligence, apparently a robotics/VLA engineering team. From the title and abstract, the emphasis is edge deployment and VLA hardware-software co-design rather than general multimodal foundation-model training.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 native multimodal，可只看它对 token 数与延迟线性关系的拆解；其余多是机器人接口工程，别误当成预训练论文。
recommendation.en: If you work on native multimodal models, only the token-count vs latency breakdown is worth skimming; the rest is mostly robotics interface engineering.

paper.title: ViCuR: Visual Cues as Recoverable Privilege for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning by training a student on trajectories sampled from its own policy under supervision from a teacher. In multimodal reasoning, a common extension is to use a privileged teacher that observes training-time-only signals such as reference answers or rationales. However, such answer-side privilege creates a train-test mismatch: the teacher's supervision may depend on signals unavailable to the student, encouraging shortcut imitation rather than visually

summary.core_problem: ViCuR 解决的是多模态 on-policy distillation 中 privileged teacher 的信号选择问题。已有方法常把参考答案、rationale 或反馈作为 teacher 的额外输入，但这些 answer-side privilege 在推理时不可恢复，学生容易模仿答案相关捷径，而不是学习从图像或视频中找证据。
summary.importance: 这篇工作和预训练的关系在于 post-train 信号质量与多模态推理能力的接口。它提醒一个关键点：teacher 更强不一定来自更多答案信息，也可以来自更好的证据提示。对 VLM 的 SFT/RL/OPD 训练来说，可恢复的视觉证据比不可恢复的答案侧信息更接近测试时分布，因而更适合作为训练时 privilege。这个思路也能反馈到预训练数据设计：多模态数据不只要有答案，还要有可定位、可恢复、可验证的视觉证据。
summary.technical_approach: ViCuR 将 teacher 的额外条件从答案或 rationale 换成 visual cues，即由图像/视频和问题派生的任务相关视觉证据描述。cue 文本只在训练时给 teacher，但 cue 的来源仍在学生推理时可见的视觉输入中，因此降低了 privilege-induced train-test mismatch。学生端没有显式 cue 输入，所以作者加入轻量 cue recovery module：在若干 Transformer 层放置一个指定 sink token，并配套专门的 cross-attention 参数。prefill 阶段，这个 token 从视觉 token 中聚合与任务相关的信息，形成内部 cue-level representation。该模块只通过 distillation objective 端到端训练，不改变推理接口，也不增加自回归生成开销。方法既可用于同 backbone 的 privileged-teacher self-distillation，也可用于更强 teacher 的 OPD；模型规模优势和 privilege 设计被视为正交因素。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-VL-2B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B 学生，在七个多模态推理 benchmark 上评测。相较 answer-based OPSD，ViCuR 的平均性能分别提升 +1.19 和 +1.24，在域内和近域数学推理任务上增益更明显。在 stronger-teacher OPD 设置下，ViCuR 相比 OPD baseline 进一步提升 +0.64 和 +1.08；8B 规模下还表现出更稳定的域外收益。实验结论支持作者的核心假设：视觉 cue 作为可恢复 privilege，比答案侧 privilege 更少诱导 shortcut imitation，也更容易转化为学生推理时可用的视觉证据获取能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 25–35 分钟。重点看 §3.1 对 privilege-induced mismatch 的形式化说明，这是方法成立的关键；再看 §3.2–§3.4 的 cue recovery module、训练目标和 OPD/OPSD 设置。实验部分优先看七个 benchmark 的平均结果、2B/8B 规模对比、answer-based OPSD 对照，以及 stronger-teacher OPD 结果。若时间有限，架构图和消融表比具体 benchmark 描述更值得看。

summary_en.core_problem: ViCuR studies what kind of privileged information should be given to a teacher in multimodal on-policy distillation. Existing methods often condition the teacher on reference answers, rationales, or feedback. Such answer-side privilege is unavailable at inference time, so the student can learn to imitate answer-aware shortcuts instead of grounding its reasoning in the visual input.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to the interface between post-training signals and multimodal pretraining objectives. Its main lesson is that a stronger teacher should not rely on information the student can never recover at test time. Visual evidence is a better privileged signal than answer-side information when the goal is grounded reasoning. This also informs multimodal data design: training examples should expose recoverable and verifiable evidence, not only final answers or polished rationales.
summary_en.technical_approach: ViCuR replaces answer-based privilege with visual cues: question-relevant evidence derived from the same image or video available to the student at inference. The cue text is only given to the teacher during training, but its source remains present in the standard visual-question input. This reduces the train-test mismatch induced by inaccessible privileged variables. Since the student does not receive cues explicitly, the method adds a lightweight cue recovery module. A designated sink token with dedicated cross-attention parameters is inserted at selected transformer layers. During prefill, this token aggregates task-relevant information from visual tokens into an internal cue-level representation. The module is trained end-to-end only through the distillation objective, keeps the inference interface unchanged, and adds no autoregressive decoding overhead. The same idea applies to privileged-teacher self-distillation and to stronger-teacher OPD.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3-VL-2B and Qwen3-VL-8B students across seven multimodal reasoning benchmarks. Compared with answer-based OPSD, ViCuR improves average performance by +1.19 and +1.24, with stronger gains on in-domain and near-domain mathematical reasoning tasks. In stronger-teacher OPD, it improves over OPD baselines by +0.64 and +1.08, and the 8B setting shows consistent out-of-domain gains. These results support the central claim that recoverable visual privilege is more useful for student learning than answer-side privilege.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Focus on §3.1 for the formal treatment of privilege-induced mismatch, then read §3.2–§3.4 for the cue recovery module and the OPD/OPSD training setup. In the experiments, prioritize the average results over seven benchmarks, the 2B versus 8B comparison, the answer-based OPSD baseline, and the stronger-teacher OPD results. If time is limited, the architecture figure and ablation tables are more informative than the benchmark-by-benchmark descriptions.

recommendation.zh: 对多模态蒸馏有启发——特权信号设计思路可迁移到文本蒸馏（如用输入侧特征而非答案侧监督做on-policy蒸馏）。看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Instructive for multimodal distillation — the idea of using input-side recoverable privilege can be transferred to text distillation. Read the method section only.

paper.title: USAD 2.0: Scaling Representation Distillation for Universal Audio Understanding
paper.abstract: Audio encoders are critical to modern audio applications as large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on a single encoder for diverse inputs. While self-supervised learning (SSL) has yielded strong domain-specific encoders like speech or music experts, multi-domain approaches like USAD and SPEAR remain limited in coverage and evaluation. Recent studies also suggest supervised encoders align better with audio LLMs. We present USAD 2.0, a universal encoder integrating knowledge from both SSL

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是通用音频编码器的知识整合问题：单一 SSL 音频模型通常只擅长 speech、general audio 或 music 中的一个域，而音频 LLM 又需要一个覆盖多域、可直接接入下游大模型的前端编码器。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在跨域表示蒸馏。USAD 2.0 不是重新设计音频 tokenizer，也不是端到端训练 audio LLM，而是把多个领域专家编码器的隐层知识压到一个统一 encoder 中。这个思路和 LLM 预训练中的数据配比、teacher mixture、domain routing 很接近：不同数据域不应无差别地对齐所有 teacher，而应根据输入域调整蒸馏信号强度。第二阶段引入监督式音频 foundation encoder，也说明纯 SSL 表示未必最适合作为 LLM 前端；面向 LLM 接入时，ASR、captioning 等监督信号可能提供更直接的语义对齐。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从 USAD 的 layer-wise representation distillation 出发。原始 USAD 把 speech SSL teacher 和 general-audio SSL teacher 的多层 hidden states 蒸馏到一个 student encoder 中，所有 teacher loss 等权。USAD 2.0 的关键改动是 domain-aware distillation：如果样本来自某个已知音频域，就提高对应 teacher 的 loss 权重，同时保留其他 teacher 的较小权重。论文用一个系数 alpha 控制 matched teacher 和 mismatched teacher 的权重比；alpha=1 退化为普通均匀蒸馏，alpha 趋近无穷则接近只蒸馏域内 teacher。作者选择软权重而不是硬路由，是因为音频域之间有重叠，例如 speech 常出现在复杂环境声中，speech teacher 的去噪和语音结构知识仍可能帮助 mixed audio。第二个改动是加入 music teacher 和音乐数据，补齐 USAD 在音乐任务上的短板。第三个改动是 USAD 2.0+：先做 SSL teacher 的多域蒸馏，再用强监督音频 encoder 做第二阶段蒸馏，使 encoder 更贴近音频 LLM、检索、语音编码等使用场景。最后，论文把模型扩到 1B 参数，采用降低时间分辨率并加深网络的方式控制计算成本。
summary.experiments: 论文评估覆盖 probing 和 LLM-based evaluation 两类。前者检查 encoder 表示在 speech、general audio、music 任务上的线性可用性；后者更接近真实音频 LLM 前端的使用方式。关键实验点包括：加入 music teacher 后，音乐相关任务如 genre、key classification 的短板得到改善；domain-aware distillation 相比等权蒸馏更稳，因为它减少了 teacher-domain mismatch 带来的干扰；第二阶段监督蒸馏提升了面向 LLM 应用的可用性；1B 深度扩展版本在保持成本可控的同时进一步提高整体表现。文中还通过消融和可视化分析说明 alpha、teacher 组合、第二阶段监督 teacher 对最终表示的影响。给定内容中没有提供完整表格数值，精读时应以主实验表和 ablation 表为准核对具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20-30 分钟。优先看方法部分的 domain-aware distillation 公式，理解它和 hard domain routing、uniform teacher averaging 的差别。然后看 teacher 组合与第二阶段监督蒸馏的消融，这部分最能反映论文对训练信号质量的判断。实验部分重点看三类域的 probing 结果，以及 LLM-based evaluation 是否真的改变了模型选择结论。1B scaling 部分可以快速看，重点不是架构新意，而是作者如何在音频序列较长的条件下降低时间分辨率、用 depth scaling 换取容量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical representation-learning problem for audio LLMs: a single audio frontend has to cover speech, general audio, and music, while most existing SSL encoders are specialized for only one of these domains.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in the training recipe rather than in a new model family. USAD 2.0 treats universal audio representation learning as a multi-teacher distillation problem with domain-dependent loss weighting. This is relevant to pretraining because it mirrors a broader issue in foundation models: heterogeneous data sources and heterogeneous teachers should not necessarily contribute uniform gradients. The second-stage distillation from supervised audio encoders is also informative. It suggests that SSL representations may be strong under probing, but supervised encoders can be better aligned with audio LLM usage, where semantic and task-facing information matters more than low-level acoustic completeness.
summary_en.technical_approach: USAD 2.0 extends the original USAD framework, which performs layer-wise representation distillation from multiple SSL teachers into one student encoder. The new component is domain-aware distillation. For an input from a known domain, the loss from the matching teacher is upweighted, while losses from non-matching teachers are kept active with smaller weights. A scalar alpha controls the ratio between matched and mismatched teachers. This avoids two extremes: uniform teacher averaging, which ignores teacher specialization, and hard domain routing, which discards useful cross-domain structure. The paper then adds a music-domain teacher and music data to cover tasks where the original USAD was weak. USAD 2.0+ further introduces a second supervised distillation stage from strong task-trained audio encoders, aiming to make the representation more suitable as an audio LLM frontend. The largest variant is scaled to one billion parameters mainly through depth scaling while reducing temporal resolution to keep cost manageable.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation combines probing tasks and LLM-based evaluations across speech, general audio, and music. The reported findings are consistent with the design: adding a music teacher improves music-centric tasks such as genre and key classification; domain-aware weighting is better than equal teacher weighting because it reduces teacher-domain mismatch; supervised second-stage distillation improves downstream usefulness for LLM-style applications; and the 1B model benefits from scaling without changing the basic framework. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, so the exact margins should be checked in the main result and ablation tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20-30 minutes. Read the domain-aware distillation formulation first, especially the role of alpha and the decision to keep mismatched teachers active. Then inspect the teacher-combination ablations and the second-stage supervised distillation results. The most relevant part for pretraining researchers is not the audio benchmark list, but the evidence about how teacher choice, domain weighting, and supervised alignment change the learned representation. The 1B scaling section is worth a quick pass for its compute-control choices under long audio sequences.

recommendation.zh: 做统一多模态前端的人可以看：价值不在“又一个音频 encoder”，而在 teacher mismatch 和 supervised distillation 这两个接口问题；先看蒸馏设计与 LLM-based eval。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about unified multimodal front-ends: the signal is not 'another audio encoder' but the teacher-mismatch and supervised-distillation interface; start with the distillation design and LLM-based evals.

paper.title: VideoKR: Towards Knowledge- and Reasoning-Intensive Video Understanding
paper.abstract: We introduce VideoKR, the first large-scale training corpus specifically designed to strengthen knowledge- and reasoning-intensive video understanding. It comprises 315K video reasoning examples over 145K newly collected, CC-licensed, expert-domain videos. We develop a human-in-the-loop, skill-oriented example generation pipeline that targets progressively deeper video reasoning capabilities while ensuring the difficulty, diversity, and reliability of both the examples and their CoT rationales.

summary.core_problem: 解决现有视频理解后训练数据偏浅层、容易走文本捷径，导致模型在知识密集和推理密集的视频问答上能力不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是高质量训练数据和评测集：315K 视频推理样本的 VideoKR 训练语料，以及专家标注的 VideoKR-Eval。对多模态后训练和数据设计有参考价值，但它不是统一多模态预训练或新建模范式工作。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了一个 human-in-the-loop、按技能分层的视频推理样本生成流程，强调难度、覆盖面和 CoT rationale 的可靠性；再在标准 SFT→GRPO 流水线上对模型做后训练，检验数据设计是否能提升知识与推理密集型视频理解。核心创新点在数据构造与任务定义，而不是模型架构。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 145K 新收集的 CC 授权专家领域视频，生成 315K 训练样本，并构建了新的专家标注评测集 VideoKR-Eval。实验显示，在标准 SFT→GRPO pipeline 下，使用 VideoKR 后训练的模型优于以往视频推理后训练方法，同时在通用视频推理上保持竞争力。摘要未给出具体 backbone、参数量和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Arman Cohan、Yilun Zhao。机构信息未在给定材料中完整提供。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of deep, knowledge- and reasoning-intensive supervision in video understanding, where existing post-training data often permits shallow textual shortcuts.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a high-quality training corpus and evaluation set: 315K video reasoning examples in VideoKR and an expert-annotated benchmark, VideoKR-Eval. This is relevant to multimodal post-training and data design, but it is not a unified multimodal pretraining or modeling-paradigm paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds a human-in-the-loop, skill-oriented pipeline for generating video reasoning examples, with emphasis on difficulty, diversity, and reliable CoT rationales. Models are then post-trained with a standard SFT-to-GRPO pipeline to test whether better data design improves knowledge- and reasoning-intensive video understanding. The novelty is in data construction and task design rather than architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset covers 145K newly collected CC-licensed expert-domain videos and 315K training examples, plus a new expert-annotated benchmark, VideoKR-Eval. The abstract claims that post-training on VideoKR outperforms prior post-training approaches on knowledge-intensive video reasoning while remaining competitive on general video reasoning. Backbone sizes and exact gains are not given in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Arman Cohan and Yilun Zhao. Full institutional attribution is not fully recoverable from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心多模态 post-train 数据配方，可以看；对基座 pretrain 直接帮助有限，重点只在数据构造流程和 eval 设计。
recommendation.en: Worth a look if you care about multimodal post-training data recipes, but the direct pretraining payoff is limited; focus on the data pipeline and eval design.

paper.title: PaintBench: Deterministic Evaluation of Precise Visual Editing
paper.abstract: While current multimodal models are proficient at open-ended visual editing, executing precise single-answer edits remains an important obstacle. To probe this challenge, we introduce PaintBench, a dynamically scalable benchmark targeting 20 fundamental precise visual editing operations across four categories: geometric transformation, structural manipulation, color change, and symbolic reasoning. Procedural generation with configurable complexity enables an effectively infinite, contamination-r

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉编辑评测里“开放式主观判断多、难以精确衡量单一正确编辑”的问题，构建可程序化、可扩展、确定性的精细视觉编辑 benchmark。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark 与评测协议。它的价值不在于提升模型，而在于把精确视觉编辑拆成 20 类基础操作，并用程序生成和像素级确定性指标减少 judge bias 与数据污染。对多模态统一建模研究员，意义在于暴露当前模型在精确控制上的短板。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 PaintBench，通过程序化生成任务实例，覆盖几何变换、结构操作、颜色修改和符号推理四大类共 20 种编辑操作。评测采用可扩展复杂度设置与像素级 deterministic evaluation，而不是依赖 LLM/VLM judge。这样可以更干净地区分模型是不会编辑、不会遵循约束，还是只会做开放式“看起来差不多”的修改。
summary.experiments: 在 11 个图像编辑模型上评测，摘要给出的最好结果只有 17.1% mIoU，说明精确编辑远未解决。论文还做了按任务类型和模型类型的细分诊断，指出几何变换、结构操作和公式驱动颜色变化尤其困难。对预训练研究员，值得看的不是榜单本身，而是 failure taxonomy 是否能反推视觉 tokenizer、编辑表示和训练目标的问题。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Rob Fergus、He He、Saining Xie，属于学界较强的视觉/多模态研究者组合。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of deterministic, precise evaluation for visual editing, where open-ended judging often fails to measure single-correct-answer edits.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark and evaluation-protocol contribution. Its value is not in improving models, but in decomposing precise visual editing into 20 primitive operations and using procedural generation plus pixel-level deterministic metrics to reduce judge bias and contamination. For multimodal pretraining researchers, it exposes where current models fail at controllable editing.
summary_en.technical_approach: PaintBench procedurally generates tasks spanning four categories—geometric transformation, structural manipulation, color change, and symbolic reasoning—with 20 editing operations in total. Evaluation is dynamically scalable in complexity and uses deterministic pixel-level scoring rather than LLM/VLM judges. This makes it easier to separate failures of editing ability, constraint following, and superficial open-ended plausibility.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 11 image-editing models, with the best model reaching only 17.1% mIoU according to the abstract, suggesting that precise editing remains weak. The paper also reports per-operation and per-model diagnostics, highlighting geometric transforms, structural edits, and formula-based color changes as especially hard. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is not the leaderboard itself but whether the failure taxonomy points back to tokenizer, representation, or objective issues.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Rob Fergus, He He, and Saining Xie, a recognizable academic lineup in vision and multimodal research.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座必读，但做原生多模态生成/编辑的人应看任务拆解；只读 benchmark 设计和失败分布，榜单分数本身信息不大。
recommendation.en: Not core foundation-model reading, but worth checking if you work on native multimodal generation/editing; read the task decomposition and failure breakdown, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: TRON: Targeted Rule-Verifiable Online Environments for Visual Reasoning RL
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for visual reasoning needs scalable, verifiable, and controllable training signals. Existing visual RL post-training trains on static curated datasets, with fixed image-question-answer samples bounded by their collection budget. In this work, we introduce TRON (Targeted, Rule-verifiable Online eNvironments), an online environment substrate: a training rollout is generated on demand by a controllable generator-verifier program that samples a fresh latent visual state,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：视觉推理 RL 缺少可扩展、可验证、可控的在线训练信号，现有做法依赖静态数据集，难以持续生成新样本和做课程学习。
summary.importance: 贡献更接近训练环境/数据生成 substrate，而不是基座模型本身。对关心 online RL、可验证训练信号、以及多模态 post-training 的研究员有参考价值。对 pretrain 的启发主要在“程序化环境生成 + verifier”这条数据闭环思路。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 TRON，一个 targeted rule-verifiable online environment 框架。每次 rollout 由 generator-verifier 程序按需采样潜在视觉状态、渲染图像、生成问题并精确验证答案，因此可以无限生成新实例，并按当前 curriculum 控制难度。当前套件包含 520 个环境，覆盖 spatial、mathematical、diagram、pattern/logic、counting 五类能力；既支持单一全能模型，也支持按能力桶训练 specialist 模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型规模，但给出了环境规模：520 个环境、5 个能力桶。实验重点应是比较静态视觉 RL 数据与在线环境训练在样本新鲜度、可验证性、课程学习和泛化上的差异，并展示 full model 与 per-bucket specialist 的训练表现。由于是环境平台型工作，结果更应看训练曲线、难度扩展和跨环境泛化，而不是单点榜单分数。
summary.authors_note: University of Georgia 团队。不是头部基座实验室，但问题设定和方法形态与近期可验证 RL、程序化环境训练的方向一致。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a bottleneck in visual reasoning RL: current post-training pipelines rely on static curated datasets, which do not provide scalable, controllable, and verifiable online training signals.
summary_en.importance: This is more of a training-environment/data-substrate contribution than a foundation-model one. It is relevant to researchers interested in online RL, verifiable supervision, and multimodal post-training. The pretraining-adjacent insight is the closed loop of procedural generation plus exact verification.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRON is a targeted, rule-verifiable online environment framework. For each rollout, a generator-verifier program samples a latent visual state, renders an image, asks a question, and exactly verifies the answer. This yields an effectively unbounded stream of fresh instances with curriculum-controlled difficulty. The current suite contains 520 environments across five ability buckets: spatial, mathematical, diagram, pattern/logic, and counting. It supports both a single generalist model and per-bucket specialist models.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, but it does specify the environment scale: 520 environments in five buckets. The key experiments likely compare static visual-RL data against online environment training in terms of freshness, verifiability, curriculum learning, and generalization, and also contrast a single full model with ability specialists. For this kind of paper, training curves and out-of-distribution generalization matter more than leaderboard snapshots.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from the University of Georgia. Not a frontier foundation-model lab, but the setup aligns with the broader trend of verifiable RL and procedurally generated training environments.

recommendation.zh: 更像多模态 RL 训练基建，不是基座 pretrain；如果你在想“可验证在线数据流”怎么替代静态后训练集，这篇的环境设计值得借鉴，其他部分可略读。
recommendation.en: This is multimodal RL infrastructure rather than core pretraining; read it if you're thinking about replacing static post-training sets with verifiable online data streams, otherwise a quick skim is enough.

paper.title: Attention-guided Fine-tuning of Multimodal Large Language Models Improves Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

summary.core_problem: 摘要不可用，基于标题分析：通过注意力引导的微调提升多模态大模型的思维链推理能力
summary.importance: 探索VLM微调策略对推理能力的影响，对多模态后训练有启发
summary.technical_approach: 采用注意力引导（attention-guided）的微调方法，针对多模态大模型
summary.experiments: 摘要不可用，无法判断实验内容

summary_en.core_problem: Abstract unavailable, based on title: Improving Chain-of-Thought reasoning in multimodal LLMs through attention-guided fine-tuning
summary_en.importance: Explores VLM fine-tuning strategies for reasoning capability, relevant for multimodal post-training
summary_en.technical_approach: Employs attention-guided fine-tuning for multimodal LLMs
