summary_en.authors_note: University of Virginia, authors include Sanchit Sinha, Aidong Zhang, etc.

recommendation.zh: 注意力引导微调VLM提升CoT，对理解多模态推理有弱启发，但与LLM纯文本预训练无直接交集，glance即可
recommendation.en: Attention-guided VLM fine-tuning for CoT improvement has weak relevance to pure-text LLM pretraining; glance suffices

paper.title: AlbedoEdit: Unified Instance-Level Video Editing with Albedo Guidance
paper.abstract: Video generative models have achieved remarkable progress in synthesizing photorealistic video sequences. However, enabling broader and more creative downstream applications requires fine-grained instance-level video editing, including object insertion, object removal, and texture editing, which has emerged as a prominent yet challenging problem. Existing approaches either propose unified generative frameworks with only coarse semantic control, or design task-specific frameworks for individual e

summary.core_problem: 解决视频实例级细粒度编辑（对象插入、移除、纹理编辑）的统一框架缺失问题
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次提出基于albedo引导的统一视频编辑框架，支持三种核心编辑任务
summary.technical_approach: 核心insight是利用本征albedo图（光照不变、无镜面反射/阴影/互反射）作为细粒度编辑控制信号，构建统一生成视频编辑框架
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型规模、训练数据或对比实验细节，论文来自NVIDIA Research与马克斯普朗克研究所等
summary.authors_note: 主要来自NVIDIA Research、马克斯普朗克信息学研究所、UC Santa Barbara、Texas A&M；Christian Theobalt是资深图形学/视觉研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Lack of a unified framework for fine-grained instance-level video editing (object insertion, removal, and texture editing)
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: first unified generative video editing framework supporting three core editing tasks via albedo guidance
summary_en.technical_approach: Key insight: intrinsic albedo maps (lighting-invariant, free of specularity/shadow/inter-reflection) provide effective fine-grained editing control signals; builds a unified generative video editing framework
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not provide specific model size, training data, or benchmark details; work is from NVIDIA Research, Max Planck Institute, UCSB, and Texas A&M
summary_en.authors_note: Primarily from NVIDIA Research, Max Planck Institute for Informatics, UC Santa Barbara, and Texas A&M; Christian Theobalt is a senior graphics/vision researcher

recommendation.zh: 视频编辑领域的方法创新，但与LLM基座预训练无直接关联，作为多模态生成领域的进展仅需了解，不值得深读
recommendation.en: Video editing method innovation but not directly relevant to LLM foundation pretraining; worth knowing about as multimodal progress but not worth deep reading.

paper.title: ReGuLaR: Relation-Grounded Latent Reasoning for Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly improved the reasoning ability of large vision-language models (LVLMs) by verbalizing intermediate reasoning steps in natural language. However, such discrete textual rationales are often insufficient for encoding continuous visual evidence. Recent work addresses this limitation by moving reasoning into continuous latent space. Despite promising progress, existing methods leave latent reasoning insufficiently connected to the compositional and r

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型(LVLM)的隐空间推理方法未能充分利用视觉证据中的组合关系结构——离散文本CoT不足以编码连续视觉证据，而现有隐空间推理方法忽略了物体间关系。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次提出将隐空间推理显式grounding在视觉关系结构上，连接了隐空间推理与视觉组合性。贡献还包括一个351K的合成推理训练数据集RGROUNDING-351K。
summary.technical_approach: ReGuLaR框架：训练时使用ReGFormer(关系感知Transformer)将隐推理状态聚焦于问题相关的物体和物体间关系；推理时无需调用ReGFormer，模型直接推理并生成答案。本质上是一种训练时的额外监督信号。
summary.experiments: 构建RGROUNDING-351K数据集(351K样本)用于训练。实验对比了现有隐空间推理方法，验证了关系grounding的有效性。
summary.authors_note: University of California, Santa Barbara。无特别知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing latent reasoning methods for LVLMs fail to leverage the compositional relational structure in visual evidence—discrete text CoT is insufficient for continuous visual evidence, and current latent reasoning methods ignore inter-object relations.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: first to explicitly ground latent reasoning in visual relational structure, bridging latent space reasoning and visual compositionality. Also contributes RGROUNDING-351K, a 351K synthetic reasoning training dataset.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReGuLaR framework: during training, a ReGFormer (relation-aware Transformer) focuses latent reasoning states on question-relevant objects and inter-object relations; at inference, the model reasons and generates answers without invoking the ReGFormer. Essentially an extra training-time supervision signal.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs RGROUNDING-351K (351K samples) for training. Experiments compare with existing latent reasoning methods, validating the effectiveness of relation grounding.
summary_en.authors_note: University of California, Santa Barbara. No particularly well-known authors.

recommendation.zh: 多模态推理方法的增量改进，训练时引入额外关系监督但推理时移除——类似知识蒸馏思路。对LLM pretrain研究员无直接启示，作为literature备查。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement in multimodal reasoning with extra relation supervision at training only—similar to knowledge distillation. No direct insight for LLM pretraining; file as literature reference.

paper.title: DeMaVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Generalizable Deformable Manipulation
paper.abstract: Real-world household robots require Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models that can acquire reusable manipulation skills across diverse objects, task conditions, and household environments. Deformable-object folding is a representative challenge, requiring robots to handle clothing items from random initial states across varying categories, geometries, materials, and scenes. However, existing VLA systems commonly train separate policies for different object categories, while naively mixe

summary.core_problem: 现有VLA系统通常为不同物体类别训练独立策略，混合多任务训练存在任务干扰和性能下降问题，难以实现可泛化的可变形物体操作
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出统一的视觉-语言-动作基础模型用于可变形物体操作，采用流匹配生成连续动作
summary.technical_approach: DeMaVLA采用VLM骨干网络加动作专家的结构，使用流匹配公式化连续动作生成；动作专家通过隔层裁剪Transformer层构建，同时保持与VLM骨干的层级对齐
summary.experiments: 论文未完成展示完整实验结果（摘要被截断），涉及衣物折叠等可变形物体操作任务

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLA systems train separate policies for different object categories, and naive mixed multi-task training suffers from task interference and performance degradation, limiting generalizable deformable object manipulation
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a unified vision-language-action foundation model for deformable manipulation using flow matching for continuous action generation
summary_en.technical_approach: DeMaVLA uses a VLM backbone with an action expert, formulating continuous action generation via flow matching; the action expert is built by pruning every other Transformer layer while maintaining layer-wise alignment with the VLM backbone
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental results not fully shown in abstract (truncated); involves deformable object manipulation tasks such as clothing folding

recommendation.zh: 机器人操作领域的多模态VLA工作，对LLM预训练研究员的直接价值有限，仅作领域动态了解
recommendation.en: A multimodal VLA work in robotics manipulation, of limited direct value to LLM pretraining researchers — useful only as field dynamics awareness

paper.title: VLA-Pro: Cross-Task Procedural Memory Transfer for Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action~(VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet they still struggle to generalize to unseen tasks that necessitate transferring relevant experience across objects, scenes, and action patterns. This paper proposes VLA-Pro, a plug-and-play framework designed to enhance cross-task generalization by storing task-relevant procedural memories at training time and transferring these memories during inference. Specifically, VLA-Pro stores tas

summary.core_problem: 提升 Vision-Language-Action 模型在未见机器人任务上的跨任务泛化，尤其是需要迁移对象、场景和动作模式经验的任务。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLA 推理时记忆迁移机制：把任务 LoRA 适配器当作程序性记忆检索和融合。对通用多模态预训练不是直接贡献，但与参数化记忆、adapter 路由和模块组合有关。
summary.technical_approach: VLA-Pro 在训练阶段为不同任务保存 task-specific LoRA adapters，作为参数化 procedural memories；推理时根据当前多模态上下文检索相关记忆，并动态融合这些 LoRA 参数来生成 action chunk。方法是 plug-and-play，可挂在多个 VLA backbone 上。
summary.experiments: 在 RoboTwin、RLBench 和真实机器人操作任务上评估；摘要称多个 backbone 均有提升，仿真中最高达到 207% 相对提升，真实场景成功率也提高，但未给出完整模型规模和绝对数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve cross-task generalization in Vision-Language-Action models for unseen robotic manipulation tasks requiring transfer of object, scene, and action experience.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time procedural-memory transfer mechanism for VLA models. It is not a direct pretraining result, but it is relevant to parametric memory, adapter routing, and modular composition.
summary_en.technical_approach: VLA-Pro stores task-specific LoRA adapters during training as parameterized procedural memories. At inference time, it retrieves memories using the current multimodal context and dynamically fuses the selected adapters to generate the action chunk.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on RoboTwin, RLBench, and real-world manipulation tasks. The abstract reports consistent gains across multiple backbones, with up to 207% relative improvement in simulation and improved real-world success rates, but full absolute metrics and model sizes are not provided.

recommendation.zh: 只看记忆检索和 LoRA 融合设计；机器人结果不必深读，但这个 adapter-as-memory 设定可借鉴到工具和多模态持续学习。
recommendation.en: Skim the retrieval and LoRA-fusion design; the robotics results are secondary, but adapter-as-memory is reusable for tool use and multimodal continual learning.

paper.title: Disagreeing Rationales: Rethinking Classification and Explainability Evaluation in Hate Speech Detection
paper.abstract: Human disagreement is ubiquitous and well-known in labeling. However, variation in explanations, captured through token-level human rationales, remains far less explored. At the same time, it is unclear how to best evaluate human labels and rationales -- or even how to best aggregate rationales beyond majority vote -- in light of this variation. Yet, rationales may provide additional insights into the richness of human reasoning, that may differ in style, values and interpretations -- especially

summary.core_problem: 异构多变量时序数据缺乏通用表示学习方法，现有方法难以处理传感器噪声和跨数据集泛化。
summary.importance: 将JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）范式扩展到时序+文本多模态表示学习，提出了通道级文本描述融合的新方法。
summary.technical_approach: CHARM：对通道顺序等变的Transformer编码器，结合JEPA目标和新型损失促进信息丰富、时序稳定的嵌入；文本描述作为通道标识符辅助跨数据集泛化。
summary.experiments: 在异常检测、分类、短期/长期预测任务上验证，仅用线性探测即取得强性能；JEPA目标和条件架构是主要性能驱动力。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自瑞典林雪平大学和工业界（Utsav Dutta, Gerardo Pastrana, Sina Khoshfetrat Pakazad, Henrik Ohlsson）。

summary_en.core_problem: General-purpose representation learning for heterogeneous multivariate time series is underexplored; existing methods struggle with sensor noise and cross-dataset generalization.
summary_en.importance: Extends JEPA (Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture) paradigm to time-series + text multimodal representation learning with channel-level textual description fusion.
summary_en.technical_approach: CHARM: Transformer encoder equivariant to channel order, trained with JEPA objective and a novel loss promoting informative, temporally stable embeddings; text descriptions serve as channel identifiers for cross-dataset generalization.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on anomaly detection, classification, and short/long-term forecasting; strong performance with linear probe only. JEPA objective and conditioning architecture are main performance drivers.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Linköping University and industry in Sweden (Utsav Dutta, Gerardo Pastrana, Sina Khoshfetrat Pakazad, Henrik Ohlsson).

recommendation.zh: JEPA 扩展到时序多模态的探索，对 LLM 预训练研究员仅有微弱的自监督范式参考价值，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: JEPA extension to time-series multimodality; only weak self-supervised paradigm reference for LLM pretraining researchers; read abstract only.

paper.title: Mind-Omni: A Unified Multi-Task Framework for Brain-Vision-Language Modeling via Discrete Diffusion
paper.abstract: Modeling the interplay between external stimuli and internal neural representations is a pivotal research area for Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs). A major limitation of prior work is the prevailing paradigm of specialized, single-task models, which curtails versatility and neglects inter-task synergies. To address this, we propose Mind-Omni, the first versatile framework that unifies seven distinct encoding and decoding tasks through a discrete diffusion paradigm. At its core is a novel Brain

summary.core_problem: 脑机接口领域现有方法多为单任务专用模型，缺乏能统一多任务并利用任务间协同的通用框架
summary.importance: 首次提出统一七类脑-视-语编码解码任务的多任务框架，核心创新是脑信号Tokenizer和离散扩散建模
summary.technical_approach: Mind-Omni框架：(1) Brain Tokenizer将异构连续脑信号转换为标准离散token；(2) 通过离散扩散在共享语义空间实现多模态token级交互；(3) 构建Brain QA指令微调数据集解锁推理能力
summary.experiments: 在七类任务上取得多任务统一框架中的SOTA；提供了详细的跨任务迁移和协同分析

summary_en.core_problem: BCI research is dominated by specialized single-task models, lacking a versatile framework that unifies multiple tasks and exploits inter-task synergies
summary_en.importance: First versatile framework unifying seven brain-vision-language encoding/decoding tasks via discrete diffusion; core innovation is the Brain Tokenizer for neural signal discretization
summary_en.technical_approach: Mind-Omni framework: (1) Brain Tokenizer converts heterogeneous continuous brain signals to standardized discrete tokens; (2) discrete diffusion enables token-level cross-modal interactions in shared semantic space; (3) Brain QA instruction-tuning dataset unlocks reasoning capabilities
summary_en.experiments: Establishes SOTA among multi-task unified frameworks across seven tasks; provides detailed cross-task transfer and synergy analysis

recommendation.zh: BCI领域的多模态tokenization和离散扩散应用有一定参考价值，但属于非常细分的领域，不建议预训练研究员投入时间
recommendation.en: The Brain Tokenizer and discrete diffusion application in BCI have some architectural novelty but are in a very specialized domain. Not worth a pretraining researcher's time.

paper.title: Rethinking Post-Training Recipes for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
paper.abstract: Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) excel at zero-shot unimodal forecasting using numerical data, but unlike LLMs they cannot consume multimodal, non-numerical context that often shape real-world trajectories. In this work, we bridge this gap and argue for a multimodal time-series forecasting approach that post-trains LLMs to act as context-guided revisors over strong numerical TSFM priors. We introduce PostTime, a post-training recipe combining Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement L

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决多模态时间序列预测中的 post-training 问题：强数值 TSFM 能建模历史曲线，但不能直接利用文本等非数值上下文；LLM 能理解上下文，却不适合直接做数值预测。目标是让 LLM 学会在 TSFM 预测先验之上做有条件的修正，而不是端到端替代数值预测器。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献较弱，更接近 post-training recipe 和训练信号设计。值得关注的点在于它没有把 LLM 当作万能 forecaster，而是把 LLM 放在“context-guided reviser”的位置：判断何时保留 TSFM prior，何时修改，何时忽略上下文噪声。这种分工对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有启发，尤其是如何围绕强外部模型先验构造 SFT traces 和 RLVR reward，而不是让 LLM 从零学习一个它并不擅长的连续数值任务。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 PostTime，包含 SFT 和 RLVR 两个阶段。输入包括历史时间序列、非数值上下文，以及 TimesFM-2.5 给出的 base forecast。LLM 的输出不是简单复刻 ground truth forecast，而是生成 forecast intervention：根据上下文决定 revise、preserve 或 ignore TSFM prior，并给出修正后的预测。SFT 阶段通过自动生成 reasoning traces 训练这个修正策略；trace 由 frontier LLM 生成，具体实例使用 Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite。RLVR 阶段使用可验证奖励强化有效修正，奖励直接围绕最终预测误差和修正是否带来收益设计。实验实例使用 Gemma-3-4B 作为被 post-train 的 LLM，TimesFM-2.5 作为数值先验提供者。
summary.experiments: 实验设置围绕 refreshed TimesX benchmark。比较对象包括强监督模型、TSFM、LLM-only forecast、直接用现成 LLM 修正 TSFM 的方案、ensemble 方法、近期 time-series reasoning 模型和其他多模态预测模型。消融关注几个设计问题：LLM 直接端到端预测是否不如修正 TSFM prior；SFT traces 的生成质量如何影响结果；训练数据是否覆盖 revise/preserve/ignore 的完整策略空间；RLVR 是否进一步改善多模态预测精度。提供的内容没有包含具体误差指标、提升幅度或显著性结果，因此只能确认实验设计和模型规模，不能确认定量收益。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读即可，预计 20-30 分钟。重点看方法部分中 LLM policy 的定义、forecast intervention 的格式、SFT trace 自动生成流程、RLVR reward 设计，以及消融实验。对 LLM 预训练研究者来说，最有用的是“LLM 作为强模型先验的修正器”这一训练接口，而不是时间序列任务本身。若只关心通用基座训练，可跳过大部分 benchmark 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to post-train an LLM for multimodal time-series forecasting when a strong numerical time-series foundation model is already available. The issue is a capability mismatch: TSFMs are good numerical forecasters but cannot directly use rich textual context, while LLMs can interpret context but are weak as standalone numerical predictors.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but the post-training design is useful. The key lesson is to avoid training the LLM to replace a specialized numerical model. Instead, the LLM is trained as a context-conditioned reviser over a strong prior forecast. This is a clean example of post-training around an external model prior, with SFT traces and verifiable RL rewards shaped around when to revise, when to preserve, and when to ignore contextual information.
summary_en.technical_approach: PostTime uses a two-stage recipe: supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. The LLM receives the historical time series, non-numeric context, and a base forecast produced by a TSFM. Rather than directly generating the entire forecast from scratch, it produces a forecast intervention: a decision and revision conditioned on whether the context should modify the TSFM prior. The concrete instantiation post-trains Gemma-3-4B, uses TimesFM-2.5 as the numerical prior provider, and generates automated reasoning traces with Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite. The RLVR stage reinforces interventions that improve final forecasting accuracy under a verifiable numerical reward.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental plan is built around a refreshed TimesX benchmark. The comparisons include supervised forecasting models, TSFMs, LLM-only forecasting, off-the-shelf LLM plus TSFM revision, ensemble baselines, time-series reasoning models, and multimodal forecasting systems. The ablations target the main recipe choices: direct forecasting versus revision, the quality and coverage of SFT traces, the revise/preserve/ignore policy space, and the incremental effect of RLVR. The provided content names the models and benchmark but does not include concrete error metrics or improvement numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient for most pretraining researchers. Spend 20-30 minutes on the policy formulation, the intervention format, the automated trace-generation procedure, the RLVR reward, and the ablations. The main transferable idea is the interface design: use the LLM to conditionally edit a strong model prior rather than forcing it to learn a continuous numerical task end to end. The detailed time-series benchmark results are less relevant unless forecasting is a target application.

recommendation.zh: RLVR+SFT的两阶段后训练配方对思考如何将领域基础模型与LLM结合有参考价值，重点看§3的奖励设计和§4的实验对比。
recommendation.en: The two-stage SFT+RLVR post-training recipe is informative for thinking about domain foundation model + LLM integration; focus on §3 reward design and §4 experiments.

paper.title: Learning When to Think While Listening in Large Audio-Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have made real-time, streaming spoken interaction increasingly practical. In this setting, reasoning quality and responsiveness are tightly coupled: delaying reasoning until the speech endpoint can improve answer quality but moves deliberation into user-visible response delay, while answering too early risks committing before decisive evidence arrives. We introduce a learnable wait-think-answer control formulation for LALMs. Motivated by the

summary.core_problem: 论文研究流式语音大模型在听用户说话的过程中，何时等待、何时生成中间思考、何时给出答案。
summary.importance: 这篇论文与文本基座预训练的关系较间接，但对语音 LM 和 post-train 控制信号有启发。它把实时 spoken reasoning 看成一个显式控制问题，而不是完整听完音频后再生成 CoT。对统一多模态 LM 来说，这类 wait-think-answer 动作空间提供了一种训练流式推理行为的接口：模型不仅学习答案内容，也学习在部分观测下管理推理状态和延迟。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把 LALM 建模为在线 controller。每个决策步的输入是目前为止的完整音频前缀，加上已经外显的 reasoning state。动作空间被限制为三类：<wait/> 表示继续听，不更新可见推理状态；<think>...</think> 表示在当前音频证据下写入一个中间推理更新；<answer>...</answer> 表示提交最终回答。作者基于 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 构建系统，先从 spoken reasoning 数据生成对齐的 wait-think-answer traces：把文本输入渲染成语音，将文本动作对齐到音频时间，并转换成链式 streaming windows。训练分两阶段：先做 SFT，再用 DAPO 做策略优化。奖励包含六类信号：答案正确性、动作合法性、更新时间、延迟同步、thought 质量和 chain consistency。论文当前采用 endpoint-gated answer，即最终答复仍受语音端点约束，重点放在听的过程中分摊推理成本。
summary.experiments: 实验主要看准确率和 endpoint 后残余思考长度之间的折中。在 synthetic spoken reasoning 上，六奖励 DAPO controller 将 row-weighted accuracy 从 base deployment controller 的 67.6% 提升到 70.3%，同时把 endpoint 后 final-think 长度从 10.44 token 降到 8.99 token。作者还在 Real Audio Bench 上做迁移检查，该集合包含 186 条人工录制音频。结果显示，SFT 版本准确率最高，而 DAPO 版本提供更短推理的操作点；六奖励 DAPO 是唯一一个 final-think 长度低于 base deployment controller 的 learned controller。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分的 controller observation、三类动作定义、trace 构造流程，以及 DAPO reward 设计。实验部分主要看 accuracy–residual-latency trade-off，不必过度关注具体 benchmark 排名。对预训练研究更有用的是动作 token 和流式 partial observation 的训练格式，而不是语音任务本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when a streaming audio-language model should wait, when it should externalize an intermediate reasoning update, and when it should answer while the user is still speaking.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a core LLM pretraining paper, but it is useful for audio-language modeling and post-training interfaces. It treats real-time spoken reasoning as a control problem under partial audio evidence, instead of the usual full-audio-then-reason protocol. For multimodal foundation models, the relevant idea is the explicit action interface: the model is trained not only to produce correct answers, but also to manage visible reasoning state and response latency during streaming input.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model is formulated as an online controller. At each decision step, it observes the full audio prefix heard so far and the visible reasoning state already emitted. The serialized action space has three primitives: <wait/> consumes more audio without changing the reasoning state; <think>...</think> emits a grounded intermediate update; <answer>...</answer> commits to the final response. The system is instantiated with Qwen2.5-Omni-7B. The data pipeline builds aligned wait-think-answer traces from spoken reasoning examples by rendering inputs as speech, aligning text actions to audio time, and converting each example into chained streaming windows. Training starts with supervised fine-tuning and then applies DAPO. The reward combines answer correctness, action validity, update timing, latency synchronization, thought quality, and chain consistency. In this version, final answering is endpoint-gated, so the main learning problem is how to distribute reasoning before the endpoint.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluation measures the trade-off between accuracy and residual post-endpoint reasoning. On synthetic spoken reasoning, the six-reward DAPO controller improves row-weighted accuracy from 67.6% for the base deployment controller to 70.3%, while reducing final-think length after the endpoint from 10.44 to 8.99 tokens. The paper also evaluates transfer on Real Audio Bench, a 186-item human-recorded set. There, SFT gives the strongest accuracy, while DAPO variants expose shorter-reasoning operating points. The six-reward variant is the only learned controller whose final-think length falls below the base deployment controller.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the controller observation, the three-action serialization, the trace-construction pipeline, and the reward design for DAPO. In the results, read the accuracy versus residual-latency plots or tables rather than treating the benchmark numbers as the main contribution. The most transferable part for foundation-model research is the training format for action tokens under partial streaming observations.

recommendation.zh: 将推理时机建模为可学习策略是有趣的方向，DAPO的奖励设计和SFT+RL流程对思考何时做推理有启发，重点看§3控制器设计。
recommendation.en: Framing reasoning timing as a learnable policy is intriguing; the DAPO reward design and SFT+RL pipeline offer useful insights for thinking about when to reason. Focus on §3.

paper.title: Can Retrieval Heads See Images? Multimodal Retrieval Heads in Long-Context Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models increasingly rely on long-context modeling to reason over documents, hour-level videos, and long-horizon agent trajectories, requiring them to locate relevant evidence across interleaved text and images. Prior work has studied this behavior using retrieval heads in large language models, but its copy-based criterion does not directly apply when evidence appears in images. We introduce a multimodal retrieval head detection method that scores attention from question to

summary.core_problem: 现有针对纯文本大模型的检索头检测方法基于答案文本复制的匹配准则，无法适用长上下文视觉语言模型中证据为图像内容的场景，也缺少对多模态检索头的属性、因果作用的系统性研究。
summary.importance: 拓展了注意力机制可解释性研究到多模态长上下文场景，验证了检索头机制是预训练阶段就已形成的通用能力，而非多模态对齐阶段新增的特性，为优化LVLM长上下文检索能力、设计更高效的多模态检索系统提供了机制层面的依据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出多模态检索头（MMRetHeads）的检测方法：基于问题token到标注证据span（包含文本token和图像对应的视觉token）的平均注意力权重得分识别检索头，不依赖答案文本复制的匹配规则，可同时适配文本和图像证据的场景；通过消融实验验证检索头的因果作用，并进一步利用检索头的注意力聚合得分实现无额外模块的端到端多模态文档检索。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-VL-8B等模型上验证，仅4.4%-10.2%的注意力头贡献了50%的正检索得分质量，具有高度稀疏性；屏蔽前5%的检索头会导致MMLongBench性能下降36%，而屏蔽随机头几乎无影响；高得分的多模态检索头与基座LLM的检索头高度重合，说明该机制继承自预训练；文本和图像检索共享部分通用检索头，同时存在各自的模态专用检索头；利用检索头注意力得分做文档页面和布局区域检索，性能超过现有主流基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读核心检测方法章节（第3章）、属性分析章节（第4-6章）和检索应用章节（第7章），重点关注检索头继承性和模态特异性的实验结论，预计阅读时间20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 麻省理工学院、斯坦福大学、加州大学伯克利分校联合研究团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing retrieval head detection methods for text-only LLMs rely on the matching criterion of answer text copying, which cannot be applied to long-context vision-language models where evidence appears as image content, and there is a lack of systematic research on the properties and causal effects of multimodal retrieval heads.
summary_en.importance: It extends attention mechanism interpretability research to multimodal long-context scenarios, verifies that the retrieval head mechanism is a general capability formed during pre-training rather than a new feature added during multimodal alignment, and provides mechanism-level evidence for optimizing the long-context retrieval capability of LVLMs and designing more efficient multimodal retrieval systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: A multimodal retrieval head (MMRetHeads) detection method is proposed: retrieval heads are identified based on the average attention weight score from question tokens to annotated evidence spans (including text tokens and visual tokens corresponding to images), independent of answer text copying rules, and adaptable to both text and image evidence scenarios. The causal effect of retrieval heads is verified through ablation experiments, and end-to-end multimodal document retrieval without additional modules is further implemented using aggregated attention scores from retrieval heads.
summary_en.experiments: Verified on models including Qwen3-VL-8B: only 4.4%-10.2% of attention heads contribute 50% of the positive retrieval score mass, showing high sparsity; masking the top 5% retrieval heads leads to a 36% drop in MMLongBench performance, while masking random heads has almost no impact; high-scoring multimodal retrieval heads are highly consistent with retrieval heads in the base LLM, indicating this mechanism is inherited from pre-training; text and image retrieval share some general retrieval heads while having modality-specific ones; using retrieval head attention scores for document page and layout region retrieval outperforms existing mainstream baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the core detection method section (Chapter 3), property analysis sections (Chapters 4-6) and retrieval application section (Chapter 7), focus on the experimental conclusions of retrieval head inheritance and modality specificity, estimated reading time 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Joint research team from MIT, Stanford University and UC Berkeley

recommendation.zh: 多模态检索头的稀疏性和因果分析对理解 VLM 注意力机制有价值，重点看 Fig 3 和掩码实验部分。
recommendation.en: Sparsity and causal analysis of multimodal retrieval heads is valuable for understanding VLM attention; focus on Figure 3 and masking experiments.

paper.title: ParaVT: Taming the Tool Prior Paradox for Parallel Tool Use in Agentic Video Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Training large multimodal models (LMMs) via reinforcement learning (RL) to natively invoke video-processing tools (e.g., cropping) has become a promising route to long-video understanding. However, existing native-RL methods dispatch tool calls sequentially (i.e., one per turn): a single wrong crop propagates errors without peer correction, multi-turn tool calls corrupt context, and inference cost scales linearly with the number of turns. We introduce ParaVT, the first multi-agent end-to-end RL-

summary.core_problem: 解决视频 agent 在原生 RL 工具调用中只能串行调用工具、导致误差传播、上下文污染和推理成本线性增长的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏 agent RL 与多模态工具使用，不是基座预训练核心论文。但它提出的 Tool Prior Paradox 有一点研究味道：预训练得到的工具先验一方面帮助探索，另一方面会破坏冷启动格式稳定性并诱发 skip-tool 奖励捷径。这对“预训练先验如何与 RL 交互”有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ParaVT，一个并行视频工具调用框架，在单轮中同时发出多个时间窗口 crop 请求，而不是逐轮串行调用。方法上结合 multi-agent 结构与端到端 RL 训练。论文进一步提出 Tool Prior Paradox：强工具先验会在温度采样下放大结构格式不稳定和跳过工具的 reward shortcut。为缓解这一点，作者通过跨模型对比和训练设计来平衡工具探索能力与结构约束。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验围绕长视频理解中的原生工具调用展开，比较对象包括现有 sequential tool-calling RL 方法，并做了强弱工具先验模型的对照。论文声称并行调用带来更干净的上下文、更好的容错和更低推理成本，但摘要未给出模型规模、视频 benchmark 名称和具体增益。对预训练研究员而言，真正值得看的不是主结果，而是关于 pretrained prior 与 RL instability 的对照实验。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息为 LMMs-Lab。摘要未提供足够信息确认更具体的团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the limitations of sequential tool calling in video-agent RL, where one wrong crop propagates errors, context gets polluted across turns, and inference cost grows linearly with the number of tool calls.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agentic multimodal RL paper, not a core pretraining paper. The interesting part is the proposed Tool Prior Paradox: pretrained tool priors help exploration but can destabilize structural formatting and create skip-tool reward shortcuts. That interaction between pretrained priors and RL is relevant beyond this specific setup.
summary_en.technical_approach: ParaVT is a parallel video-tool-calling framework that dispatches multiple temporal crop requests in a single turn instead of sequentially. It combines a multi-agent structure with end-to-end RL. The paper argues that standard RL exposes a Tool Prior Paradox: stronger pretrained tool priors improve exploration but worsen format instability and shortcut exploitation under temperature sampling. The method then uses training design and cross-model analysis to balance exploration with structural reliability.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments target long-video understanding with native tool use, comparing against sequential tool-calling RL baselines and contrasting models with stronger versus weaker tool priors. The abstract claims cleaner context, better fault tolerance, and lower inference cost, but does not expose model sizes, benchmark names, or exact gains. For pretraining researchers, the most relevant part is the analysis of how pretrained priors interact with RL instability.

recommendation.zh: 正文不必细读，抓住“Tool Prior Paradox”即可：它提示强预训练先验未必总利于 RL，尤其在格式约束和 shortcut reward 并存时；看对照实验就够。
recommendation.en: You can mostly ignore the full method and just read the Tool Prior Paradox section; it is a useful reminder that stronger pretrained priors can hurt RL when format constraints and reward shortcuts coexist.

paper.title: MM-Conv: A Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Context-Aware Grounding in 3D Dialogue
paper.abstract: Grounding language in the physical world requires AI systems to interpret references that emerge dynamically during conversation. While current vision-language models (VLMs) excel at static image tasks, they struggle to resolve ambiguous expressions in spontaneous, multi-turn dialogue. We address this gap by introducing (1) a benchmark for referential communication in dynamic 3D environments, built from 6.7 hours of egocentric VR interaction with synchronized speech, motion, gaze, and 3D scene g

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM在动态3D环境的多轮对话中难以解析歧义指代表达，缺乏面向3D对话场景的基准数据集。
summary.importance: 数据贡献+基准贡献：发布了MM-Conv数据集（6.7小时VR第一人称交互，含语音/运动/凝视/3D几何的多模态数据，4200+人工验证指代表达），建立了3D对话中语言接地的benchmark。
summary.technical_approach: 两阶段接地pipeline：先通过上下文重写解决会话歧义，再进行视觉定位；对比了端到端方法和模块化方法。
summary.experiments: 基准包含全指代、部分指代和代词指代三种类型；上下文重写使接地性能平均提升11-22个百分点；重写后GroundingDINO在代词指代上达到56.7%，接近最佳端到端基线的两倍。
summary.authors_note: KTH皇家理工学院团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLMs struggle to resolve ambiguous referring expressions in spontaneous multi-turn dialogue within dynamic 3D environments, and no benchmark dataset exists for this specific setting.
summary_en.importance: Data and benchmark contribution: MM-Conv dataset (6.7 hours of egocentric VR interaction with speech, motion, gaze, and 3D geometry; 4,200+ manually verified referring expressions), establishing a benchmark for language grounding in 3D dialogue.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-stage grounding pipeline: contextual rewriting to resolve conversational ambiguity first, then visual localization; compares end-to-end vs modular approaches.
summary_en.experiments: Benchmark spans full, partitive, and pronominal reference types; contextual rewriting improves grounding by 11-22pp on average; GroundingDINO reaches 56.7% on pronominals after rewriting, nearly doubling the best end-to-end baseline.
summary_en.authors_note: KTH Royal Institute of Technology team.

recommendation.zh: 3D多模态对话基准，对LLM基座预训练研究无直接关联，但数据集的构建方法（VR环境多模态同步采集）对多模态数据设计有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: 3D multimodal dialogue benchmark. Not directly relevant to LLM pretraining, but the dataset construction methodology (synchronized multimodal capture in VR) has some reference value for multimodal data design.

institutions: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm

paper.title: Bernini: Latent Semantic Planning for Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion models have each reached remarkable maturity: MLLMs excel at reasoning over heterogeneous multimodal inputs with strong semantic grounding, while diffusion models synthesize images and videos with photorealistic fidelity. We argue that these two families can be unified through a simple division of labor: MLLMs perform semantic planning, while diffusion models render pixels from high-level semantic guidance and low-level visual features. Buil

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文试图解决视频生成和编辑中的接口问题：如何让 MLLM 负责语义理解和规划，让 diffusion/flow 模型负责像素生成，同时避免把两者粗糙拼接成一个难训练的端到端系统。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近统一多模态预训练和新型生成建模接口设计。核心价值在于它选择 MLLM 内部的 ViT embedding space 作为语义桥梁，而不是让 MLLM 直接生成离散图像 token、文本 prompt，或让 diffusion 模型只依赖外部文本编码器。这个选择有两个含义：第一，视觉语义计划落在 MLLM 已经熟悉的连续表征空间里，减少适配成本；第二，生成器接收的是目标画面的高层视觉表示，而不只是语言描述，因此更适合复杂编辑、参考图/参考视频约束和主体保持。
summary.technical_approach: Bernini 由两部分组成。Planner 是一个 MLLM，它接收统一序列化的多模态输入，包括文本、源图像/视频的 ViT tokens，以及目标输出的占位 tokens。它不直接输出像素，而是在 MLLM 的 ViT embedding space 中预测目标视觉语义表示。训练时采用 masked generative modeling：随机 mask 目标 ViT tokens，在 MLLM hidden states 上接轻量 ViT embedding decoder，恢复被 mask 的目标 embedding；推理时从全 mask 状态开始逐步填充目标语义 tokens。Renderer 是 DiT，使用 flow matching 在 VAE latent tokens 上生成图像或视频，通过 cross-attention 接收 planner 给出的语义 embedding，并结合文本特征；做编辑任务时额外注入源输入的 VAE latent，以保留低层细节和时序一致性。为了统一多源视觉输入，论文提出 Segment-Aware 3D RoPE，在时空 RoPE 中加入 segment index 相关的相位调制，避免多个图像/视频源在位置编码上混淆。另一个设计是 latent-space CoT：让 planner 在连续视觉语义空间中进行中间推理，再输出最终 target embedding。训练策略上，两部分可以大体独立训练，再轻量联合调整，这有利于保留 MLLM 的理解能力，也降低整体训练难度。
summary.experiments: 论文覆盖 text-to-video、subject-to-video、图像/视频编辑等任务，并构造了多任务训练数据：视频和图像 pair 预训练数据、基于传播和运动感知的视频编辑数据、参考图和参考视频引导生成数据。评测包括 OpenVE-Bench、OpenS2V-Eval，以及论文提出的 Bernini-Bench。给出的结论是 Bernini 在多个视频生成、编辑和主体保持评测上优于对比系统，尤其在需要理解复杂指令、多参考输入和保持主体一致性的设置中收益更明显。当前提供的正文片段没有给出完整参数规模、训练 token/clip 数量和逐项指标，阅读时需要回到实验表格核对具体幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看 Fig. 3 和方法部分，确认 planner 到 renderer 的接口到底传什么：是 ViT semantic embeddings，而不是文本 prompt 或 VAE latent。然后看 masked ViT embedding prediction 的训练/推理流程、SA-3D RoPE 的定义、编辑任务中源 VAE latent 的注入方式。实验部分重点看多任务数据构造和 ablation：没有 semantic planner 会怎样，只用文本条件会怎样，去掉 source VAE features 或 SA-3D RoPE 会怎样。对基座研究更有用的是“连续语义计划 + diffusion 渲染”的分工设计，而不是具体视频 demo。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the interface problem between multimodal understanding and video synthesis: how to let an MLLM perform semantic planning while a diffusion-style generator renders pixels, without forcing both roles into a brittle end-to-end design.
summary_en.importance: This is relevant to unified multimodal pretraining and generation-interface design. The central choice is to use the MLLM’s own ViT embedding space as the semantic bridge to the generator. This is more informative than passing only a text prompt, and more natural for the MLLM than directly producing pixels or low-level VAE latents. It also creates a clean separation: the MLLM predicts what should appear in a compact visual-semantic space, while the DiT handles photorealistic rendering and detail preservation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Bernini has two main modules. The planner is an MLLM that consumes a unified multimodal sequence containing text, source visual tokens, and target placeholders. It predicts the target visual representation in continuous ViT-embedding space. Training follows a masked generative modeling setup: target ViT tokens are randomly masked, and a lightweight ViT-embedding decoder on top of the MLLM reconstructs the missing target embeddings from contextual hidden states. At inference, the planner progressively fills in the full target representation starting from masked tokens. The renderer is a DiT trained with flow matching over VAE latent tokens. It conditions on the planner’s semantic embeddings through cross-attention, also uses text features, and for editing tasks receives source VAE features to preserve low-level appearance and temporal consistency. The paper also introduces Segment-Aware 3D RoPE, which adds segment-index-dependent phase modulation to spatiotemporal rotary embeddings so that multiple visual sources can coexist in one sequence. A latent-space CoT mechanism lets the planner perform intermediate reasoning before producing the final target embedding.
summary_en.experiments: The system is evaluated on text-to-video generation, subject-to-video generation, and image/video editing. The training corpus combines video and image-pair pretraining data, propagation-based and motion-aware video editing data, and reference-image/reference-video guided generation data. Evaluation includes OpenVE-Bench, OpenS2V-Eval, and a new Bernini-Bench. The reported results show consistent gains over compared systems, with stronger effects in settings that require complex instruction following, multiple visual references, editing consistency, and subject preservation. The provided text does not include the full model scale, data scale, or all numeric metric values, so the exact margins should be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with Fig. 3 and the method description to understand the planner-renderer contract: the planner outputs ViT semantic embeddings, not text prompts or VAE latents. Then read the masked ViT-embedding prediction procedure, Segment-Aware 3D RoPE, and the source-VAE conditioning path for editing. In the experiments, focus on the multi-task data construction and ablations: removing the semantic planner, replacing it with text-only conditioning, removing source VAE features, or dropping SA-3D RoPE. The useful idea for foundation-model researchers is the continuous semantic planning interface between MLLM reasoning and diffusion rendering.

recommendation.zh: MLLM+扩散的分工架构值得了解一下，语义接口的设计思路对多模态统一预训练有参考价值。重点看规划器和渲染器的接口设计。
recommendation.en: The MLLM-diffusion division-of-labor architecture is worth understanding; the semantic interface design offers insights for unified multimodal pretraining. Focus on the planner-renderer interface design.

paper.title: Bernini: Latent Semantic Planning for Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion models have each reached remarkable maturity: MLLMs excel at reasoning over heterogeneous multimodal inputs with strong semantic grounding, while diffusion models synthesize images and videos with photorealistic fidelity. We argue that these two families can be unified through a simple division of labor: MLLMs perform semantic planning, while diffusion models render pixels from high-level semantic guidance and low-level visual features. Buil

summary.core_problem: 解决视频生成与编辑里“语义规划”和“像素渲染”耦合过紧的问题，希望把 MLLM 的高层语义能力与 diffusion 的视觉生成能力更干净地拼接起来。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态生成框架设计：提出用语义表示作为接口，把 MLLM 负责的语义规划与 DiT 负责的像素渲染解耦。对做统一多模态预训练的人有一点接口设计启发，但它更偏视频生成系统，而不是 LLM 基座预训练本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，先用基于 MLLM 的 planner 直接在 ViT embedding 空间预测目标语义表示，再由 DiT-based renderer 在该语义计划条件下生成视频像素；编辑场景下再加入源视频的 VAE 特征以保留细节。核心设计是把“语义”作为 planner 和 renderer 的中间接口，因此两部分可以分开训练，只做轻量协同训练，尽量复用各自已有预训练能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确模型规模、训练数据规模和具体基线名称，只说明覆盖视频生成与编辑任务，并强调在保留预训练能力的同时实现统一框架。由于缺少定量细节，目前更适合把它当作架构接口思路，而不是可直接迁移到 LLM 预训练 recipe 的证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the tight coupling between semantic planning and pixel rendering in video generation/editing, aiming to combine MLLM-level semantic grounding with diffusion-based visual synthesis through a cleaner interface.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly a multimodal generation framework: using semantic representations as the interface between an MLLM planner and a DiT renderer. This offers some interface-design signal for unified multimodal pretraining, but it is still much more a video generation system paper than a foundation-LLM pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses an MLLM-based planner to predict target semantic representations directly in ViT embedding space, then a DiT-based renderer generates pixels conditioned on that plan. For editing, source VAE features are added to preserve details. The key idea is to treat semantics as the contract between planner and renderer, enabling separate training with only light co-training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, training corpus scale, or named baselines. It claims unified support for video generation and editing while preserving pretrained capabilities. Given the lack of quantitative detail, this is better read as an interface proposal than as strong evidence for transferable LLM-pretraining methodology.

recommendation.zh: 更像视频生成系统整合，不是 pretrain 论文；只需看它如何把“语义接口”从像素生成里剥离，若你在想 AR+diffusion 联合建模，这个接口定义可作弱参考。
recommendation.en: This is mostly a video generation integration paper, not a pretraining one; only read it for the semantic-interface split if you're thinking about AR+diffusion unification.

paper.title: ProCrit: Self-Elicited Multi-Perspective Reasoning with Critic-Guided Revision for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
paper.abstract: Multimodal sarcasm detection requires reasoning over cross-modal incongruities between literal expression and intended meaning, yet the specific analytical perspectives needed vary across samples due to the diversity of sarcastic mechanisms. While recent methods make this analytical process explicit, they still rely on fixed, predefined perspectives that operate independently under hand-crafted routing rules. We argue that multimodal sarcasm detection instead calls for self-elicited multi-perspe

summary.core_problem: 多模态讽刺检测需要对跨模态不一致性进行推理，但现有方法依赖固定预定义视角和手工路由规则，无法适应不同样本的讽刺机制多样性。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出了Proposal-Critique两agent框架，实现了自激发多视角推理与批评引导的修订，并合成了过程级推理标注数据。
summary.technical_approach: ProCrit 由 proposal agent（多视角推理）和 critic agent（外部评估与定向修订引导）组成，通过合成过程级推理标注解决缺乏过程监督的问题。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未提供完整的实验结果细节，包括模型规模、baseline对比和量化指标。
summary.authors_note: 包含百度研究者，主要应用领域为多模态情感分析。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal sarcasm detection requires reasoning over cross-modal incongruities, but existing methods rely on fixed predefined perspectives with hand-crafted routing rules, failing to adapt to diverse sarcasm mechanisms across samples.
summary_en.importance: Methodological novelty: Proposal-Critic two-agent framework enabling self-elicited multi-perspective reasoning with critic-guided revision, plus synthesized process-level reasoning annotation data.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProCrit consists of a proposal agent for multi-perspective reasoning and a critic agent for external evaluation and targeted revision guidance, with synthesized process-level reasoning annotations to address lack of process supervision.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not provide complete experimental details including model size, baselines, or quantitative metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: Includes researchers from Baidu Inc., primarily focused on multimodal sentiment analysis.

recommendation.zh: 特定领域（讽刺检测）的多模态agent应用，方法属于现有agent范式的领域适配，对LLM基座研究无直接启发。
recommendation.en: Domain-specific multimodal agent application (sarcasm detection); adapts existing agent paradigms to a niche task with no direct insight for LLM foundation research.

paper.title: Causal Evidence for Attention Head Imbalance in Modality Conflict Hallucination
paper.abstract: Modality-conflict hallucination occurs when multimodal large language models (MLLMs) prioritize erroneous textual premises over contradictory visual evidence. To understand why visual evidence fails to prevail during generation, we take a mechanistic perspective and examine which internal components drive or resist this failure. We perform head-level causal analysis using path patching across five open-source MLLMs and identify two groups of attention heads with opposing causal roles: hallucinat

summary.core_problem: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在面对文本预设与视觉证据冲突时，为何常产生偏向错误文本的幻觉？
summary.importance: 从机制可解释性（Mechanistic Interpretability）角度，首次在注意力头（Attention Head）级别揭示了多模态冲突幻觉的因果机制，为理解和缓解此类幻觉提供了内部视角。
summary.technical_approach: 采用路径修补（Path Patching）技术，在五个开源 MLLMs 上进行头级别的因果分析。通过对比冲突输入（包含错误文本预设）和干净输入（无偏预设）下的激活差异，识别出两类作用相反的注意力头：驱动幻觉的头（Hallucination-driving heads）和抵抗幻觉的头（Hallucination-resisting heads）。基于此发现，提出了一种概念验证性的推理时干预方法 MACI，利用抵抗头的激活来检测冲突，并在必要时抑制驱动头。
summary.experiments: 在五个 7B-8B 模型上发现一致的不对称性：驱动幻觉的效应分布更广、总权重更大，而抵抗效应集中在少数高重要性的头上。消融实验证实了这些头的因果作用。MACI 在 MMMC 数据集上显著降低了幻觉，并在 SCI-SemanticConflict 上表现出零样本迁移能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读第 2 节关于因果分析的实验设计和结果，特别是图 2 中驱动头和抵抗头的不对称分布。第 3 节的消融实验和 MACI 方法的评估也值得关注，了解如何利用内部机制进行推理时干预。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Why do Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often hallucinate by favoring erroneous textual premises over contradictory visual evidence?
summary_en.importance: Provides the first causal evidence at the attention-head level for modality-conflict hallucination from a mechanistic interpretability perspective, offering internal insights for understanding and mitigating such hallucinations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Applies path patching, a mechanistic interpretability technique, to perform head-level causal analysis across five open-source MLLMs. By comparing activations under conflict inputs (with erroneous textual premises) and clean inputs (unbiased premises), it identifies two groups of attention heads with opposing causal roles: hallucination-driving heads and hallucination-resisting heads. Based on this, a proof-of-concept inference-time intervention, MACI, is proposed, which uses resisting-head activations to detect conflict and suppresses driving heads when necessary.
summary_en.experiments: Reveals a consistent asymmetry across five 7B-8B models: driving effects are more broadly distributed and carry greater aggregate weight, whereas resisting effects concentrate in a small number of high-importance heads. Ablation experiments confirm the causal roles of these heads. MACI significantly reduces hallucinations on the MMMC dataset and demonstrates zero-shot transfer to SCI-SemanticConflict.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the experimental design and results of the causal analysis, especially Figure 2 showing the asymmetric distribution of driving and resisting heads. Section 3 on ablation experiments and the evaluation of MACI is also worth reading to understand how internal mechanisms can be leveraged for inference-time intervention. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 用path patching做的因果机制分析，发现了驱动幻觉和抵抗幻觉的两类注意力头的不平衡结构。对理解MLLM幻觉机制有参考价值，重点看Fig 2和消融实验部分
recommendation.en: Causal mechanism analysis using path patching reveals imbalanced structure between hallucination-driving and resisting heads. Useful for understanding MLLM hallucination; focus on Fig 2 and ablation sections.

institutions: National Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University

paper.title: OmniGUI: Benchmarking GUI Agents in Omni-Modal Smartphone Environments
paper.abstract: Current benchmarks for graphical user interface (GUI) agents predominantly rely on static screenshots. However, real-world smartphone interaction routinely requires agents to process transient audio cues and temporal video dynamics that are tightly coupled with the moment of action. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniGUI, the first step-level benchmark designed to evaluate GUI agents in omni-modal smartphone environments. OmniGUI provides continuous, interleaved multimodal inputs comprising st

summary.core_problem: 现有 GUI agent benchmark 多依赖静态截图，无法评估真实手机交互中与动作时机耦合的音频和视频线索。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 贡献。它把 GUI agent 评测从静态视觉扩展到 step-level 的图像+音频+视频输入，对原生多模态 agent 的能力边界有现实意义。对预训练研究员的价值主要在数据形态与评测需求，而不是方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OmniGUI，一个面向智能手机环境的 omni-modal GUI agent benchmark。每个 action step 提供连续交错的静态图像、同步音频和视频片段，并标注多模态依赖程度。由于专门的 omni-modal GUI agent 尚不成熟，作者用能原生处理交错输入的基础 omni-modal 模型作为代理 baseline。
summary.experiments: 数据包含 709 条专家演示 episode、2579 个 action step，覆盖 29 个应用。评测重点是不同多模态依赖级别下的 agent 表现。摘要未给出具体模型名和分数，但明确指出现有模型在需要时序音视频理解的 GUI 场景下存在明显缺口。

summary_en.core_problem: Current GUI-agent benchmarks rely heavily on static screenshots and fail to evaluate audio/video cues that are tightly coupled with action timing in real smartphone use.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. It extends GUI-agent evaluation from static visual inputs to step-level image+audio+video streams, which matters for native multimodal agents. For pretraining researchers, the value is mostly in the data/evaluation shape rather than in a new modeling method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces OmniGUI, an omni-modal benchmark for smartphone GUI agents. Each action step contains interleaved static images, synchronized audio, and video clips, with annotations for multimodal dependency levels. Because dedicated omni-modal GUI agents are still immature, the authors use foundational omni-modal models that can natively process interleaved inputs as proxy baselines.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 709 expert-demonstrated episodes and 2,579 action steps across 29 apps. The evaluation focuses on how performance changes with multimodal dependency. The abstract does not list exact model names or scores, but it clearly argues that current models struggle when GUI interaction requires temporal audio-video understanding.

recommendation.zh: 作为 benchmark 选题是对的：GUI agent 迟早要吃时序音视频；但对 pretrain 只提供需求侧信号，读数据设计和失败案例就够。
recommendation.en: The benchmark direction is right—GUI agents will eventually need temporal audio/video—but for pretraining this is mostly a demand-side signal; read the dataset design and failure cases only.

paper.title: Introducing Gemini Omni

summary.core_problem: Gemini Omni 解决的是“任意模态输入到视频生成与编辑”的统一建模问题。重点不只是文生视频，而是让文本、图像、音频、视频都能作为条件，并在多轮对话中保持角色、场景、物理关系和编辑历史的一致性。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要在统一多模态生成范式。它把 Gemini 的推理、世界知识和视频生成能力放在同一个产品接口里，说明前沿系统正在从单一 text-to-video 走向 reference-conditioned、instruction-following、multi-turn editing 的视频生成模型。贡献类型更接近系统能力披露和产品化信号，不是可复现实验论文。它没有公开 tokenizer、架构、训练目标、数据配比或 scaling 细节，因此不能直接用于复现训练方案；但它明确给出了下一代多模态基座模型需要优化的能力边界：跨模态条件融合、长程时序一致性、物理先验、音画同步、可编辑性和安全水印。
summary.technical_approach: 公开内容没有披露模型结构。能从能力描述中推断出的设计重点有四点。第一，输入侧是多模态条件融合：文本、图像、视频和音频都可作为 reference，模型需要把角色外观、动作轨迹、镜头运动、风格、节奏和语义约束合成为同一个生成条件。第二，输出侧当前以视频为主，后续计划支持图像和音频输出，说明 Omni family 的目标不是单独的视频模型，而是更通用的生成接口。第三，多轮编辑是核心交互方式。每条指令都建立在前一轮结果上，要求模型或系统保留场景状态，并把局部编辑约束和全局一致性一起处理。第四，Gemini 的知识和推理能力被用于提高生成内容的语义正确性，例如字母物体序列、蛋白质折叠解释、物理运动、历史或科学语境。和传统 text-to-video 相比，区别在于它不只从 prompt 采样视频，而是把已有视频、图像、音频和对话历史作为可组合的条件空间。
summary.experiments: 没有报告标准 benchmark、人工偏好评测、消融实验、训练规模、参数量或数据规模。全文提供的是产品示例和能力演示。关键示例包括：把雕塑改成气泡材质；让镜子产生液体涟漪并把手臂变成镜面材质；让公寓灯光随音乐同步亮起；把小提琴手转移到参考图环境并进一步改变机位；用输入图像、输入视频和输入音频共同约束科幻风视频；用参考视频的极端镜头运动驱动图像角色的走路循环；把手触碰叶片的动作和竖琴声同步。发布信息包括：Gemini Omni Flash 已进入 Gemini app、Google Flow、YouTube Shorts 和 YouTube Create App；面向开发者和企业的 API 计划随后开放；生成视频带 SynthID 隐形水印，可在 Gemini app、Chrome 中的 Gemini 和 Google Search 中验证。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时应把它当作能力边界说明，而不是方法论文。优先看三类信息。第一，多轮编辑段落，尤其是“每条指令建立在上一条指令上”“角色一致、物理保持、场景记住之前内容”这些表述，这对应视频生成中最难的状态保持问题。第二，reference conditioning 示例，尤其是同时使用 image、video、audio 的 prompt，可用于理解统一多模态条件接口的产品形态。第三，安全与发布段落，包括语音 avatar 限制、音频/语音编辑仍在测试、SynthID 水印和验证链路。值得深挖的问题是：这类系统如何在训练中表示视频编辑状态；如何把音频节奏、视觉运动和文本指令对齐；多轮编辑是单模型端到端完成，还是包含检索、分割、重绘、重采样等外部工具链。由于缺少技术细节，不建议把文中能力直接解读为某种特定架构已经成立。
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind / Google Gemini 团队发布的产品与研究能力介绍。未提供具体作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: Gemini Omni addresses a unified multimodal generation problem: creating and editing video from arbitrary inputs. The central issue is not plain text-to-video generation, but using text, images, audio, video, and dialogue history as conditions while preserving characters, scene state, physical behavior, and edit continuity across turns.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model pretraining, the main signal is the shift toward unified multimodal generative systems. The announcement places Gemini-style reasoning and world knowledge behind a video creation interface, which suggests that frontier multimodal models are moving beyond one-shot text-to-video into reference-conditioned and instruction-following video editing. The contribution is a capability and product disclosure rather than a reproducible research result. It does not reveal the tokenizer, architecture, objective, data mixture, scaling setup, or optimization recipe. Still, it is useful for defining the capability targets that future multimodal pretraining has to support: cross-modal conditioning, temporal consistency, physics-aware dynamics, audio-visual synchronization, editable scene state, and provenance controls.
summary_en.technical_approach: The technical implementation is not disclosed. The capability descriptions point to several design requirements. First, the input interface must fuse heterogeneous conditions: text instructions, image references, source videos, motion cues, visual style, and audio rhythm. Second, the current output is video, while later members of the Omni family are planned to support image and audio outputs, so the intended interface is broader than a standalone video generator. Third, multi-turn editing is treated as a primary mode rather than an add-on. Each instruction builds on the previous one, which requires persistent scene state and a mechanism for reconciling local edits with global consistency. Fourth, Gemini’s knowledge and reasoning are used to improve semantic faithfulness, for example in alphabet-item generation, protein-folding explainers, and physically plausible motion. Compared with conventional text-to-video systems, the distinctive point is the compositional conditioning space: existing media and conversation history are part of the generation problem.
summary_en.experiments: No standard benchmark, human-preference study, ablation, parameter count, data scale, or training setup is reported. The evidence consists of product demonstrations. Examples include turning a sculpture into bubbles, making a mirror ripple like liquid while transforming an arm into reflective material, synchronizing apartment lights with music, moving a violinist into an image-defined environment and then changing the camera angle, using an image, a video, and an audio file jointly to create a sci-fi clip, transferring extreme camera motion from a reference video to a character from an image, and adding harp sounds synchronized with touches on fern leaves. Deployment details are concrete: Gemini Omni Flash is rolling out in the Gemini app, Google Flow, YouTube Shorts, and YouTube Create App; developer and enterprise APIs are planned; generated videos include an imperceptible SynthID watermark that can be verified through Gemini, Gemini in Chrome, and Google Search.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it as a capability boundary document, not as a methods paper. The most useful parts are the multi-turn editing examples, especially the claims about preserving characters, physics, and scene memory; the reference-conditioning prompts that combine image, video, and audio; and the safety/deployment section covering avatars, restrictions on speech editing, SynthID watermarking, and verification. The research questions worth carrying forward are concrete: how is editable video state represented during training or inference; how are audio beats, visual motion, and language instructions aligned; and how much of the editing pipeline is handled by a single model versus auxiliary tools such as segmentation, tracking, inpainting, or resampling. The announcement should not be used as evidence for a specific architecture without additional technical material.
summary_en.authors_note: Released by Google DeepMind / Google Gemini teams. Individual authors are not listed.

recommendation.zh: 信息密度接近零，先过滤；等技术报告或模型卡出来再看，不要被名字带节奏。
recommendation.en: Near-zero information density; skip it until a technical report or model card appears.

paper.title: Reversing the Flow: Generation-to-Understanding Synergy in Large Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: The long-standing goal of multimodal AI is to build unified models in which visual understanding and visual generation mutually enhance one another. Despite recent works such as BAGEL, BLIP3o achieves remarkable progress; In practice, however, this unification remains one-directional: understanding routinely guides generation, yet how and why generation can support understanding is rarely investigated. We revisit this asymmetry and propose Generation-to-Understanding (G2U) synergy, where visual

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论统一多模态模型里的一个不对称问题：现有模型通常是“理解指导生成”，但生成能力很少反过来帮助理解。作者把问题具体化为：当输入图像存在细节缺失、上下文不足或结构关系不清时，模型能否先生成一张辅助图像，再把这张图像作为中间证据用于回答问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把多模态统一从“共享参数、共享架构”推进到“训练目标和推理过程是否真的耦合”。如果生成只能作为输出端能力存在，那么 AR+diffusion 或统一视觉 token 方案仍然可能只是并列能力。论文的实验证据表明，生成质量会限制理解增益，自主选择生成什么也仍然不稳定。这提示后续预训练可能需要显式训练“生成何种中间视觉证据”的能力，而不只是把理解数据和生成数据混在一起训练。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是一个两阶段零样本框架，不重新训练模型，也不引入外部工具。第一阶段，给定原图和问题，模型执行受控生成操作，产生作者称为 visual thought 的自生成视觉中间物。生成操作包括细节增强、上下文扩展、结构关系可视化等。第二阶段，把原图、问题和生成出的辅助图像一起输入同一个多模态模型，让模型基于这些额外视觉证据回答。与 InstructPix2Pix、Show-o、BAGEL、Janus 等常见 understanding-to-generation 流程不同，这里不是用理解结果控制图像生成，而是把生成过程放回理解链路中，作为一种内部分析步骤。
summary.experiments: 论文在 12 个多模态理解 benchmark 上做了系统评估。核心观察有三点。第一，生成质量和理解提升之间有明显耦合：生成图像越能保留真实细节并补足任务相关信息，后续理解收益越稳定。第二，不同编辑 prompt 家族的迁移模式不同；细节增强、上下文扩展和结构可视化并不适用于同一类任务。第三，让模型自动决定“应该想象什么”时，生成结果常常表面合理，但和问题所需信息对不齐，因此收益不稳定。论文还指出，持续使用生成导向数据训练统一模型，可能增强合成能力但削弱原有理解能力。给定材料中没有提供各 benchmark 的具体分数和提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 understanding-to-generation 不对称性的分析，以及 Method 中两阶段 G→U 流程的形式化。实验部分应优先看三类内容：不同 visual thought 类型的对比、生成质量与理解收益的相关性、自主生成 visual thought 的失败案例。最值得细看的不是具体 prompt 技巧，而是失败模式：模型能生成图像，但还不会稳定判断哪种生成对当前问题有用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies an asymmetry in unified multimodal models. Current systems usually use understanding to guide generation, but generation rarely feeds back into understanding. The concrete question is whether a model can generate an auxiliary image first, such as an enhanced detail view, expanded context, or structural visualization, and then use that image as intermediate evidence for visual reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is the distinction between architectural unification and functional coupling. A model that shares parameters across understanding and generation may still run the two capabilities as parallel modules. The paper suggests that generative fidelity constrains the possible gain in perception, and that models are still weak at deciding what kind of visual evidence should be generated for a given question. This points to a missing training signal in native multimodal pretraining: not only generating images, but generating task-aligned intermediate visual evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is a two-stage zero-shot framework. In the first stage, given an input image and a question, the model performs a controlled generative action and produces a self-generated visual thought. The action can enhance low-level details, expand surrounding context, or visualize structural relations. In the second stage, the original image, the question, and the generated visual thought are fed back into the same model for answering. This differs from the standard understanding-to-generation pipeline used in image editing and unified models such as InstructPix2Pix, Show-o, BAGEL, and Janus. Generation is not treated as the final output; it becomes an intermediate analytic step.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on 12 multimodal understanding benchmarks. The main findings are qualitative and mechanistic. First, the benefit to understanding is tightly linked to the fidelity and relevance of the generated visual thought. Second, different prompt families transfer differently across task types; detail enhancement, context expansion, and structural visualization are not interchangeable. Third, when models are asked to autonomously decide what to imagine, they often produce plausible edits that are poorly aligned with the information needed for the question. The supplied text does not include per-benchmark scores or exact improvement numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on the introduction for the analysis of the one-way understanding-to-generation paradigm, and on the method section for the two-stage G-to-U loop. In the experiments, prioritize the comparisons between visual thought types, the correlation between generation fidelity and reasoning gain, and the failure cases of autonomous visual thought generation. The most useful part is the diagnosis of why generation helps only when it is task-aligned.

recommendation.zh: 多模态理解与生成双向协同的思路有启发性，对统一多模态预训练有一定参考价值，建议只读方法部分
recommendation.en: The bidirectional synergy between generation and understanding is conceptually interesting for unified multimodal pretraining; read only the method section

paper.title: MHSA: A Lightweight Framework for Mitigating Hallucinations via Steered Attention in LVLMs
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across diverse multimodal tasks, yet they continue to suffer from hallucinations, generating content that is inconsistent with the visual input. Prior work DHCP (Detecting Hallucinations by Cross-modal Attention Pattern) has explored hallucination detection from the perspective of cross-modal attention, but does not address hallucination mitigation. In this paper, we propose MHSA (Mitigating Hallucinations via Steered Atte

summary.core_problem: 大视觉语言模型（LVLM）的幻觉问题——生成内容与输入视觉信息不一致，现有缓解方法存在明显局限：训练类方法需要大量算力和标注数据，推理类方法依赖固定的人工规则，无法适配每个样本的具体幻觉特征；此前基于交叉注意力模式的幻觉检测方法DHCP仅能完成检测任务，无法直接缓解幻觉，且仅支持句子级别的检测。
summary.importance: 为LVLM幻觉缓解提供了一种无需修改主干模型参数的轻量化方案，验证了通过数据驱动的注意力模式修正来缓解幻觉的可行性，且方案可迁移到不同的LVLM架构，具有较好的实用性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MHSA框架，核心是训练一个三层MLP生成器，输入原始交叉注意力矩阵，输出修正项，得到修正后的注意力矩阵；将预训练的DHCP检测器改造为token级别的判别器，提供注意力引导的监督信号，同时加入正则项保留原始注意力的基础结构，避免破坏输出质量；训练过程仅更新生成器和DHCP的参数，推理时替换LVLM的原始交叉注意力即可生效，无需修改LVLM主干；进一步将DHCP的检测能力扩展到token级别，支持生成类任务的幻觉缓解。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen2.5-VL、InternVL2-8B、LLaVA-v1.5三个主流LVLM上进行测试，在判别类视觉问答任务上实现了稳定可靠的幻觉缓解效果，在生成类图像描述任务上也展现出缓解幻觉的潜力，通过注意力可视化验证了注意力修正与幻觉缓解的因果关联。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章方法部分，理解注意力修正模块的训练目标设计和token级别扩展的实现逻辑；查看实验部分的注意力可视化图表，直观感受修正前后的注意力模式变化；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 未公开明确机构信息

summary_en.core_problem: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) suffer from hallucinations, where generated content is inconsistent with input visual information. Existing mitigation methods have limitations: training-based methods require massive computing resources and annotated data, while inference-time methods rely on fixed handcrafted rules that cannot adapt to sample-specific hallucination signatures. The prior DHCP method can only detect hallucinations via cross-modal attention patterns and cannot mitigate them, with detection limited to the sentence level.
summary_en.importance: It provides a lightweight hallucination mitigation solution for LVLMs that does not require modifying backbone model parameters, validates the feasibility of mitigating hallucinations through data-driven attention pattern correction, and is compatible with multiple LVLM architectures for practical deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The MHSA framework trains a 3-layer MLP generator that takes original cross-modal attention matrices as input and outputs correction terms to produce adjusted attention matrices. The pretrained DHCP detector is repurposed as a token-level discriminator to provide attention-guided supervision signals, with additional regularization to preserve the original attention structure and avoid degrading output quality. Only the generator and DHCP parameters are updated during training, and the corrected attention replaces the original cross-modal attention during inference without modifying the LVLM backbone. DHCP's detection capability is further extended to the token level to support hallucination mitigation for generative tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Tests are conducted on three mainstream LVLMs: Qwen2.5-VL, InternVL2-8B, and LLaVA-v1.5. Stable and reliable hallucination mitigation is achieved on discriminative visual question answering tasks, and the method also shows potential for hallucination reduction on generative image captioning tasks. Attention visualizations validate the causal link between attention correction and hallucination mitigation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (Method) to understand the design of the attention correction module's training objectives and the implementation of token-level extension. Review the attention visualization charts in the experiments section to observe attention pattern changes before and after correction. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: No explicit institutional information available

recommendation.zh: 利用内部注意力信号做轻量推理-time修正的思路有启发性，对多模态对齐研究有参考价值。看方法部分（§3）即可，实验验证强度一般。
recommendation.en: The inference-time attention steering approach using internal signals is conceptually interesting for multimodal alignment research. Read §3 (method) only; experimental validation is moderate.

institutions: University of Science and Technology Beijing

paper.title: Pelican-Unified 1.0: A Unified Embodied Intelligence Model for Understanding, Reasoning, Imagination and Action
paper.abstract: We present Pelican-Unified 1.0, the first embodied foundation model trained according to the principle of unification. Pelican-Unified 1.0 uses a single VLM as a unified understanding module, mapping scenes, instructions, visual contexts, and action histories into a shared semantic space. The same VLM also serves as a unified reasoning module, autoregressively producing task-, action-, and future-oriented chains of thought in a single forward pass and projecting the final hidden state into a den

summary.core_problem: 现有具身智能模型多采用独立模块拼接的流水线架构，感知、推理、世界建模、动作策略四部分相互割裂，存在语义断层、泛化性差、长时序任务误差累积等问题。
summary.importance: 提出具身智能的统一建模范式，为多模态预训练向具身场景扩展提供架构设计参考，验证了共享表示联合优化的可行性，不需要在各专项能力上做性能妥协。
summary.technical_approach: 采用单VLM作为共享的理解与推理模块，将场景、指令、视觉上下文、动作历史映射到统一语义空间，自回归生成面向任务、动作、未来的思维链并输出隐变量；后续接统一未来生成器（UFG），基于该隐变量在同一扩散去噪过程中用两个模态头同时生成未来视频和底层动作；训练时语言、视频、动作损失同时回传到共享表示层，实现四类能力联合优化。
summary.experiments: 单checkpoint在三类任务上表现突出：8个VLM基准得分64.7，同等参规模型中最优；WorldArena基准得分66.03，排名第一；RoboTwin动作基准得分93.5，对比方法中平均排名第二。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2节统一范式的定义、第3节模型架构设计、第4节核心实验结果，跳过相关工作和冗余实验细节部分，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Most existing embodied intelligence models adopt a pipeline architecture stitched with independent modules, leading to fragmentation across perception, reasoning, world modeling and action policy, which causes semantic gaps, poor generalization, and error accumulation in long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a unified modeling paradigm for embodied intelligence, provides architecture design references for extending multimodal pretraining to embodied scenarios, and verifies that joint optimization of shared representations requires no performance tradeoff across individual specialized capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: A single VLM serves as the shared understanding and reasoning module, which maps scenes, instructions, visual contexts and action histories into a unified semantic space, autoregressively generates task-, action- and future-oriented chains of thought, and outputs the corresponding latent variable. A Unified Future Generator (UFG) conditions on this latent variable, and generates both future videos and low-level actions via two modality-specific heads within the same diffusion denoising process. During training, language, video and action losses are all backpropagated to the shared representation layer to enable joint optimization of four capabilities.
summary_en.experiments: A single checkpoint achieves strong performance across three task categories: 64.7 on 8 VLM benchmarks, best among models with comparable parameter scale; 66.03 on WorldArena, ranking first; 93.5 on RoboTwin action benchmark, second average rank among compared methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the definition of unified paradigm, Section 3 for model architecture design, Section 4 for core experiment results. Skip related work and redundant experiment details. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 具身智能统一建模的尝试——用单一VLM+扩散生成器连接推理、视频预测和动作生成。共享表示学习的思路对多模态预训练有一定参考。只看方法架构部分即可。
recommendation.en: An attempt at unified embodied intelligence — a single VLM + diffusion generator connecting reasoning, video prediction, and action generation. The shared representation approach has some reference value for multimodal pretraining. Just read the architecture section.
